records.title: Senior Manager, Quality – Development Programs (R5315)
records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Senior Manager of Quality is responsible for establishing and leading all quality activities for a complex aerospace development program from prototype through production readiness. This role serves as the primary quality leader embedded within the program team and partners closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Flight Test, and Program Management to ensure products are designed, developed, tested, and transitioned to production with quality, reliability, and mission success as foundational objectives.

The Senior Manager of Quality will build and lead a multidisciplinary quality team while implementing scalable quality systems, risk management processes, problem-solving disciplines, and development quality practices appropriate for a rapidly growing aerospace and defense technology organization.

This position requires balancing speed of development with disciplined engineering rigor to support aggressive program schedules while ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, and company requirements.

What you'll do:

 - Development Quality Leadership

 - Serve as the quality leader for XBAT development.

 - Establish quality strategy, objectives, and metrics aligned with program milestones.

 - Integrate quality requirements into the product development lifecycle.

 - Ensure quality considerations are incorporated during system architecture, design reviews, verification, validation, and qualification activities.

 - Partner with Engineering leadership to identify and mitigate technical and programmatic risks.

 - Drive a culture of proactive quality and continuous improvement throughout the program.

Design & Configuration Quality

 - Ensure quality requirements are appropriately captured in product definitions, specifications, and design documentation.

 - Participate in design reviews, change control boards, and configuration management activities.

 - Ensure full configuration and traceability for all material installed into prototype aircraft.

 - Evaluate engineering changes for quality and production readiness impacts.

 - Support requirements verification and validation planning.

 - Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-quality, and design-for-reliability initiatives.

Risk Management & Reliability

 - Lead quality participation in program risk management activities.

 - Establish and maintain FRACAS processes for development and flight test phases of the program.

 - Facilitate root cause and corrective action investigations for design, manufacturing, supplier, and field failures.

 - Support reliability growth planning and execution.

 - Monitor defect trends, failure modes, and reliability metrics to identify systemic risks.

Verification, Validation & Test Quality

 - Develop quality oversight strategies for laboratory, ground, and flight test activities.

 - Ensure test results, anomalies, and nonconformances are appropriately documented and dispositioned.

 - Support qualification and certification efforts.

 - Establish processes for managing test escapes, failures, and corrective actions.

Nonconformance & Corrective Action Management

 - Lead Material Review Board activities for development hardware.

 - Establish scalable processes for nonconformance management.

 - Drive root cause analysis using structured problem-solving methodologies.

 - Ensure timely and effective corrective and preventive actions.

 - Track effectiveness of corrective actions through closure.

Production Readiness & Industrialization

 - Partner with Manufacturing and Supply Chain teams to transition products from prototype to production.

 - Define quality requirements for production readiness reviews.

 - Support development of inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and control strategies.

 - Ensure lessons learned from development are incorporated into production processes.

 - Lead quality planning activities supporting low-rate initial production and rate increases.

Quality Management System

 - Develop and implement quality processes supporting aerospace development programs.

 - Ensure compliance with AS9100, customer requirements, and internal procedures.

 - Drive continuous improvement of development quality processes.

 - Support internal and external audits as required.

 - Establish scalable systems that support future production growth.

Leadership & Team Development

 - Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing quality organization.

 - Recruit and develop quality engineers, inspectors, and technicians.

 - Establish clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations.

 - Promote a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and collaboration.

 - Develop organizational capabilities to support future company growth.

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Aerospace Engineering, or related technical discipline.

 - 10+ years of experience in aerospace, defense, aviation, space, or other highly regulated industries.

 - 5+ years of leadership experience managing technical quality organizations.

 - Experience supporting complex product development programs from concept through production transition.

 - Strong knowledge of quality systems, engineering development processes, and aerospace manufacturing.

 - Experience leading root cause investigations and corrective action programs.

 - Experience with risk management, reliability engineering, and failure analysis.

 - Working knowledge of AS9100 quality management systems.

 - Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leadership.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience supporting UAV, aerospace, defense, aviation, autonomous systems, or advanced technology programs.

 - Experience leading quality organizations during rapid company growth.

 - Background in systems engineering, reliability engineering, or development engineering.

 - Experience with flight test programs and qualification testing.

 - ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), or equivalent certification.

 - Familiarity with government defense programs and customer quality requirements.

#LI-JM1

#LE

 

Full-time regular employee offer package:

Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity

 

Temporary employee offer package:

Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)

 

Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information.

 

###

 

Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 

Job Description:

The Senior Air Vehicle Operator (AVO) – Deployment Operations is responsible for executing and leading V-BAT flight operations in support of DoD and foreign customers in both land-based and maritime OCONUS environments. This is an operationally focused role requiring strong aviation judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to lead small teams in austere and high-visibility conditions. 

 

The Senior AVO is responsible for leading mission planning activities, performing comprehensive risk assessments, delivering pre-mission briefings, executing flight operations, and conducting structured post-flight debriefs. This role includes conducting Functional Check Flights (FCFs) and system validation as required, ensuring aircraft configuration control and logbook accuracy, coordinating with maintenance to sustain fleet readiness, and supporting overall operational discipline. The Senior AVO will mentor junior operators, serve as the on-site operational representative to customers, and travel extensively in support of deployments. 

 

This is not an entry-level flight operations role. The ideal candidate brings strong aviation fundamentals, disciplined cockpit habits, and mature operational decision-making. They must be comfortable leading deployments, briefing customers, managing risk in dynamic environments, and maintaining professionalism in high-visibility settings. The Senior AVO must balance mission execution with customer satisfaction while upholding the highest standards of safety, compliance, and operational excellence. 

Required Qualifications:

 - Minimum of 2000 documented unmanned flight hours or 1000 manned flight hours 

 - Demonstrated instructor experience (manned or unmanned aviation)  

 - FAA Private Pilot License (PPL)  

 - FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate 

 - Ability to obtain and maintain an FAA Class II Medical Certificate 

 - Ability to obtain and hold a Secret DoD security clearance 

 - Ability to pass background, drug screening, and customer-required medical/dental screenings 

 - Willingness to travel up to 50–75% in support of deployments 

 - Ability to lead and operate independently in small teams under austere conditions 

 - Strong aviation judgment, decision-making, and risk management skills 

Preferred Qualifications

 - FAA Instrument Rating and/or Commercial Pilot License  

 - Experience operating as aircrew on manned aircraft  

 - Prior military service, particularly with overseas or deployed operations  

 - Maritime or shipboard UAS operational experience  

 - Previous experience as a Site Lead or in a leadership role overseeing aviation operations

records.title: Senior Staff Engineer, Operations Analysis (R5869)
records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Senior Lead Operational Analyst to contribute to the modeling, simulation, and analysis of Shield AI’s aircraft systems. In this role, you will perform analysis at the component, system, mission and campaign levels to evaluate the effectiveness, survivability, and operational impact of our aircraft across multiple domains, missions and applications. You will collaborate closely with engineering, product, and defense stakeholders to assess system performance, inform design trade-offs, and improve mission outcomes. 


This position requires a strong working knowledge of military operations, modeling & simulation (M&S), data science, and operational analysis techniques. Your analyses will directly support product decisions and customer engagements by helping demonstrate how Shield AI’s AI-powered platforms perform in realistic and contested operational environments. 

What you'll do:

 - Plan, own and execute operational analyses to assess the effectiveness of autonomous systems in representative military scenarios.

 - Develop and run modeling, simulation, and wargaming analyses to evaluate system performance, mission impact, and survivability in contested environments.

 - Collaborate with engineering teams and product managers to translate operational findings into actionable system insights.

 - Perform trade studies and sensitivity analyses to assess system performance across varying operational conditions, assumptions, and threat environments.

 - Build, modify, and analyze mission-level models using tools such as AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, Python, or similar M&S frameworks.

 - Analyze force-on-force engagements, sensor performance, and autonomy-enabled behaviors to support mission effectiveness assessments.

 - Engage with DoD stakeholders, operators, and analysts to understand mission needs and operational constraints.

 - Contribute to the development and refinement of concepts of operations (CONOPS) for AI-enabled aircraft capabilities.

 - Monitor emerging threats and operational challenges relevant to autonomous and air combat systems.

 - Prepare technical documentation, analysis reports, and briefings for internal teams, customers, and government stakeholders. 

 - Apply modern compute and development best practices (e.g., version control, scripting, scalable compute workflows, and reproducible analysis) to build and maintain reliable analysis pipelines.

 - Be a force multiplier by coaching and developing incoming talent.

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering or math domain.

 - Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience in operational analysis, modeling & simulation, operations research, or related defense or aerospace roles.

 - Active Secret at a minimum.  

 - Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Prior experience in force-on-force analysis, CONOPS development, or military campaign modeling.
 
 - Experience with evaluating strategic development and analysis goals for multi-mission/multi-domain applicability.

 - Familiarity with DoD acquisition processes, tools (Brawler, ESAMS, etc.), Joint Capabilities Integration and Development System (JCIDS), and military operational testing.
 
 - Experience leading a product effort from pre-shaping to tactical deployment

 - Prior experience in systems engineering product development lifecycle (SysML or MBSE preferred)
 
 -  Experience developing technical expertise in a team to execute analyses for system design and analysis.

 - Preferred Top-Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).

records.title: Senior Manager, Supplier Quality (R6220)
records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

Shield AI is actively seeking candidates with deep expertise in manufacturing and quality methodologies, paired with a relentless drive to enable supplier success and strengthen mission-critical operations.

Shield AI’s Supply Chain Quality team is responsible for global quality oversight across our supplier base. The team reduces supply-chain risk through supplier assessments and internal risk reviews, proactively drives supplier qualification and development activities.

In this role, you will lead a supplier quality team responsible for supplier qualification, development, performance management, and quality assurance across Shield AI’s aerospace and defense supply base. You will set supplier-quality priorities; manage team capacity, technical execution, and resource allocation; and develop high-performing quality leaders. The role also oversees supplier audits, nonconformance resolution, root-cause investigations, and hands on hardware dispositions.

You will evaluate supplier capability, quality performance, organizational risk, and resource needs to ensure purchased hardware and materials meet Shield AI engineering, customer, regulatory, and quality requirements. As an experienced aerospace quality leader, you will partner closely with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, and Program teams to resolve complex supplier-quality issues, improve supplier capability, and reduce quality and delivery risk across the supply base.

What you'll do:

 - Develop the supplier quality team responsible for supplier qualification, surveillance, performance management, and corrective-action activities across Shield AI’s global aerospace and defense supply base.

 - Establish supplier-quality priorities, allocate resources, and translate functional objectives into staffing, workload, and execution plans that support product, program, and organizational needs.

 - Develop Supplier Quality leaders and engineering personnel through coaching, performance management, succession planning, workforce development, and technical mentorship.

 - Oversee supplier qualification, risk assessments, periodic performance reviews, supplier audits, source inspections, and approved-supplier status across complex aerospace hardware, commodities, and manufacturing processes.

 - Ensure supplier requirements are effectively flowed down and that suppliers comply with applicable quality management system, engineering, customer, contractual, regulatory, and statutory requirements.

 - Escalate significant supplier-quality risks and direct SCARs, supplier recovery efforts, and capability-improvement plans that could affect product quality, delivery, mission readiness, or program execution.

 - Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Program teams to address supplier producibility, design-for-manufacturability, process capability, technical execution, and quality risks.

 - Advance supplier-quality processes, business systems, data analytics, and continuous-improvement practices that strengthen supplier capability, product quality, delivery performance, and supply-base resilience.

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or another related technical discipline.

 - At least 7 years of relevant experience, including 2–5 years of leadership or people-management experience with direct responsibility for Quality Engineering and/or Supplier Quality Engineering personnel.

 - Strong working knowledge of AS9100 and/or ISO 9001 quality-management systems, as well as aerospace and defense supplier-quality requirements.

 - Demonstrated proficiency in root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving methods, including 8D, 5 Whys, and fishbone analysis.

 - Experience with supplier qualification, supplier development, PPAP, and First Article Inspection processes, including AS9102 requirements.

 - Understanding of ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and other requirements applicable to aerospace and defense suppliers.

 - Demonstrated people-leadership capability, including coaching, performance management, organizational development, and building high-performing technical teams.

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration, executive communication, and supplier relationship-management skills.

 - Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.

 - Experience using ERP/MRP systems.

 - Ability to travel to Shield AI manufacturing locations and supplier sites domestically and, as needed, internationally—up to approximately 20% of the time.

Preferred qualifications:

 - ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Quality Manager (CQM), or equivalent quality certification.

 - Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.

 - Experience leading supplier-quality functions in a high-growth aerospace, defense, autonomy, robotics, or advanced-manufacturing environment.

 - Experience supporting the production and qualification of complex electromechanical, electronic, precision-machined, composite, or avionics hardware.

records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Compensation Director, Aircraft Engineering and Manufacturing, serves as the strategic compensation leader for the Aircraft division, providing enterprise-level oversight for compensation programs supporting manufacturing, production, operations, supply chain, logistics, customer success, and skilled trades. This role defines compensation strategy for large, complex employee populations while ensuring programs are competitive, scalable, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. 

As the organization's subject matter expert for manufacturing and operations compensation, the Director partners closely with business leaders, Px Business Partners, Finance, and Legal to design compensation programs that enable business growth, talent attraction, workforce scalability, and operational excellence. 

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in manufacturing compensation strategy, non-exempt workforce design, market intelligence, and executive consulting, with a demonstrated ability to influence enterprise decisions and build compensation frameworks that support rapidly growing operations. 

What you'll do:

Compensation Strategy & Enterprise Leadership 

 - Develop and lead the compensation strategy supporting Aircraft manufacturing, production, operations, supply chain, logistics, customer success, and skilled trades populations.  

 - Serve as the SME on manufacturing and operations compensation, shaping long-term compensation philosophy and governance.  

 - Partner with business leadership to align compensation strategy with business growth, workforce planning, organizational design, and operational priorities.  

 - Drive compensation initiatives supporting facility expansions, new business models, geographic growth, and workforce transformation.  

Manufacturing & Operations Compensation 

 - Lead the design and evolution of compensation structures supporting large non-exempt employee populations.  

 - Establish wage structures, geographic differentials, shift premium strategies, progression frameworks, and other compensation programs that balance external competitiveness with internal equity.  

 - Oversee market pricing methodologies utilizing Radford, Mercer, WTW, and specialized manufacturing compensation surveys alongside complementary market intelligence.  

 - Develop innovative compensation approaches to attract and retain highly competitive manufacturing, technical, and operational talent. 

Executive Partnership & Business Consulting 

 - Serve as the trusted compensation advisor to Aircraft executives and business leaders.  

 - Consult on organization design, workforce investments, location strategy, and talent acquisition decisions with significant financial and organizational impact in partnership with the Px Business Partner.  

 - Provide strategic guidance on compensation implications of organizational changes, acquisitions, new facilities, and business expansion.  

 - Present compensation recommendations and analyses to executive leadership with clear business rationale and risk assessments.  

Compensation Analytics & Insights 

 - Lead enterprise compensation analyses including market competitiveness, pay equity, workforce cost modeling, and incentive effectiveness.  

 - Translate complex compensation data into actionable insights for executive stakeholders.  

 - Anticipate market trends and proactively recommend compensation strategies that strengthen organizational competitiveness.  

Governance, Compliance & Program Excellence 

 - Establish governance frameworks, policies, and administration standards for manufacturing compensation programs.  

 - Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local wage and hour regulations while mitigating organizational risk.  

 - Partner with Legal, Finance, and People Operations on complex compensation matters and regulatory changes.  

 - Lead continuous improvement initiatives to simplify compensation processes, improve scalability, and enhance operational efficiency. 

Leadership 

 - Champion best practices in compensation design, analytics, governance, and operational excellence.  

 - Build organizational capability through knowledge sharing, coaching, and development of compensation expertise across the People function. 

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field. 

 - 15+ years of progressive compensation experience, including significant leadership supporting manufacturing, production, operations, or supply chain organizations.  

 - Deep expertise designing enterprise compensation strategies for large non-exempt employee populations.  

 - Extensive knowledge of wage and hour regulations, compensation governance, and manufacturing compensation practices.

 - Demonstrated experience designing wage structures, progression frameworks, geographic differentials, and premium pay programs.  

 - Advanced analytical, financial modeling, and executive presentation skills.  

 - Proven ability to influence senior executives and drive enterprise-wide compensation decisions.  

 - Experience leading large, cross-functional compensation initiatives with significant organizational impact. 

Preferred qualifications:

 - Certified Compensation Professional (CCP).  

 - Experience supporting both union and non-union manufacturing environments.  

 - Experience within global manufacturing or advanced technology organizations.  

 - Expertise utilizing Radford, Mercer, WTW, and specialized manufacturing compensation surveys.  

 - Experience with Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or enterprise compensation planning systems.  

 - Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement experience. 

 - Experience leading or mentoring compensation professionals.

records.title: Director, Accounting – Manufacturing
records.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role
Crusoe is looking for a Director of Accounting to own accounting, cost accounting and financial reporting for its manufacturing business. You'll report to the Corporate Controller and lead a multi-site team of 8+ and act as the accounting partner to Manufacturing leadership. You'll also build the cost, inventory and control infrastructure the business needs as production grows to meet demand for Crusoe's AI infrastructure.



Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy

 - Lead, build and develop a team of 8+ across multiple manufacturing facilities. Set the team's structure, hiring plan and development path as the business grows.

 - Act as the primary finance partner to manufacturing leadership (operations, supply chain, engineering, quality and procurement). Turn plant and assembly metrics into financial insight and decisions.

 - Drive financial accountability across operations by setting cost targets, tracking performance and influencing decisions on capacity, make-vs-buy, sourcing and pricing.

 - Advise executive leadership on product and program margins, cost-reduction opportunities and the financial impact of design, material and process changes.

Cost Accounting & Inventory

 - Own the cost accounting framework, including standard cost methodology, the annual standard-setting process, overhead absorption and labor rates.

 - Set and oversee inventory accounting policy, including valuation, WIP, high-value long-lead components, reserves and excess/obsolete inventory. Own the cycle count and physical inventory programs across all sites.

 - Lead analysis of manufacturing variances (purchase price, usage, labor, overhead), yield and productivity. Turn the results into actionable cost-improvement initiatives.

 - Own new-product and new-program cost estimates and margin modeling in partnership with Engineering and Sales.

Close, Reporting & Controls

 - Be accountable for a timely, accurate month-end close for the manufacturing entity. Present results, key drivers and risks to the Controller, CAO and operations leadership.

 - Ensure US GAAP compliance and own the manufacturing control environment, building it out to a SOX-ready, audit-ready standard. Serve as the primary contact for external auditors on manufacturing and inventory matters.

 - Lead the manufacturing entity's annual budget and rolling forecasts, working with FP&A.

Systems & Scale

 - Act as the accounting owner for the ERP manufacturing modules (BOMs, routings, work orders, costing) and lead system improvements and implementations.

 - Design, document and continuously improve scalable processes, with a focus on automation, as new facilities and product lines come online.



Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting. CPA or CMA required.

 - 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 5+ years in manufacturing or cost accounting and 3+ years leading teams (including managers).

 - Proven ownership of standard costing, inventory valuation and variance analysis in a complex, multi-site manufacturing environment.

 - Deep experience with ERP manufacturing modules (BOMs, routings, job and work-order costing). ERP implementation experience is a plus.

 - Experience with complex inventory, such as WIP, engineered-to-order or high-value long-lead components.

 - Strong knowledge of US GAAP and internal controls. SOX, public-company or Big 4 experience is a plus.

 - Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills.

 - High operational credibility: comfortable on the factory floor and able to influence senior operations and engineering leaders.

 - Track record of scaling teams, processes and systems in a high-growth environment.



Benefits:

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $185,000 - $215,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. (#INDCORP)

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

records.title: Head of Quality Assurance Operations
records.description:
ABOUT DAVID AI

At David AI, our vision is to bring impactful AI into billions of lives through voice. Our mission is to help the world's leading AI companies build better voice models and agents. We're building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind those models.

Founded in 2024, we're a fast-growing Series B company backed by NVIDIA, Meritech, First Round, YC, and others, with ~70 people across San Francisco and New York City.




ABOUT OUR DATA OPERATIONS TEAM

Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale. This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.



ABOUT THIS ROLE

As Head of Quality Assurance Operations, you'll own quality for every dataset David AI ships including but not limited to conversational, TTS, and transcription data, and manage David AI’s relationships with the global contingent workforce, comprising independent contractors and vendor-supplied contributors. You'll report to the Head of Operations and be located in the US.



IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Own the quality bar across all data ops, including quality standards, calibration, consistency and on-time delivery of datasets

 - Design the quality review structure, organized by language and region, so every dataset gets consistent quality coverage

 - Audit and review the quality of delivered work product across languages, keeping quality benchmarks consistent globally

 - Run quality in languages you don't speak through deliverables from native-speaker and cross-language gold sets

 - Plan capacity against production ramps and own contingent workforce sourcing across many countries, ensuring each engagement is structured and classified correctly under local law

 - Build and own dashboards for quality, throughput, and cost efficiency

 - Manage David AI’s relationships with staffing vendors, service providers, and employer-of-record partners
 


YOUR BACKGROUND LOOKS LIKE

 - 7 to 10+ years in operations, including 3+ in senior leadership roles

 - You've run quality operations for large contingent workforce networks across multiple countries

 - You've owned quality at scale, across calibration, capacity planning, and spend efficiency

 - You built the system yourself, from tooling to contingent workforce sourcing at scale

 - Speech, audio, or linguistic data experience is a strong plus




BENEFITS

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.

 - FSA & HSA access.

 - 401k access.

 - Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.

 - Unlimited company-sponsored Barry's classes.
 
 


VISAS

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B transfers, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on STEM OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

records.title: Deputy Head of Production, Autonomous Airpower (Fury)
records.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 We are looking for a Deputy Head of Production, Autonomous Airpower (Fury) to join our rapidly growing team at Arsenal 1, our cutting edge factory in Asheville, OH. As the Deputy Head of Production, you will work directly on our autonomous fighter jet, Fury. You will have the ability to have your fingerprints all over something that was just science fiction until now. You will own the short-to-mid-term strategy and execution for the manufacture of Fury. You will lead and collaborate with some of the most brilliant engineers and manufacturing talent in the world. 

 What You'll Do: 

 
 Own production outcomes for Fury, standing up new manufacturing lines, including ramp plans, and people management.

 Create and execute a long-term strategy to rapidly scale production volumes from a prototype units per year to predictable production rates.

 Lead cross-functional production teams to execute plans that meet aggressive customer timelines.

 Partner with engineering to transition new designs and systems to production quickly and efficiently.

 Shape corporate tools and processes to support the unique needs of aerospace production.

 Triage production resources and focus to manage shifting priorities in a dynamic environment.

 Serve as a rallying point for production teams through strong leadership, advocacy, and on-site presence.

 
 Required Qualifications: 

 
 8+ years of experience overseeing the production and test of complex electromechanical products.

 Ownership and successful execution of NPI for multiple complex hardware products.

 Strong leadership of large (100+ person) manufacturing teams.

 Experience directing and leading large cross functional teams across planning, supply chain, engineering, quality, and production teams to deliver products of the highest quality.

 A strong background in quality assurance, with a track record of driving a "quality-first" culture in a production environment.

 Past success operating in low rate and high rate manufacturing environments.

 Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance.

 High ownership and ability to effectively manage multiple (6+) large projects and priorities in parallel, at a rapid pace, and report out on progress regularly.

 Ability to work onsite five days a week at our Asheville, OH campus (Arsenal 1).

 
 Preferred Qualifications: 

 
 8+ years of experience overseeing the production of highly complex aerospace products.

 Success scaling production operations by 5x or more in a high-complexity manufacturing environment.

 Ownership and successful execution of NPI for multiple complex hardware products in the aerospace or hard tech.

 Deep experience with the niche supply chains for aerospace and robotics.

 Experience managing and operating in highly secure manufacturing environments.

 US Salary Range
 $190,000 — $252,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

records.title: Deputy Head of Production, Connected Warfare
records.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE SITE 

Anduril, a leader in autonomous systems and weapons manufacturing, is building Arsenal-1 , its first hyperscale manufacturing facility, just south of Columbus, Ohio in Pickaway County. Arsenal-1 is redefining the scale and speed that autonomous systems and weapons can be produced for the United States and its allies and partners. This is a monumental and essential step toward rebuilding America’s defense industrial base, strengthening America’s warfighting capabilities, and enhancing deterrence amid rising international threats.



 ABOUT THE TEAM

 The Connected Warfare will set the standard for building the future at Arsenal-1 , our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Ashville, OH. This team will have the opportunity to train under our world-class manufacturing team at Anduril HQ in Costa Mesa, CA for 3 months before bringing that standard of excellence back to Ohio.

 ABOUT THE ROLE 

 As the Connected Warfare Deputy Head of Production, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of defense manufacturing by directly influencing the production of Anduril’s Connected Warfare product line. Working as a right hand to the Head of Production, you will own the short-to-mid-term strategic development and execution of manufacturing operations, driving products from NPI to full-rate production. This role requires a dynamic leader who can serve as both a strategic architect and a hands-on executor, leading cross-functional teams to meet aggressive timelines and deliver products of the highest quality for our customers. You will contribute significantly to Anduril’s vision of becoming a next-generation aerospace and defense manufacturer.

 

 What You'll Do: 

 
 Production Ownership & Strategy: Own all production outcomes for the Connected Warfare product line, including ramp plans, headcount, and the standing up of new manufacturing lines. Develop and execute a strategy to rapidly scale production volumes f rom NPI to full-rate production.

 Leadership & Team Management: Serve as a strategic leader and tactical do-er, driving all people and resources across production to achieve outcomes. Lead cross-functional teams (including Production, Supply Chain, Quality, and Manufacturing Engineering) through strong leadership, advocacy, and a consistent on-site presence, holding them accountable to meeting demands, deadlines, and goals.

 Operational Excellence: Drive processes and systems needed throughout the product development lifecycle to mature products to full-rate production. Establish and manage the team to key performance indicators (KPIs) for financial, quality, and on-time delivery, and partner on production budgets and cost targets to optimize manufacturing operations’ impact on the business.

 Quality & Compliance: Be accountable to AS9100D guidelines and drive a “quality-first” culture across all manufacturing operations.

 Process & Technology Advancement: Advise on development and oversee the implementation of digital technologies, from PLM and ERP to our custom MES and QMS systems, that enable our production operations to efficiently scale while meeting customer requirements. Shape corporate tools and processes to support the unique needs of aerospace production.

 
 Required Qualifications: 

 
 8+ years of proven experience overseeing the production and test of complex electromechanical products.

 Strong leadership experience managing large (100+ person) manufacturing teams and directing large cross-functional teams across planning, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, quality, and production to deliver products of the highest quality.

 A strong background in quality assurance, with a track record of driving a "quality-first" culture in a production environment and accountability to standards like AS9100D.

 Past success operating in both low-rate prototype and high-rate manufacturing environments, with a proven ability to scale production.

 High ownership and the ability to effectively manage multiple large projects and priorities in parallel, at a rapid pace, and report out on progress regularly.

 Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance.

 Ability to work onsite five days a week at our Asheville, OH campus (Arsenal 1).

 
 Preferred Qualifications: 

 
 Success scaling production operations in a high-complexity manufacturing environment.

 Deep experience with the niche supply chains for aerospace and robotics.

 Demonstrated experience implementing and leveraging digital manufacturing technologies (PLM, ERP, MES, QMS) to drive efficiency and scale.

 
  
 US Salary Range
 $190,000 — $252,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

records.title: Director, Manufacturing Analytics
records.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 About the role

 The Director, Manufacturing Analytics owns Manufacturing Analytics globally: every site, every product line, and every Manufacturing function across Manufacturing Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain, Planning, and Warehousing / Material Management. The ambition is not better dashboards. It is that a division leader can tell whether they will hit rate before they miss it, and that when we argue about where to invest, the argument is settled by data rather than by whoever presents best.

 ABOUT THE JOB

 This is a player-coach role. You will lead the hardest analytical problems yourself, on the programs that matter most to the company, and build a team that can run several more in parallel. You will be judged on what you accomplish, not on how you operate: whether a program hit rate that would otherwise have slipped, whether a constraint got cleared because we saw it coming, whether a number leadership used to make a real decision came from this team.
We weigh approach over domain familiarity. The strongest analytics leaders we have are exceptional at how they attack a problem, even where they arrived without the functional background. Manufacturing depth is useful and listed below as preferred, but it does not substitute for analytical method, judgment about what matters, and the ability to drive a result through an organization.

 What you'll do

 
 Apply analytics to manufacturing’s biggest problems. Hold an evidence-backed view of what is worth the company's attention and in what order, rather than working a request list. Take the hardest two or three problems in Anduril's flagship programs and build analytics into them end to end, hands-on.

 Make the various business units in Anduril decide earlier. Shift Manufacturing reporting from retrospective to leading: risk surfaced two months before the gate, not status recited on the day of it. Adoption is the deliverable. A correct dashboard nobody opens has failed.

 Turn what worked into the enterprise standard. Generalize proven capabilities into supported products, standardize the definitions the work proved out, and consolidate the duplicated reporting they replace. A standard that survives contact with a program running at rate is defensible. One written in a document is not.

 Answer what it takes to scale. Own the analytical side of a ramp from low rate to high rate, and keep a current, evidenced view of the constraints that actually bind as the company grows.

 Build the team and the foundation. Lead the consolidated analytics organization and the managers within it. Build on and in the Manufacturing process/team rather than beside them. Hold the line that the various business units own master data quality while the analytics team builds the tooling that makes defects visible and cheap to fix.

 Your work should produce numbers the business can trust. Where a metric is known to be wrong, it is a defect with an owner and a date, not a caveat on a slide. Fix the data before building on top of it.

 
 Required qualifications

 
 10+ years in analytics, data, or quantitative operations, including 5+ years leading analytics or data teams, and experience managing managers or clear readiness to do so.

 A rigorous, teachable approach to ambiguous problems. You can describe how you decide what to work on, how you structure an analysis, how you know when you're wrong, and how you install that method in a team.

 Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL and a modern data stack, able to get into a dataset personally, find the answer, and defend the method. This role does not succeed as pure management.

 Demonstrated ability to identify the highest-value problem in a messy operational environment and solve it analytically.

 A track record you can point at: specific operational outcomes your work caused, with the numbers, the program, and the skeptics named.

 Experience shipping analytics as supported products with real users, and retiring what they replace.

 Able to influence business unit and functional leadership peer-to-peer without authority, and to work credibly with a program team that starts out unconvinced.

 Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. U.S. person status required per ITAR/EAR.

 
 Preferred qualifications

 
 Operational depth in manufacturing, supply chain, or planning, including fluency with routings, work orders, MRP exceptions, and cycle counts.

 Analytical ownership of a Manufacturing ramp from low rate to high rate.

 Experience building an analytics function from a scattered starting point, consolidating people, standards, and tooling that previously sat under separate owners.

 Databricks and Palantir Foundry, dimensional modeling and semantic or ontology layers.

 High-rate or high-mix manufacturing, defense Manufacturing, or another environment scaling volume fast.

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. This senior leader will support both the development of new products and the scaling of high-volume production.

Your leadership will guarantee that rigorous manufacturing processes are in place, resulting in the consistent delivery of superior quality products. This role demands an innovative and adaptable approach to solving complex manufacturing challenges, driving advancements in digital tools, DfM/DfA, and automation in a highly dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be a results-oriented leader with deep expertise in lean manufacturing, process engineering, operational excellence, and team development.

 Build systems and processes to support the manufacturing design and production of classified products in compliance with security and regulatory requirements.

 Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing team of manufacturing engineers and technical staff.

 Build and maintain an engaged, motivated workforce through strong leadership and communication.

 Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

 
 New Product Introduction (NPI) & Scalability 

 
 Partner with R&D and product development teams to ensure seamless transition of new products from design to production.

 Drive Design for Manufacturability (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles during product development, ensuring smooth scaling into production.

 
 Resource Planning 

 
 Manage budgets, resources, and staffing for the manufacturing engineering department.

 Forecast future operational and headcount needs to support scaling efforts for high-growth production environments.

 Plan for rapid response to large-scale program demands, including classified systems, with short ramp-up times.

 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Industrial, Electrical), Operations Management, Business, or a related field; Master’s degree or MBA strongly preferred.

 15+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing engineering and operations with at least 7 years in senior leadership roles.

 Strong knowledge of automation, robotics, and advanced manufacturing technologies.

 Experience in managing New Product Introduction (NPI) and scaling production for high-growth environments.

 Experience in developing, implementing, and utilizing digital manufacturing tools for design and analysis.

 Familiarity with quality systems and regulatory compliance (ISO, FDA, AS9100, etc.) preferred.

 Familiar with Product Life Cycle (PLM) systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and Test Execution Systems (TES).

 Excellent leadership, interpersonal, communication, and project management skills.

 Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

records.title: Director of Manufacturing Operations, AD&S
records.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE ROLE 

 We’re hiring a Director of Manufacturing Operations to oversee all production within our Air Dominance & Strike division, from rapidly maturing prototypes through full-rate production at scale. 

 In this role, you will be responsible for managing a team of highly talented managers, line supervisors, and technicians who manufacture both our current key autonomous products, Fury, Barracuda, and Roadrunner, and our emerging capabilities. This is a highly dynamic role that requires both technical and frontline people management skills. This role is at the forefront of delivering exceptional customer experiences, fostering team development, and overseeing operations at Arsenal-01 and HQ. 

 As a Director in the Air Dominance & Strike Production organization, you must be a technical leader with the expertise to evaluate, qualify, manage, and advocate for an increasing number of sophisticated parallel pursuits. This role is crucial in ensuring that both manufacturing sites and operations align with the division's strategic direction and receives the appropriate resourcing, in addition to balancing innovation with practical execution to drive the business line's manufacturing operational success. 

 Success in this role demands consistent achievement across hardware production, team management, manufacturing operations, and financial goals. The ideal candidate combines technical acumen with effective communication, strong time-management skills, and a passion for leading transformative change. The ideal candidate should be energetic, highly organized, and deeply committed to scaling innovative products. While individual contributions are valued, teamwork is crucial for achieving the highest level of success while maintaining our Anduril culture above all. 

 Please note: This role will be based at Arsenal-01 in Columbus, OH. A successful candidate will be expected to work out of Columbus, OH. Based on eligibility, relocation assistance may be available. There will likely be 25% - 50% travel required for the role. 

 WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 
 First and foremost, deliver outcomes for the Air Dominance & Strike Production organization 

 Create a clear vision for Manufacturing Operations 

 
 You are a key leader in supporting and strengthening the vision of AD&S Production 

 Manage the portfolio of projects necessary to achieve your vision for Manufacturing Operations 

 
 Collaborate successfully with leaders across our production organization 

 
 Leaders include Manufacturing Engineering, Design Engineering, Planning, Quality, and Supply Chain 

 
 Deliver quality products, on-time and at cost 

 
 Own attainment for both current and emerging programs 

 
 Own the culture on the floor 

 
 Be a stakeholder in all programs, policies, etc. that affect life on the floor 

 Maximize for what’s right both for Anduril’s future and maintaining a strong team culture 

 Coach, mentor and support Manufacturing Operations Managers and Production Supervisors 

 Create and maintain a high bar for excellence 

 
 Clearly communicate up and out 

 
 Provide consistent and high-quality briefs both up, to Anduril Senior Leadership, and out, to AD&S Customers 

 
 In summary, show up every day with a high level of urgency, ownership, and enthusiasm to get the job done 

 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: 

 
 6+ years experience managing manufacturing and production operations 

 3+ years in a supervisor or production operations management role at the Director level or above 

 3+ years of experience as a manager of managers 

 Experience managing operator / technician workforce of 100+ within direct organization 

 Experience working directly and communicating with designers and engineers 

 A full understanding of the product life cycle (NPI to scaled production), LEAN manufacturing principles, and change management 

 Extremely reliable, organized, and detail-oriented with excellent verbal & written communication skills 

 You have a passion for employee development and enjoy the process of training and developing both new hires and veteran production staff 

 Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance 

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: 

 
 Bachelor or Master’s degree in a technical field (engineering, business, or applied science) 

 Working knowledge of AS9100 standards and OSHA laws 

 
  
 US Salary Range
 $190,000 — $252,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM

 The Tactical Recon and Strike (TRS) team at Anduril develops aerial small drones (Group 1-3) and all equipment to test, deploy and operate. The team is responsible for taking products like Ghost, Bolt, Anvil, and Altius from paper sketches to operational systems. The Tactical Effects Team is a cornerstone business line of the TRS group that is going through tremendous growth. We work in close coordination with specialist teams to solve some of the hardest problems facing our customers. The TRS Operations team is a small but mighty team of business generalists who ‘solve for scale’ the specific business problems that hamper efficiency or productivity. One project may have you solving staffing inefficiencies across engineering teams, while another project may have you working across manufacturing, supply chain, and quality teams to help address capacity or production challenges. We are looking for the Head of Operations to support our Ghost and Precision Engagement Systems business lines, based in Costa Mesa, CA.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 
 Own all aspects of business operations and infrastructure, ensuring business development, engineering, and production teams have what they need when they need it to execute

 Serve as the General Manager’s chief strategist to balance resource and execution risk against our massive growth plans, regularly monitoring financials to help guide us toward our profitability targets

 Translate growth signals into demand across all operational infrastructure including staffing, real estate, test ranges, classified infrastructure, and production and collaborate with cross-functional partners across Anduril to deliver

 Own the business line’s governance structure from business reviews to annual planning and employee onboarding to all hands, developing and evolving information pathways as the organization scales

 Collaborate closely with division leadership to evolve the organizational structure and define and implement strong hiring, onboarding, and execution standards for key functions so we maintain a culture of “doing things differently”

 Execute on special projects, evolve internal processes, spearhead the stand up of new functions, and lead M&A efforts as needed

 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 You have 5-7+ years of varied experience in an operating role at a high-growth technology company, starting a venture, or in finance or consulting

 You love solving complex, ambiguous, cross-functional problems in a people-centric way

 You’re both high ownership and low ego, approaching everything with strong outcome orientation and high humility

 You’re highly detail oriented and data-driven

 You’re discerning and an incredibly fast learner

 You’re tactical and enjoy getting into the details.

records.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM

 The Air Dominance and Strike Division is one of Anduril’s fastest growing, most technically complex divisions. We develop and build collaborative combat aircraft , missiles, and the software that powers these autonomous weapons. We are looking for a Program Director to be part of the leadership team on one of Anduril’s largest production programs. As a Program Director you will lead a significant portion of the product line and will be directly responsible for all elements of cost and schedule performance in assigned area.

 ABOUT THE JOB

 
 Strategic Thinking and Decomposition: Ability to understand the long term objectives of the business, successfully develop a winning strategy that maximizes business objectives, and decompose into near term and long term plans.

 Execution focused - digging into the details, charting the path and owning the outcome. You will be expected to utilize your technical aptitude in conjunction with your program management, and leadership skills to deliver the best outcome for Anduril and the customer.

 Finical and Business Acumen: Understand the fundamentals of the business and develop KPIs and goals for departments and teams that drive real outcomes

 Collaborative partnership - managing customer relationships and shaping the future of the program with the government.

 
 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 
 Own the overall financial performance and schedule for the production segment of the business

 Autonomously execute on broad and/or ambiguous requirements from internal engineering, customers, and third party corporate partners to own successful delivery of outcomes on multiple programs simultaneously

 Understanding the long term objectives of the business, develop winning strategies that result in meeting Anduril’s business objectives while service the customers needs

 Develop strong, trusting relationships with Anduril’s DOD customers, ensuring we have tight feedback loops that enable us shape solutions, rapidly iterate, and ultimately field solutions faster

 Monitor and manage program progress across cost, schedule, and resource allocation, making tradeoffs that enable us to deliver best-in-class solutions to our customers on-time and on-budget at the stated production capacity rates

 Develop and implement lightweight processes, tools, and metrics for program planning, scope management, risk management, and customer communication to enable Anduril to move rapidly

 Be high ownership on all pieces of work and become a trusted partner and advisor to senior management

 Foster a creative, high-performance culture within the team, and proactively assess team skills versus needs, identifying personnel development or recruitment opportunities to strengthen the team’s capabilities

 Collaborate with finance and business development teams to develop novel pricing strategies for proposals that set Anduril up for long term financial and operational success

 Collaborate with senior management to develop and refine the strategic roadmap for Anduril Air Dominance & Strike R&D investments that underpin the success of our programs

 Work with functional owners to asses and understand current organizational capabilities, ensuring plan is comprehensive and maps path from today's capabilities to needed desired state for the business line, over months and years to come

 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field (technical background preferred)

 Minimum of 8 years experience managing production of complex technical systems

 Proven track record of successfully managing complex, multi-million-dollar production lines and driving their on-time, on-budget performance

 Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving abilities with the ability to move seamlessly between tactical and the 30,000 ft level

 Experience coordinating multiple internal and external teams within a complex engineering or technology-focused organization

 Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences

 $241,000 — $319,000 USD
