records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
Responsible to manage, promote, and continuously maintain a compliant quality management system by effectively managing the quality department that consist of validation, quality inspection, document control, change control, customer complaints, metrology, CAPA management, nonconforming product, calibration, receiving inspection and product release activities. As a quality manager you will ensure that the manufacturing site meets and applies the Global Quality Policies and Guidelines relating to, ISO 9001 & 13485 standards, FDA 21 CFR 820 regulations, customer requirements and comply with necessary local and international regulations.

**Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities****:**

* Responsible for , leading developing, implementing and manage an effective quality management systems that supports the company-wide quality policy, ISO 9000, ISO 13485 and FDA 21 CFR 820 regulations for medical devices with a continuous improvement programs.
* Lead, develop, implement and maintain quality systems for controlling product quality using process capability, inspection, auditing and statistical analysis.
* Lead, develop, implement and maintain an effective quality system for preventing nonconforming product and/or its recurrence using quality planning, material review, corrective action and quality reporting.
* Responsible for selection, interviewing and onboarding of new hires and develop a relevant training program and plan for all site personnel.
* Responsible for leading, driving and enforcing quality programs in collaboration with manufacturing team.
* Resolve customer concerns, complaints and provide feedback on quality issues.
* Analyze daily and monthly quality reports and develop tests to improve product quality.
* Manage day to day department activities.
* Support company quality policy and objectives.
* Ensure products produced meets customer expectations (approve quality specifications) and regulatory requirements
* Lead customer audits, ISO audits and Internal audits
* Achieve financial objectives (maintain department salaries within budget, prepare the Quality budget, schedule the expenditures)
* Follow and report of the site quality performances from a quality standpoint and ensure alignment with Business Unit and manage continuous improvement for product quality
* In cooperation with the Sites Quality Coordinator, develop and implement Quality Objectives in line with objectives of the business unit
* Lead and influence a quality mindset to quality and operations to maintain, improving and maintaining quality system requirements.
* Continually improve quality through analyzing, identifying, and eliminating root causes. Such improvements include reducing defects, decreasing scrap, reducing waste, and improving outputs.
* Apply and evaluate testing and inspection methods; including the identification of requirements for improvements.
* Develop and implement quality cost reduction concepts and techniques.
* Manage department resources, including work assignments, training, cross training, personnel issues, hiring decisions, performance appraisals, motivation, efficiency, capacity and accuracy of work.
* Ensure shift-to-shift communication.
* Provide a safe work environment and resolve any safety issues that arise.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

**Core Competencies:**

* Facilitation
* Conflict Management
* Fostering Learning
* Information Gathering & Processing
* Interactive Communication
* Partnering
* Relationship Building
* Research
* Teamwork
* Writing Skills
* Attention to detail
* Adaptability
* Concern for Safety
* Proactive and self-motivated
* Strong time management with priority setting skills
* Client focused

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Expert knowledge and interpretation of ISO 13485, ISO 9000 standards, 21 CFR 820 and cGMP compliance.
* Ability to lead, implement quality management systems as applicable to ISO and 21 CFR regulations.
* Demonstrate understanding of industry standard validation tools and techniques.
* Demonstrated ability of metrology and basic inspection tools, metrology and injection molding workmanship standards.
* Ability to develop/conduct quality related training programs.
* Effectively communicate in both verbal and written.
* Good organizational skills.
* Excellent English communication skills (both written and verbal).
* Fluency in Spanish a plus.
* Understanding and use of metrology equipment.
* Ability to read drawings and good understanding of geometric tolerancing.
* Knowledge of processing engineering polymers is a plus.
* Exceptional leadership skills which include ability to prioritize, lead, direct, train, and motivate staff.
* Ability to influence peers.
* Excellent planning and organizational skills.
* Good analytical, problem-solving and math skills. Six Sigma and Lean knowledge a plus.
* Understanding and use of sampling plans, Gauge R&R, statistical techniques and SPC.
* Ability to use personal computer and Windows-based software (Outlook, Word and Excel preferred). Use of PC-DMIS metrology software, IQMS manufacturing software and Minitab a plus.

**Education and/or Experience**:

* Bachelor’s degree desirable, four-year college degree (preferably in a sciences chemical, pharmacy, plastics or engineering field) or equivalent combined college/work experience.
* At least 5 years of leading and implementing quality systems in a pharmaceutical or medical device environment
* Manufacturing experience in injection molding plastics industry (or equivalent industry) is a plus.

records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
Harvest Solar, an equal opportunity employer, is a Michigan-based company that provides cost-effective renewable energy for agriculture, commercial, and utility customers yielding more energy independence by utilizing solar energy. We believe in energy independence and a sustainable future for our children and grandchildren. Our purpose is to empower people to create and use renewable energy by providing them with the best‐in‐class service, products, and experience. 
 
**Position Title and Purpose of Position** 
The Director of Quality will develop, coordinate, and implement quality and commissioning policies and procedures to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant operations throughout the organization. The Director of Quality is responsible for site specific quality and commissioning compliance within both Harvest’s and the customer’s requirements. The Director of Quality will work closely with onsite Harvest Solar project management, direct-labor staff, customer’s representatives, and subcontractors to ensure all work is completed to established requirements.

**Salary** 
The salary range for this role is $110,000.00 to $130,000.00 USD, salary commensurate with education and experience. An Annual Bonus Target representing 10% of your annual base salary/annual wages is paid based on meeting both organizational and individual targets. 
 
**Major Responsibilities of Position**

* Ensure a “Safe Culture” through employee engagement, training, coaching, and compliance
* Responsible for planning, developing, implementing, maintaining, and improving quality and commissioning policies and procedures in compliance with Harvest requirements along with customer, Utility, and AHJ requirements
* Responsible for planning, developing, implementing, and providing quality and commissioning training for relevant employees
* Identifies opportunities to improve existing policies and procedures
* Maintain quality and commissioning records using Procore and other customer required systems
* Prepare written reports of findings and recommendations for corrective or preventive measures where indicated; follow up to ensure measures have been implemented
* Work with project management teams and field workers to implement solutions to quality issues on project sites
* Provide technical support to Preconstruction department for quoting and proposals
* Represent company in meetings with governing bodies (AHJ, utilities), subcontractors, and customer on issues regarding quality and commissioning
* Responsible for managing direct reports
* Other duties as assigned

The successful candidate will have: (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Other Attributes)

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
* Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, employees, and the public
* Ability to prioritize tasks especially when handling an accident or incident
* Ability to manage daily priorities and ensure task accomplishment
* Ability to communicate effectively, both oral and written
* Thorough knowledge of health and safety laws and guidelines
* Extensive attention to detail to distinguish safety hazards
* Good understanding of data analysis and risk assessment
* Good organizational, leadership and motivational skills
* Maintain regular and acceptable attendance
* Willing to work hours necessary to support the accomplishment of organizational goals

**Educational and Certification Background**

* High school diploma or GED – Required.
* Bachelor’s degree in safety management and five years’ experience; or ten years’ experience coordinating safety & environmental programs; experience in construction environment preferred.
* Valid State Driver’s License – Required
* OSHA 30 - Preferred
* MIOSHA Level I or Level II Certification, or OHSA 500 - Preferred

**Work Environment**

* Commercial Construction Setting 20% of the time: Job Site terrain and outdoor work with exposure to weather fluctuations in addition to construction site hazards. Installers travel to work sites and therefore, travel is required 100% of the time. Harvest values our employees work life balance and whenever possible, overnight travel is Monday through Friday. Hotel and transportations costs are covered. Additionally, a food per diem is paid for overnight stays.
* Travel Required 20% of the time: Position supports job site activities therefore daily and overnight travel is required. Harvest values our employees work life balance and whenever possible, overnight travel is Monday through Friday. Hotel and transportations costs are covered. Additionally, per diem is paid for overnight stays.

**Benefit Offerings** 
 
**Immediately after Hire:**

* Nine Paid Holidays per Year. Including: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Day after Thanksgiving, and Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Years Eve.
* Paid Vacation: Vacation time is accrued each week at a rate of .924 to achieve 48 hours in the calendar year. Unused vacation can be paid out and/or up to 40 unused hours can be rolled over at year end.
* Paid Time Off (PTO): 72 Hours are available each year on January 1. In the first year of employment available hours are prorated based on your date of hire.

**The First of the Month after the Date of Hire**:

* Health Insurance. The premiums are a shared expense with 80% covered by Harvest Solar and 20% covered by the associate via a weekly payroll deduction. Premiums are based on level of coverage, (i.e., Associate only, Associate & Spouse, Associate & Child(ren), Family).
 + Option 1: Priority Health, HMO HSA 2000 Plan
 + Members must seek care from in-network providers.
 + HSA compatible health plan. An HSA is a tax-deductible savings account used in conjunction with the health plan. Contribution limits are determined by the IRS. Harvest Solar will make the following weekly deposit into your HSA account based on the coverage options: Associate: $10.64; Associate & Spouse: $27.25; Associate & Child(ren): $21.65; Family: $37.55
* Option 2: Priority Health, Traditional HMO 1000 Plan
 + Members must seek care from in-network providers.
 + Preventive care covered 100% when received in-network.
 + Not an HSA compatible health plan.
* Dental Insurance The premiums are a shared expense with 80% covered by Harvest Solar and 20% covered by the associate via a weekly payroll deduction.
* Vision Insurance: The premiums are a shared expense with 80% covered by Harvest Solar and 20% covered by the associate via a weekly payroll deduction.
* Group Life Insurance: $50,000.00 of group life insurance, with and Accident Death clause. Premiums are covered by Harvest Solar
* Group Short Term Disability: 60% of your earnings, with a $1,000.00 weekly maximum, are available for injury or illness after a seven-day waiting period. Premiums are covered by Harvest Solar.
* Voluntary Supplemental Programs: Accident, Critical illness, and Hospital Indemnity are available at the associate’s expense. Plans are organized through Allstate and premiums are paid through payroll deduction.

**The First of the Month After 90-Days of Employment:**

* Harvest Solar 401k Plan: Associates are auto enrolled at a 3% deferral rate. Once enrolled, the associate may make changes that include:
 + Increasing the Deferral Rate to the Applicable IRS Limits: A company match is available. When the associate defers 3%, Harvest Solar matches 3%. When the associate defers 4%, Harvest Solar matches 3.5%. When the associate defers 5%, Harvest Solar matches 4%.

records.description:
**Director of Quality Compliance** 
 **Southern Peaks, Canon City CO**
======================================================================

[Full-Time)

$75,000 To $90,000 Annually

DailyPay Available

**Looking for More Than Just a Job?**
-------------------------------------

At Abraxaswe believe every person deserves the opportunity to live a meaningful, fulfilling, and independent life.

We’re seeking compassionate, dedicated professionals who are looking for more than a paycheck. We’re looking for individuals who want to make a difference, build rewarding careers, and become part of a team committed to helping others succeed.

Whether you’re beginning your career, changing professions, or bringing years of experience, we provide the training, support, and opportunities needed to help you thrive.

**About Abraxas**
-----------------

For more than 50 years, Abraxas has been dedicated to improving lives through high-quality services and support.

Our employees play a vital role in helping individuals achieve greater independence, confidence, and success while promoting dignity, respect, inclusion, and personal choice.

Every day, our team members make a meaningful impact by supporting people in reaching their goals and living their best lives.

**Why Join Our Team?**
======================

**Competitive Pay & Benefits**
------------------------------

* Competitive Compensation
* DailyPay – Access Your Earned Wages Before Payday
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Programs
* Employee Referral Bonuses
* Company-Paid Training

**Career Growth & Development**
-------------------------------

* Paid Training Programs
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Certification Opportunities
* Leadership Development Programs
* Career Advancement Opportunities
* Opportunities Across Multiple Service Lines

**Meaningful Work That Matters**
--------------------------------

* Make a Difference Every Day
* Support Individuals and Families
* Build Meaningful Relationships
* Strengthen Communities
* Join a Mission-Driven Organization

**What You’ll Do**
==================

As a Director of Quality Compliance, you will:

Monitors compliance with applicable Colorado Department of Human Services (CDHS) Volume 7 residential licensing rules, including 12 CCR 2509-8, Section 7.714, as well as payer and Joint Commission requirements.

* Works with program leaders to draft corrective action plans for Director review and approval. Tracks deadlines, verifies completion, and escalates overdue or ineffective actions.
* Coordinates preparation for licensing inspections, payer reviews, and accreditation surveys. Organizes evidence and tracks follow-up requests.
* Tracks updates to Health First Colorado (Colorado Medicaid) and Regional Accountable Entity (RAE) requirements and works with program leaders to update procedures and audit tools.
* Conducts chart and program audits covering intake, assessments, treatment planning, service documentation, and discharge planning. Shares findings and conducts follow-up audits.
* Supervises assigned Quality and Compliance staff, coordinates audit assignments, and coaches staff on applying regulatory, payer, and accreditation standards.
* Maintains monitoring tools and trains program staff on policy changes, documentation expectations, and recurring audit findings.
* Analyzes audit results, incidents, grievances, clinical outcomes, and authorization and denial trends. Reports results to program leadership and the Director and tracks improvement actions.
* Partners with Clinical, Admissions, and Billing to monitor prior authorization, concurrent and continued-stay review, and documentation of medical necessity and level of care. Tracks denials and appeals.
* Drafts and updates procedures for Director review. Maintains current policy manuals and tracks required staff education.
* Prepares compliance reports and supporting records for leadership and board review.
* Coordinates documentation and follow-up for annual licensed independent practitioner peer review at Joint Commission accredited programs.
* Supports PREA training, audit preparation, and corrective action follow-up for assigned programs where applicable.
* Participates in quality and compliance committees and follows up on assigned actions.
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Who We’re Looking For**
=========================

You may be a great fit if you are:

✔ Compassionate

✔ Dependable

✔ Patient

✔ Team-Oriented

✔ Service-Focused

✔ Professional

✔ Positive

✔ Committed to Helping Others

**Qualifications**
==================

Required:

Bachelor's degree in social sciences, healthcare, behavioral health or related field and five years related experience OR Master’s degree and three years of experience.

* Knowledge of Colorado Volume 7 residential licensing requirements, Health First Colorado behavioral health managed care, and applicable accreditation standards is required.
* Experience with behavioral health utilization management, including authorization, medical necessity and continued-stay documentation, and payer audits. Experience in youth residential mental health or psychiatric residential treatment facilities (PRTFs) is preferred.
* Experience with Prison Rape Elimination Act (PREA) compliance, including staff training, audit preparation, and corrective action follow-up, is preferred.
* Ability to supervise and coach staff, assign work, and follow up on performance expectations.
* Ability to develop and teach methods for auditing, monitoring, and improving program operations.
* Ability to interpret and teach the application of regulations, payer requirements, accreditation standards, and contractual language.
* Knowledge of adolescent residential mental health treatment, including trauma-informed care, co-occurring conditions, and the needs of youth involved in child welfare or juvenile justice.
* Ability to develop and revise policies that meet licensing, payer, contractual, and accreditation requirements.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in written form, with a diverse group of people including regulatory agency representatives, employees, clients, governing body members, and the general public.
* Must be available for periodic travel, to include overnight stays.
* Must have a valid driver’s license.
* Ability to work with computers and the necessary software typically used by the department.

**Physical Requirements (If Applicable)**
=========================================

* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, and assist individuals as needed
* Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation

**Apply Today**
===============

Some jobs pay the bills. Some jobs build careers. This job changes lives.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your compassion, dedication, and hard work make a real difference every day, we encourage you to apply today.

**Join our team and become the reason someone has a better day.**

### **About Our Organization**

**Abraxas** is part of the Inperium family of companies.

Employment for this position is administered through Apis Services, Inc.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

Apis Services, Inc., Inperium Inc., and affiliates provide equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment in compliance with all federal and applicable state and local laws and regulations, including nondiscrimination in hiring and employment.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

This policy of nondiscrimination and equal employment opportunity extends to every phase and aspect of hiring and employment

records.title: Director of Quality, Regulatory & Improvement
records.description:
***Title:*** ***Director of Quality, Regulatory and Improvement***

**Job Summary:**
----------------

This senior leadership role leads the quality departments for all Deringer-Ney locations globally. The Director implements best practices and metrics to coordinate all teams under a unified Quality Management System and is responsible for ensuring that the company's products, services, and manufacturing processes comply with strict government laws, industry standards, and internal quality systems. The role plans, coordinates, and directs the activities of the quality assurance and compliance programs to ensure the production of consistent, reliable products that meet or exceed established standards, and leads the continuous improvement team to support, train, and execute the DNIOS system.

***Supervisory Responsibilities:****Yes*

**Duties/Responsibilities:**
----------------------------

* Manage all quality departments by formulating, developing, and overseeing global goals, objectives, policies, procedures, systems, and outcomes pertaining to quality controls, assessments, and audits.
* Quality Management Systems (QMS): Build, maintain, and continuously improve QMS frameworks (such as ISO 13485 and ISO 9001).
* Develop a high-performance team by acquiring, developing, training, coaching, cultivating, and managing talented Quality Control personnel.
* Maintain and improve the quality system through routine system audits and corrective actions, and ensure that corrective actions, whether internal or external, are handled in a timely manner.
* Risk & Lifecycle Management: Oversee design controls, validation packages, complaint handling, and post-market surveillance (such as Automotive Reporting).
* Manage and maintain quality inspection and product release programs for raw materials, work in process (WIP), and finished goods.
* Regulatory Compliance & Filings: Lead product submissions and act as the primary liaison during agency audits.
* Disseminate quality awareness, adherence, and developments to global stakeholders by scheduling and performing regional quality audits and by ensuring that ISO systems are managed and maintained.
* Serve as an active member of the DNI Leadership Team, sharing the function's progress toward its goals while setting, and driving toward, an aspirational vision for a best-in-class quality department.
* Create a Cost of Poor Quality metric for the organization and set specific goals to improve quality performance across the company.
* Lead the development of the Annual Strategic Planning (P.D.C.A.) Cycle to include the Improvement Process.
* Lead the organization in attaining key metrics based on Balanced Scorecard (BSC) Objectives. Understand the department's key performance indicators and leading and lagging indicators, and contribute to achieving these goals, both individually and as a team.
* With the CIP Team, perform systematic audits designed to confirm that process standards are being utilized and met (BSC One-Page Reports).
* Interact with and make recommendations and presentations to the Executive Leadership Group via standardized checks: weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end. Maintain the PDCA Cycle while focusing on BSC Objectives.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**
------------------------------

* Strong background in ISO 9000 system management, including training and auditing.
* Strong background in ISO 13485 system management and thorough knowledge of FDA requirements and other international standards that regulate the medical device industry.
* Knowledge of automated inspection equipment, including vision systems and coordinate measuring devices.
* Adept at delegating and managing multiple tasks with various levels of priority.
* Excellent communication skills; must be able to present ideas, results, and requirements effectively throughout the organization and to the customer on a timely basis.
* Expert skill set in applied statistics, reliability, design of experiments, MSA, GR&R, and project management.
* Fluency with various software packages commonly used in project management, database, SPC, word processing, and data acquisition.
* Analytical, problem-solving, project management, facilitation, and decision-making skills are essential.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, resolve conflict, and promote teamwork.
* Ability to see and hear the facts from several viewpoints while promoting success through interactive problem solving and teamwork.

**Experience & Education Requirements:**
----------------------------------------

* Technical degree (BS, BSE, or BSME) with a minimum of 10 years' experience in quality engineering or quality management.
* Strong preference for relevant industry experience in a metals or electrical connectors company or similar.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, or Regulatory Affairs within a regulated field such as medical devices, automotive, or defense.
* Preferred certifications: Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE).
* Demonstrated project management skills in the areas of process control, SPC, automotive PPAP submission, and statistical analysis.
* Lean Green Belt or Black Belt certification, Six Sigma, and DMAIC process experience.
* Actively continuing training through courses and seminars.

***Physical Requirements:***

records.title: Director, Quality Engineering
records.description:
HHAeXchange is the leading technology platform for home and community-based care. Founded in 2008, HHAeXchange was born out of an idea to create a fully comprehensive end-to-end homecare solution to help people who are aging or have disabilities thrive in their homes and communities. Our employees are passionate about transforming the healthcare space by building the only homecare ecosystem that fully connects patients, personal care providers, managed care organizations, and states.

The Director, Quality Engineering will lead the enterprise-wide quality strategy and Quality Assurance (QA) program across HHAeXchange. This role is responsible for standardizing testing processes and tools, driving test automation, and ensuring our products meet high standards for reliability, performance, security, and accessibility. The Director, Quality Engineering will oversee functional and non-functional testing practices, including accessibility (WCAG) and security-related validation, and will own processes that support customer User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates located in the EST or CST time zones within the US only.**

### **Essential Job Duties**

* **Enterprise Quality Leadership:** Develop, implement, and lead the overall quality strategy and QA operating model across the organization.
* **Standardize Testing Processes:** Define and enforce consistent testing approaches including test planning, test cases, regression strategy, and release readiness criteria.
* **Tooling Ownership:** Select, implement, and manage enterprise testing tools for test management, automation, performance, accessibility, and security validation.
* **Automation Strategy:** Drive increased automated test coverage across UI, API, mobile, and services, reducing reliance on manual regression testing.
* **Compliance, Accessibility & VPAT Reporting:**
 + Lead accessibility testing programs aligned to WCAG 2.1+
 + Oversee creation and maintenance of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) and Accessibility Conformance Reports
 + Partner with Product, Legal, and Compliance to respond to customer accessibility requirements and audits
* **Security & Compliance Testing Support:** Coordinate with Security teams on SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation, and remediation tracking.
* **Customer UAT Support:**
 + Define and support customer UAT strategies and environments
 + Provide test plans, data guidance, and defect triage support during customer acceptance testing cycles
 + Ensure feedback from UAT informs release decisions and product quality improvements
* **Quality Metrics & Reporting:** Establish KPIs to measure product quality, defect escape rate, automation coverage, UAT outcomes, and release readiness; communicate results to leadership.
* **Shift-Left Quality Practices:** Embed quality earlier in the development lifecycle through collaboration on requirements, acceptance criteria, and CI/CD integration.
* **Incident & Defect Management:** Oversee defect triage for high-priority production and pre-production issues and ensure timely resolution and root-cause prevention.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Security, and Compliance to ensure alignment of quality practices across releases.
* **Organizational Leadership**: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of QA engineers, SDETs, automation engineers, and accessibility/compliance testers.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify quality gaps and drive process improvements that improve product reliability, reduce rework, and increase delivery confidence.
* **Release Governance:** Participate in release readiness reviews and serve as a key stakeholder in go/no-go decisions.
* **Coding agent advocacy:** **Help onboard team members to AI development tools. Share techniques, prompt patterns, and review practices that make AI-augmented development effective and safe in a regulated environment.**

### **Other Job Duties**

* Other duties as assigned by supervisor or HHAeXchange leader.

### **Travel Requirements**

* Travel up to 10%, including overnight travel

### **Required Education, Experience, Certifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering within a software product company, with a focus on developing scalable, high-performance systems.
* 4+ years leading QA organizations or enterprise quality programs.
* Proven experience designing and implementing standardized QA processes and test automation strategies in SaaS environments.
* Hands-on experience implementing automated testing frameworks integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with accessibility testing and standards such as WCAG 2.1+ and authoring VPATs/ACRs.
* Experience supporting security testing practices such as vulnerability scanning, SAST/DAST, and penetration test remediation validation.
* Experience supporting or running customer UAT processes.
* Strong understanding of quality metrics (defect rates, coverage, MTTR, escape rate, etc.) and how to operationalize them.
* Background working in cloud-based architectures and microservices environments.
* Demonstrated success collaborating across engineering, product, and security teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing QA and automation teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical partners.
* **AI/ML fundamentals:** Familiarity with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and how generative AI can be applied in a product context. Direct project experience preferred.

The base salary range for this US-based, full-time, and exempt position is $175,000-195,000/yr, not including variable compensation. An employee’s exact starting salary will be based on various factors including but not limited to experience, education, training, merit, location, and the ability to exemplify the HHAeXchange core values.

This is a benefits-eligible position. HHAeXchange offers competitive health plans, paid time-off, company paid holidays, 401K retirement program with a Company elected match, including other company sponsored programs.

HHAeXchange is an equal-opportunity employer. The Company offers employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, citizenship, genetic information, hairstyles, or any other status protected by local or federal law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

records.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies' core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

The Director of Quality, Defense is responsible for overseeing all quality activities, personnel, systems, and performance associated with Defense programs across multiple Karman Space & Defense operating sites. This role provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure all Defense hardware, assemblies, and services meet or exceed contractual, regulatory, and customer requirements. 
 
This position will manage the Defense Quality Engineering organization, supports execution of Defense programs, and ensures consistent application of quality standards and tools across the sector. This leader works in close partnership with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align each site's AS9100 compliant QMS with the emerging enterprise quality architecture and to transition multiple Defense sites toward a unified enterprise certification. 
 
This role is critical in driving disciplined execution, continuous improvement, product integrity, and customer satisfaction within the Defense market segment.

Reports to Vice President, Defense. Functional Partnership with Enterprise Director of Quality (Karman Space & Defense). 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 

* Lead, develop, and manage the Quality Engineering team supporting all Defense programs and projects.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement across Defense Quality functions.
* Serve as the primary Defense quality leader to the VP of Defense and the Defense leadership team.
* Ensure the quality of all Defense hardware, assemblies, engineered systems, and services produced across multiple sites.
* Oversee program quality planning, including inspection strategies, qualification/verification plans, critical characteristics control, product safety considerations, and risk mitigation.
* Review and approve quality requirements for Defense proposals, contracts, and manufacturing plans.
* Drive effective root cause analysis, corrective action, and failure review processes for Defense programs.
* Ensure each Defense site maintains compliance to AS9100, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Provide direct guidance to site Quality Managers/Quality Engineers on QMS implementation, audit readiness, and procedural improvement.
* Support site internal audits, customer audits, DCMA oversight, and third‑party certification audits.
* Partner with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align Defense site QMS structures, documentation, and practices with the enterprise quality framework.
* Support the long-term strategy to transition multiple Defense AS9100 certificates into a unified enterprise certificate.
* Collaborate closely on enterprise initiatives such as configuration management improvements, risk management systems, document control harmonization, supplier quality strategies, and enterprise metrics.

 
**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** 

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or related technical field preferred
* 10 years of experience in aerospace/defense quality roles preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, and Defense customer quality standards.
* Quality Engineering experience with complex programs including design.

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS**

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, certain positions may require applicants to be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel 0-10% of the time.

Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

View our Privacy Policy

records.title: Head of Quality
records.description:
**About Bora:**

Bora Biologics is a global biologics CDMO delivering integrated development and GMP manufacturing solutions from First‑in‑Human through licensed commercial supply. While many CDMOs are structured primarily for early clinical programs, Bora Biologics is purpose‑built for commercialization. Our inspection‑proven, bi‑coastal U.S. manufacturing platform and integrated development center provide the infrastructure, regulatory discipline, and operational precision required for sustained global market supply.

**Summary**

Reporting to the VP, Regional Head of Quality, the BBUL Site Head of Quality is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing a comprehensive Quality Management strategy aligned with corporate policies, client expectations, and global regulatory requirements. This role ensures products from development through commercialization are safe, effective, and fully compliant with applicable CGMP/GxP standards. As a key member of the site leadership team, the Director/Sr. Director of Quality provides strategic and operational leadership for the Quality organization, which includes Quality Assurance and Quality Control. The role partners cross-functionally with all departments to foster a strong culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement while ensuring regulatory compliance and client satisfaction. The Director/Sr. Director also directs day-to-day quality operations, drives operational excellence and process optimization, supports execution of strategic and tactical initiatives, and ensures timely resolution of quality and compliance issues to maintain business performance and inspection readiness.

 

**Essential Functions**

*Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* P rovide strategic leadership and overall accountability for the site Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with global policies, procedures, CGMP/GxP standards, and applicable regulatory requirements across the U.S. and international markets including EU.
* Partner with the Site Leadership Team (SLT) to strengthen and sustain a proactive culture of quality, escalating significant compliance risks and driving timely, effective resolution of quality issues.
* Lead and oversee regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring inspection readiness, effective agency interactions, and timely, compliant responses to observations.
* Direct all core Quality functions, including batch record review, material and product disposition, deviations and change control, document control, QC, QA oversight of all GMP functions including validation, operations, and facility activities.
* Provide leadership to ensure uninterrupted support for successful product transfers through robust quality oversight and operational excellence.
* Serve as the senior Quality leader supporting development initiatives and phased clinical programs, ensuring appropriate compliance throughout product development activities.
* Lead the Quality organization in achieving operational and strategic objectives, including budget planning and management, workforce planning, project execution, and organizational effectiveness.
* Establish and monitor key quality metrics (e.g., deviations, CAPAs, change controls, product release) to foster accountability. Evaluate system effectiveness and drive corrective action.
* Oversee quality indicators and operational efficiencies, implementing action plans to mitigate risks and streamline quality processes.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing Quality organization that operates as a trusted, collaborative business partner, while driving talent development, succession planning, and employee growth.
* Establish clear, consistent, and effective communication across the Quality organization and with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, risks, and business objectives.
Perform additional responsibilities and strategic initiatives as assigned 

*The above statements are intended to describe the nature of work performed by those in this job and are not an exhaustive list of all duties. Nothing in this job description restricts managements right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time which reflects management’s assignment of essential functions.*

**Minimum Education, Experience and Skills**

Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related area of study

**Experience:**

* At minumum15 years of pharmaceutical industry experience with at least 10 years of Quality experience, both QC and QA in biopharma/biotech in a CGMP pharmaceutical manufacturing environment with early and late-stage products.
* 5+ years of senior leadership experience driving Quality strategy, compliance initiatives, continuous improvement and staff development.
* Extensive experience developing, implementing and improving quality systems directly related to biologics drug substance manufacturing CGMP
* Proven track record of successfully managing and leading regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation activities with global health authorities with demonstrated success in leading a company through cGMP pre-approval and post-approval inspections.
* Proven ability to build and sustain a transparent, collaborative, and quality-focused culture that promotes accountability, engagement, and operational performance.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing organizational change within complex regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to develop staff at all levels.
Experience with developing and managing budgets. 

**Skills and Abilities**

* Strong working knowledge of global regulatory requirements and quality standards, including US FDA, EMA, PIC/S, and ICH guidelines.
* Demonstrated success in leading organizations through sound decision-making, strategic problem-solving, and effective communication at all levels of the business.
* Prior experience within a CDMO environment is strongly preferred
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and communicate complex quality and compliance matters clearly and effectively.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and support teams through crisis management, organizational transformation, cultural change, and business growth initiatives.
* Highly adaptable and resilient, with the ability to perform effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure environments while maintaining focus on priorities and outcomes.
* Strong leadership capability with a demonstrated ability to empower teams, identify high-potential talent, and drive employee development and succession planning.
* Results-oriented leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skills focused on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Skilled at building trusted relationships and collaborating effectively with cross-functional peers, senior leadership, clients, and regulatory agencies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in biological or chemical sciences
* Experience with US FDA, China FDA, Health Canada, EMEA, PMDA, and ANVISA is preferred
* Knowledge of and experience with GLP and/or GCP regulatory inspections a plus
Strong operational excellence experience or qualification 

Base Salary Range 192000-270000

 
 

**Compensation and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ wellbeing, including:

* Competitive salary and performance-based incentives
* Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement savings plans with employer matching contributions
* Paid time off
* Professional development opportunities
* Employee wellness programs and resources
* Employee Assistance Program and Mental Health Resources

**Core Values**

*At Bora, our values guide everything we do — from how we solve challenges to how we support our people. We lead with a solutions-first mindset, strive to do the right thing, stay proactive, and above all, respect everyone.*

Bora Pharmaceuticals is committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees according to all applicable equal opportunity and affirmative action laws, directives and regulations of federal, state and local governing bodies and agencies. In keeping with this commitment, Bora Pharmaceuticals will recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles, without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex (including factors related to pregnancy or child birth), national origin, age, marital status, familial status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity status with regard to public assistance, employment status, local human rights commission activity, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, atypical hereditary cellular or blood trait, or any other protected category.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Plant Manager**

**Manufacturing Operations | Color Compounding and Synthetic Turf Yarn Extrusion**

Company

TenCate

 

Location

Dayton, Tennessee

 

Department

Manufacturing / Operations

 

Reports To

VP of Manufacturing

 

Position Type

Full-Time

**About Us**

TenCate brings together specialized businesses in synthetic turf manufacturing, sports surfacing, construction, and related services. Our operations combine manufacturing expertise, product innovation, and customer-focused execution to support high-performing athletic environments.

**Position Summary**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership and performance of the Dayton manufacturing facility, which includes color compounding and extrusion of synthetic turf yarn. This role has accountability for safe operations, product quality, production performance, cost control, staffing, maintenance coordination, continuous improvement, third-party yarn sales, and sourcing of raw materials.

The Plant Manager will provide strong day-to-day leadership while building the systems, accountability, and capabilities necessary to support future growth. The successful candidate will be a visible, hands-on leader who is comfortable working directly with production teams while also managing plant performance through data and clearly defined operating metrics.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Safety and Compliance**

* Maintain a strong safety culture with clear expectations and accountability at all levels of the plant.

* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety requirements and company standards.

* Drive identification and correction of unsafe conditions and operating practices.

**Manufacturing Operations**

* Lead daily operations across color compounding and turf-yarn extrusion.

* Ensure production schedules are achieved while maintaining safety and quality requirements.

* Optimize machine utilization, throughput, labor, and manufacturing efficiency.

* Identify and eliminate production bottlenecks, excessive downtime, scrap, and waste.

* Ensure effective shift-to-shift communication and production reporting.

* Coordinate production priorities with planning, supply chain, quality, maintenance, and other manufacturing locations.

**Quality**

* Ensure products consistently meet established specifications and customer requirements.

* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for quality issues, scrap, and customer complaints.

* Maintain strong process controls around color consistency, raw materials, extrusion conditions, and finished-yarn performance.

* Partner with Quality and Technical teams on process and product improvements.

**Cost and Productivity**

* Manage plant performance against budget and operating targets.

* Drive improvements in labor efficiency, material yield, waste, energy consumption, downtime, and overall manufacturing cost.

* Monitor plant KPIs and develop corrective actions when performance falls below target.

* Identify and execute continuous-improvement and cost-reduction opportunities.

**Commercial and Raw Material Sourcing**

* Manage third-party yarn sales, including customer coordination, pricing support, order execution, and alignment of external commitments with available plant capacity.

* Develop and maintain productive relationships with third-party yarn customers while ensuring service, quality, and profitability expectations are met.

* Lead sourcing and supplier coordination for key raw materials used in color compounding and turf-yarn extrusion.

* Partner with Supply Chain, Technical, Quality, and Finance to evaluate suppliers, material performance, cost, availability, and supply risk.

* Support negotiations, purchasing strategies, inventory planning, and contingency plans that ensure reliable and cost-effective raw material supply.

**People Leadership**

* Provide leadership and direction to supervisors, technical resources, and hourly manufacturing associates.

* Establish clear responsibilities, expectations, and accountability throughout the organization.

* Develop supervisors and future manufacturing leaders.

* Ensure appropriate staffing and training to meet production requirements.

* Create a culture of teamwork, urgency, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Maintenance and Reliability**

* Partner with maintenance to improve equipment reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.

* Establish appropriate preventive and predictive maintenance priorities.

* Support equipment upgrades, capital projects, and manufacturing process improvements.

* Ensure recurring equipment issues receive appropriate root-cause analysis and corrective action.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Use production data and structured problem-solving to drive measurable improvements.

* Establish standardized work and disciplined operating processes.

* Lead improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, output, yield, labor productivity, uptime, and cost.

* Support future capacity planning, equipment additions, and manufacturing expansion as required.

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant manufacturing leadership experience in a plant or production environment.

* Demonstrated experience leading hourly manufacturing teams and front-line supervisors.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing KPIs, including safety, quality, throughput, downtime, yield/scrap, labor efficiency, and cost.

* Demonstrated ability to drive operational improvement and hold teams accountable for results.

* Strong problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.

* Demonstrated commercial judgment and the ability to balance customer requirements, plant capacity, material availability, and profitability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field.

* Experience with plastic extrusion, polymer processing, synthetic fibers, masterbatch/color compounding, or similar continuous manufacturing processes.

* Lean manufacturing or continuous-improvement experience.

* Experience managing a multi-shift manufacturing operation.

* Familiarity with capital projects, process automation, and equipment reliability programs.

* Experience with third-party or business-to-business sales in a manufacturing environment.

* Experience sourcing polymers, additives, color concentrates, packaging, or other manufacturing raw materials.

**Key Measures of Success**

* Safety performance

* First-quality / right-first-time production

* Schedule attainment

* Pounds produced / throughput

* Scrap and waste percentage

* Labor efficiency

* Machine uptime / unplanned downtime

* Manufacturing cost per pound

* Customer complaints and internal quality issues

* Energy consumption per pound produced

* Employee training, development, and retention

* Third-party yarn sales revenue and profitability

* Third-party customer service and on-time delivery

* Raw material cost, availability, quality, and supplier performance

* Raw material inventory and supply continuity

**Work Environment**

This position requires regular presence in a manufacturing environment and the ability to work across shifts as business needs require. The Plant Manager must be able to communicate effectively with hourly associates, technical teams, support functions, and senior leadership.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

The company is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to characteristics protected by applicable law.

This description summarizes the general nature and level of work performed and is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities or qualifications. Duties may change based on business needs.

records.title: VP, Production - Soft Accessories
records.description:
About Us:

Centric Brands is a leading lifestyle brand collective that designs, sources, markets and sells high quality products in multiple segments, including women’s, men’s and kid’s apparel, accessories, entertainment and beauty. Centric Brands is focused on our customers and our brands that will drive the company’s future growth. We are defined by innovation as we seize new opportunities and thrive in an environment informed by creativity and thinking that is both analytical and outside the box. Centric Brands reflects a team built on respect, for others and for the hard work it takes to achieve our goals and build our bright future together.

**Production**

From sourcing raw materials to manufacturing, order placement, pricing and quality control and getting the finished product where it needs to be, our production team is responsible for ensuring we keep our standards high and our business profitable at every step of the journey. If you are a focused, results -driven, tenacious and highly flexible team player, we’ll give you every opportunity to build a rewarding career with one of the world’s foremost major lifestyle brand collectives.

Specific Responsibilities Would Include:

Centric Brands is looking for a dynamic, creative and resourceful Vice President of Production, Soft Accessories, to join its team. This individual must be a self-starter and collaborative leader who takes initiative, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is excited to accelerate transformation across Centric Brands. The Vice President of Production, Soft Accessories, oversees all facets of global development, manufacturing and supply chain operations for cold weather accessories, including scarves, gloves, hats, beanies and related knit accessories. This leader will identify and manage the appropriate vendors and factories, negotiate manufacturing orders, and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality, profitable goods.

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Strategy & Innovation**

 

* Partner with corporate resources to achieve global production efficiencies across divisions and groups
* Lead ongoing market and competitive research to identify innovations in leather, knitwear, yarns, fibers, fabrications, construction, trims and finishing techniques. Translate relevant developments into actionable recommendations for Merchandising and Design, and maintain a current archive of yarns, materials, hardware and production techniques.

**Operations and Results**

* Oversee and continuously evaluate the approved vendor matrix for cold weather accessories, with particular focus on factories with strong technical capabilities in knit scarves, gloves (knit & leather), hats, beanies and related accessories. Review costing, capacity, quality and production standards.
* Lead high-level negotiations on yarn, material, trim and finished-goods pricing to ensure profitability. Approve final buys; oversee production from development samples through final delivery; resolve vendor non-compliance, claims and chargebacks; and coordinate customs classification requirements with Imports.
* Partner with Merchandising, Design and Sales throughout product development to ensure accurate execution of cold weather accessories, including stitch, gauge, yarn, handfeel, fit, construction, color and finishing. Deliver agreed-upon margin goals and development-calendar milestones across the assortment.
* Review production standards and brand consistency across categories and vendors. Oversee quality-control initiatives, including testing and corrective action plans for yarn performance, pilling, shrinkage, colorfastness, seam strength, embellishments, trims and overall product durability.
* Lead high-level troubleshooting of quality and technical issues. Guide special product development and modifications to designs, materials, stitches and constructions while protecting the intended aesthetic, performance and financial goals.
* Oversee capacity planning and vendor performance by sourcing office, region, country and factory. Define accurate costing models; partner with Sales and Planning to project production needs; make yarn and raw-material commitments when appropriate; allocate production; and reserve factory capacity for seasonal peaks.
* any issues

**Customers & Relationships**

* Partner with customers, Sales, Merchandising and Operations, as well as vendors and factories to ensure adequate flow of goods relative to orders and anticipated demand criteria
* Oversee interoffice communication and follow-up with internal and external customers and contacts regarding production, including suppliers and vendors
* Delegate special projects as assigned
* Travel regularly to factories and international trade shows

**Leadership & Teams**

* Lead, train and motivate global team of full-time and part-time personnel as well as factory and independent agents; strategize staffing needs across categories and brands, where appropriate
* Contribute positively to team dynamic and manage up where necessary
* Attract, develop and retain talent; create appropriate succession plans
* Monitor and evaluate performance of individuals and team(s)

Our Best Fit Candidate Would Have:

* Superior organizational skills and excellent communication skills; team oriented
* Ability to multi-task and meet deadlines, highly detail oriented and meticulous
* Creativity, technical capability and sensibility for merchandising/design
* Required hands-on production and sourcing experience in cold weather accessories, including scarves, gloves (knit & leather), hats, beanies and related knit accessories.
* Bachelor’s Degree
* 10+ years’ experience in production and sourcing; significant relevant experience in category
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, Adobe products, SAP, CAD and Mac computers

Salary Range: $200,000 - $240,000

At Centric Brands, we believe our people are our greatest asset, and we seek to structure competitive compensation offers to ensure that we are able to attract and retain the best talent. Our job postings include an annual base salary range at the time of employment. The stated base salary range represents our good faith estimate as to what candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on several factors, including the selected candidate's educational and professional experience, industry knowledge, location, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the selection process. Base salary is a part of a total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, annual bonus and other Centric Brands sponsored benefit programs.

**Be part of our growing community by getting involved with groups, teams and initiatives like Be Green, Be Giving, and Be Celebrated.**

**Centric Brands is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

Please note that Centric Brands will only reach out to interview, make an offer of employment or conduct onboarding activities for candidates who have applied through our careers site. When interviewing for a position, the candidate experience will include live interaction, such as a video conference or telephone call, with a Recruiter and/or company employee(s). We will never ask for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process. Be aware of suspicious recruitment activity. If you think you are a victim of an employment scam, you may contact your local law enforcement agency and/or visit the Federal Trade Commission website here: https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams.

records.title: Plant Manager - Manufacturing Operations
records.description:
**Plant Manager – Manufacturing**

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced Plant Manager to lead an established, mid-size manufacturing operation in Holt, Michigan. This is an opportunity for a well-rounded manufacturing leader to take ownership of the facility's overall business performance, providing strategic direction and leadership while driving operational excellence, profitability, and continued growth.

Reporting to the VP of Operations, the Plant Manager will have full responsibility for the facility's operational and financial performance, including full P&L accountability. This individual will oversee all aspects of the business, lead and develop the management team, and ensure the facility consistently achieves its financial, operational, quality, safety, and customer objectives.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for a seasoned manufacturing leader who understands how to run a plant as a business. The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of operational expertise, financial acumen, and business leadership, with a proven ability to translate company objectives into measurable results.

This person will be comfortable leading through department managers, establishing accountability, making sound business decisions, and developing a culture of continuous improvement. Equally important is the ability to balance the bigger picture with an understanding of what is happening on the plant floor.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assume full ownership and accountability for the facility's overall performance, including P&L, profitability, operating costs, and financial results.
* Develop and execute annual operating plans, budgets, and business strategies aligned with company objectives.
* Monitor financial and operational performance, analyze results, identify areas of opportunity, and implement corrective actions as needed.
* Provide leadership and oversight across all plant functions, including production, quality, maintenance, materials, shipping, and safety.
* Lead, mentor, and develop the management team, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and performance standards.
* Provide direction and oversight to the Production Manager and other functional leaders, ensuring alignment across departments and consistent execution of business objectives.
* Drive improvements in productivity, labor efficiency, throughput, quality, on-time delivery, and overall operating costs.
* Identify and implement cost-reduction initiatives, process improvements, and operational efficiencies that positively impact the bottom line.
* Maintain strong customer relationships, ensuring customer requirements are met and issues are addressed promptly and effectively.
* Oversee workforce planning, staffing, employee development, and organizational effectiveness.
* Ensure a safe working environment and maintain compliance with applicable safety regulations, quality standards, and other requirements.
* Direct capital planning and investment decisions, evaluating equipment, technology, and facility improvements to support business needs and long-term growth.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators, using data and financial reporting to measure results and drive continuous improvement.
* Partner with senior leadership to communicate facility performance, address business challenges, and identify opportunities for growth and improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Progressive leadership experience in a manufacturing environment, with demonstrated success managing an entire plant or manufacturing operation.
* Previous full P&L responsibility, including budgeting, financial reporting, cost management, and profitability.
* Broad understanding of manufacturing operations, including production, quality, maintenance, materials management, and supporting functions.
* Proven ability to improve financial and operational performance through effective planning, execution, and accountability.
* Experience leading and developing department managers and supervisors, with the ability to build a strong, effective leadership team.
* Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to understand financial statements, evaluate operating costs, and make sound business decisions.
* Demonstrated success with continuous improvement, process optimization, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Strong customer-facing skills and the ability to develop and maintain productive business relationships.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
* A hands-on, approachable leadership style combined with the ability to think strategically and lead at the business level.

**The Opportunity**

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced manufacturing leader to take ownership of an established operation and make a meaningful impact on its overall performance and continued success. The right individual will have the opportunity to influence the business, develop a strong team, and drive improvements across all areas of the facility.

The company offers a competitive compensation package, bonus potential, and a comprehensive benefits program including health, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off.

This is an on-site leadership position in Holt, Michigan.

Thank you for considering this opportunity.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Experience:

* Plant management: 4 years (Preferred)
* P&L responsibility: 4 years (Preferred)
* composite, paint finish, or similar: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

records.description:
**Vice President of Operations – Appliance Segment**
----------------------------------------------------

**Company:** SSW Advanced Technologies, LLC 
**Location:** REMOTE, with regular travel to plants in the U.S., Canada and Mexico 
**Travel:** Approximately 30–50% 
**Employment type:** Full-time, exempt

### **About the Role**

SSW Advanced Technologies is a leading manufacturer of engineered components for major appliance OEMs. We’re looking for a **Vice President of Operations** to lead our Appliance Segment, a multi-plant operation that makes wire, glass and component products for some of the best-known names in home appliances.

You’ll be accountable for the safety, quality, delivery and financial performance of our appliance plants across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. That includes:

* San Luis Potosí, MX; Sweetwater, TN; Vincennes, IN; Midland, ON; Clinton, IA & Madison, TN

This is a hands-on executive role for a leader who can set the strategy, build strong plant teams and deliver results for demanding OEM customers.

### **What You’ll Do**

* **Own segment performance:** Drive end-to-end results across all appliance plants against targets for safety, quality, delivery, cost and EBITDA.
* **Set the operations strategy:** Develop and execute a multi-year plan that supports growth, margin expansion and footprint optimization across U.S., Canada and Mexico operations.
* **Lead the customer relationship on operations:** Serve as the senior operations contact for appliance OEM customers, and meet or exceed scorecard goals for quality (PPM), on-time delivery, responsiveness and cost.
* **Deliver launches and changeovers:** Partner with Engineering, Quality and Sales so that capacity, tooling, customer qualification and ramp-up are ready on schedule.
* **Match capacity to demand:** Align production plans with OEM schedules, including seasonal and promotional volume swings, build-ahead requirements and short-notice changes.
* **Partner on supply chain:** Work closely with Supply Chain leadership on commodity exposure, supplier performance, alternate sourcing, inventory, premium freight and cross-border logistics.
* **Drive productivity and cost reduction:** Deliver annual plans that offset customer price-downs and inflation through Lean, automation, scrap reduction and labor efficiency.
* **Manage the numbers:** Build and manage the segment operating budget, capital plan and staffing plan. Hold plant leaders accountable to budget, and lead weekly forecast and commitment reviews.
* **Champion safety and compliance:** Build a zero-harm safety culture and fully implement our integrated Quality, Safety and Environmental management system, 5S and EHS standards.
* **Develop leaders:** Lead, coach and develop Plant and General Managers and operations leaders, and build bench strength and succession for critical roles.
* **Standardize how we run:** Establish common best practices, KPIs and daily, weekly and monthly operating rhythms across all plants.
* **Lead change:** Guide restructuring, footprint and transfer-of-work initiatives, including workforce planning.

### **What You Bring**

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Business Administration or a related field
* 10+ years of progressive operations leadership in manufacturing, including multi-plant responsibility
* A proven record of delivering cost reduction, successful launches and EBITDA improvement
* Strong P&L, budgeting and capital planning skills
* Executive-level communication and decision-making
* Fluent English

**Preferred:**

* Experience supplying major appliance OEMs or other high-volume OEM customers
* Background in metal forming, wire, glass, coating/finishing or assembly operations
* Experience leading operations in Mexico and managing cross-border supply chains
* MBA or master’s degree
* Lean or Six Sigma certification
* Spanish fluency (strongly preferred)

### **Your Team**

* **Direct reports:** Plant Managers, Operations Managers and Maintenance Managers across the Appliance Segment
* **Dotted-line partners:** Segment Quality, Engineering and EHS leaders

### **Work Environment**

Office and manufacturing plant environments, with regular travel between U.S., Canadian and Mexican facilities and to customer sites.

### **Why SSW**

* Lead a growing, multi-national segment with real influence on strategy and results
* Work directly with senior leadership in a hands-on, fast-moving environment
* Competitive salary, annual bonus and comprehensive benefits

*SSW Advanced Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.*

records.title: VP, Global Operations
records.description:
**About Oshkosh AeroTech, an Oshkosh company**

**Oshkosh AeroTech is a leading provider of aviation ground support products, gate equipment and airport services to commercial airlines, airports, air-freight carriers, ground handling and military customers. Oshkosh AeroTech offers products that make a difference in people’s lives by supporting those in our communities who do some of the toughest work. They own many of the most trusted brands in the air transportation industry, including LEKTRO®, JetAire®, JetPower®, AmpTekÔ, Jetway®, and more.**

The Oshkosh AeroTech Vice President, Operations will lead operational strategy, execution, and continuous improvement across the Ground Support Equipment (GSE) and Jetway businesses. With dual reporting to the VP of Global Operations & Supply Chain at the Vocational segment and the President of Oshkosh AeroTech, this role is a key member of the Oshkosh AeroTech leadership team, responsible for driving a safety culture, operational efficiency, increasing capacity, manufacturing excellence, and overall business performance.

**YOUR IMPACT**

Safety & Operations Leadership

* Develop, implement, and sustain a world-class safety program that prioritizes team member well-being
* Drive a proactive safety culture by embedding safety into all operational activities, ensuring every team member understands and takes ownership of safety responsibilities.
* In collaboration with VP, Operations & Supply Chain at Vocational segment, develop and implement a comprehensive operations strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Establish KPIs to measure and drive operational performance, efficiency, and cost optimization.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives in production, workflow optimization, and resource allocation.
* Ensure world-class manufacturing capabilities, leveraging Lean, Six Sigma, and automation best practices.
* Develop and implement strategy to increase capacity across AeroTech manufacturing sites.
* Partner with Supply Chain organization to optimize supplier partnerships and inventory management.
* Drive cost reduction initiatives while maintaining high quality and regulatory compliance.

Quality & Compliance

* Ensure all operational processes comply with industry standards, safety regulations, and quality control frameworks.
* Implement best-in-class operational processes to reduce defects, improve reliability, and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Drive adherence to ISO and other relevant regulatory requirements.

Financial Management

* Manage budgets, operational expenditures, and capital investments to drive profitability.
* Conduct financial analyses to improve operational decision-making and efficiency.
* Optimize cost structures through strategic sourcing, automation, and process improvements.

Leadership & Talent Development

* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing operations team.
* Foster a culture of safety, continuous improvement, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning and development initiatives to align with business growth and expansion.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, Engineering, or related field.
* 12+ years of experience in operational leadership, with at least 3 years in a VP or Director-level role.
* Experienced people leader with cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong experience in multi-site manufacturing, supply chain management, and logistics.
* Proven track record in driving operational excellence, lean manufacturing, and six sigma methodologies.
* Strong financial acumen, data-driven decision-making, and process optimization skills.
* Lives the Oshkosh Core Values of We put people first, We do the right thing, We persevere, We are better together
* Demonstrates the Oshkosh Leadership Traits of Inspires Vision and Purpose, Drives Results, Customer Focus, Cultivates Innovation, Fosters Engagement, and Instills Trust

**STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master’s degree in business administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience working with government, military, or defense contracts.
* International or global business experience.
