**Company Description**

**About AbbVie**

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**

The Director, Factory of the Future, leads AbbVie’s global strategy, design standards, and delivery of next-generation factories and manufacturing operations that leverage Industry 4.0/5.0, robotics, automation, and AI. The Director owns the Factory of the Future vision and roadmap across biotechnology, aseptic manufacturing, packaging, medical device, and chemical production, and leads a team of senior engineers and technical leaders who develop reference designs, run pilots, and enable deployment into new facilities and major site transformations. This role partners with Operations leadership, Engineering, Quality, PDS&T, Supply Chain, BTS, and Security to ensure future factories are safe, compliant, flexible, and highly automated, and deliver measurable gains in quality, speed, and cost.

**Vision and Strategy**

* **Factory of the Future strategy:** Define and own the multi-year Factory of the Future vision, technology roadmap, and investment case, aligned to Operations, network, and enterprise AI and digital strategies.
* **Network and capital alignment:** Partner with Global Engineering, Manufacturing, and Finance to embed future-factory design principles and technology choices into the capital plan, site master plans, and new-facility business cases.

**Design and Technology Leadership**

* **Reference designs and standards:** Establish global reference designs, design standards, and technology platforms for aseptic and biologics manufacturing, packaging, device assembly, and chemical production, including modular, flexible, and continuous concepts.
* **Automation, robotics, and AI:** Direct the evaluation, piloting, and scale-up of robotics, autonomous material handling, vision inspection, digital twins, advanced process control, and AI-enabled operations, in partnership with BTS and Operations AI.
* **Technical governance:** Provide design authority and review for major capital projects; ensure cGMP, Annex 1, data integrity, device regulations, EHS, and OT/IT cybersecurity requirements are built in from concept stage.

**Delivery and Value**

* **Portfolio delivery:** Lead a portfolio of Factory of the Future pilots, proofs of concept, and project deployments, managing scope, schedule, budget, risk, and benefits.
* **Value tracking:** Define KPIs (e.g., OEE, right-first-time, labor productivity, cycle time, capex efficiency, sustainability) and report realized value to the Operations Leadership Team.

**Leadership and Ecosystem**

* **Team leadership:** Build, lead, and develop a global team of principal and senior principal engineers and technical specialists; create a pipeline of future-factory talent.
* **External engagement:** Develop strategic relationships with equipment OEMs, automation integrators, technology startups, academia, and industry bodies (e.g., ISPE) to benchmark and access emerging capabilities.
* **Executive communication:** Represent Factory of the Future in executive and enterprise forums, translating technical concepts into business outcomes.

 
**Qualifications** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Biomedical, Electrical, Automation, Industrial, or related) required; Master’s, PhD, or MBA preferred.
* Minimum of 18 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device manufacturing, engineering, or technology, including 8+ years leading teams and large capital or technology programs.
* Proven record of leading greenfield/brownfield facility design or major site transformations from concept through startup.
* Expertise in aseptic and sterile manufacturing and/or biologics; experience across packaging, device, or chemical production is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated leadership in deploying Industry 4.0/5.0 technologies (robotics, automation, MES/MOM, IIoT, digital twins, AI/ML) at scale in GMP environments.
* Strong command of cGMP, Annex 1, data integrity, computer system assurance, and OT/IT cybersecurity expectations.
* Ability to build business cases and manage multi-million-dollar budgets and portfolios.
* Executive presence and ability to influence senior leaders across a global matrix organization.
* Experience developing and leading high-performing technical teams, including senior technical talent.
* Professional certifications (PE, PMP, ISPE CPIP) and a record of external publications, patents, or industry leadership are a plus.

 
**Additional Information**

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law:

* The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.
* We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
* This job is eligible to participate in our long-term incentive programs.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

US & Puerto Rico only - to learn more, visit https://www.abbvie.com/join-us/equal-employment-opportunity-employer.html

US & Puerto Rico applicants seeking a reasonable accommodation, click here to learn more:

https://www.abbvie.com/join-us/reasonable-accommodations.html

records.title: Director of Manufacturing
records.description:
Director of Manufacturing

**POSITION SUMMARY**
====================

Weaver Popcorn is seeking an experienced manufacturing leader to direct the **Malden, Missouri** operation and strengthen safety, quality, service, cost performance, throughput, and associate development. The Director of Manufacturing provides strategic and hands-on leadership for plant operations, maintenance, sanitation, scheduling, grower partnership, and continuous improvement while ensuring reliable execution of annual operating priorities.

This leader will establish clear performance expectations, develop plant leadership and frontline capability, optimize equipment and labor effectiveness, and partner across Quality, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, and Continuous Improvement to deliver sustainable operational and financial results.

**HOW WILL YOU HELP US GROW?**
==============================

**Manufacturing & Operational Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Lead the Malden manufacturing operation with accountability for safety, quality, service, cost, throughput, schedule attainment, sanitation, labor effectiveness, and overall plant performance.
* Establish clear operational standards, performance goals, equipment expectations, and operating cost objectives aligned with the annual plan.
* Drive reliable production output and efficient growth by ensuring the right equipment, staffing, operating systems, and performance measures are in place.
* Lead regular operating reviews with plant leadership to evaluate productivity, downtime, quality, staffing, schedule attainment, and corrective actions.
* Ensure manufacturing systems, procedures, and policies are consistently deployed, understood, and followed across assigned operations.
* Align internal manufacturing capabilities with customer needs, production schedules, raw-material availability, and growth expectations.

**Safety, Quality & Food Manufacturing Compliance**
---------------------------------------------------

* Provide visible leadership for a safe workplace and hold leaders accountable for proactive hazard identification, corrective action, training, and compliance.
* Partner closely with Quality leadership to ensure compliance with food safety and quality requirements, including HACCP, GMPs, sanitation standards, product controls, and applicable regulatory and customer requirements.
* Support disciplined investigation and sustainable corrective action for safety events, quality deviations, operational failures, customer concerns, and recurring performance issues.
* Ensure plant practices support audit readiness, traceability, sanitation effectiveness, and consistent production of safe, conforming product.
* Reinforce the authority and responsibility to stop or correct work when safety, food safety, quality, or regulatory requirements are not being met.

**Continuous Improvement, Reliability & Capital**
-------------------------------------------------

* Deploy Lean manufacturing, Statistical Process Control, and structured problem-solving methods to improve throughput, yield, reliability, labor efficiency, and cost performance.
* Identify operational failures and constraints, establish root causes, implement corrective actions, and verify sustained effectiveness.
* Develop and maintain meaningful manufacturing KPIs and equipment-efficiency measures that support timely, fact-based decisions.
* Partner with Maintenance and plant leaders to improve equipment reliability, preventive maintenance effectiveness, space utilization, and production capacity.
* Jointly establish capital expenditure priorities and lead effective execution of approved capital and process-improvement projects.
* Challenge existing practices, standardize successful improvements, and build continuous-improvement capability throughout the operation.

**Grower, Supply Chain & Cross-Functional Partnership**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Collaborate with Field Operations to support grower relationships, contracted acreage plans, raw-material supply, and growth objectives.
* Partner with Supply Chain and plant scheduling teams to balance customer requirements, inventory, capacity, labor, and raw-material availability.
* Work with Finance and Information Technology to strengthen business processes, operating data, management reporting, budgeting, and decision-support tools.
* Contribute the manufacturing perspective to companywide initiatives led by Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Quality, and other functional leaders.
* Communicate operational risks, priorities, tradeoffs, and performance clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional partners.

**People Leadership & Talent Development**
------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop plant leaders and assigned functional leaders; establish clear goals, accountabilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Build a culture of excellence, ownership, accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement at every level of the operation.
* Develop internal talent, strengthen succession readiness, and partner with Human Resources to recruit and retain a capable workforce.
* Build associate competency through effective training, qualification, coaching, and skills-development programs.
* Use a visible, participative leadership style that communicates direction, listens for understanding, addresses conflict directly, and earns followership.

**WHAT DO YOU NEED TO HAVE?**
=============================

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Operations Management, or a related field.
* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least 10 years in a Plant Manager or comparable senior manufacturing leadership role; food or agricultural processing experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success applying Lean manufacturing, Statistical Process Control, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving methods to improve throughput, equipment efficiency, labor productivity, yield, and cost performance.
* Experience leading workplace safety, food manufacturing quality systems, sanitation, GMPs, HACCP-based programs, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
* Proven financial acumen, including budgeting, P&L accountability, capital prioritization, and analysis of manufacturing KPIs and cost drivers.
* Demonstrated success developing leaders, strengthening organizational capability, managing change, and building accountability in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
* Ability to travel regionally approximately 15% and remain available outside normal business hours when operational needs require support.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Leadership experience in popcorn, corn, grain, ingredient, food processing, or a related agricultural manufacturing environment.
* Experience leading capital projects, technical teams, maintenance-reliability programs, and high-engagement employee relations.
* Formal training or certification in Lean, Six Sigma, safety, continuous improvement, or project leadership.
* Experience partnering directly with growers or agricultural supply networks.

**WHERE & WHEN WILL YOU WORK?**
===============================

This role operates across office, agricultural, warehouse, and food manufacturing environments and requires regular presence in production areas. The typical schedule is Monday through Friday; however, the Director of Manufacturing must be available outside normal business hours, including occasional evenings or weekends, when safety, quality, customer, staffing, equipment, or other operational needs require support. Regional travel of approximately 15% is expected, with additional travel based on business needs.

**WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE?**
================================

* Strong, sustained performance in safety, quality, service, cost, throughput, schedule attainment, and customer satisfaction.
* Improved equipment reliability, operating efficiency, labor effectiveness, yield, and cost performance supported by clear KPIs.
* Consistent execution of manufacturing, sanitation, food safety, quality, and operating standards.
* Disciplined problem solving that reduces recurring failures and produces measurable, sustained improvement.
* A capable and accountable plant leadership team with clear goals, stronger bench strength, and active development plans.
* Effective partnership across Quality, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, and Continuous Improvement.
* Credible, visible leadership that builds ownership, engagement, and confidence throughout the Malden operation.

**HOW WILL WE HELP YOU GROW?**
==============================

* Competitive compensation.
* Three weeks of paid time off in the first year.
* 401(k) plan with a company match of 100% of employee deferrals up to 10%.
* Health, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance beginning the first day of the month following 30 days of employment.
* Education reimbursement of up to $15,000 per year.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
================================

Weaver Popcorn is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and associates. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

*The role responsibilities are many, various, and not limited to those written in this document.*

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Job Summary:**

This Operations Manager role is responsible for the operating profitability and performance of a world class GMP/GDP food facility and team. This role will execute day-to-day site operations to ensure short and long term strategies and tactics critical to operational success are met.

Job titles reporting to the Operations Manager: Shipping/Receiving Manager, Tooling Manager, A/B/C/D Shift Operations Supervisors and Industrial Engineering.

**Essential Functions:**

* Servant Leadership.
* Translates strategic plans to tactics effectively executing the business plans and growth projections. Directs and coordinates activities of the assigned manufacturing facility through Supervisors and Team Leads to meet or exceed customer's timeline, quality requirements and budgetary constraints.
* Development and communication of clear, concise and measurable SQDIC performance metrics through Tier Accountability to assure performance and bottom up communication. Promote safety and ensure teams compliance with all safety and environmental rules, policies and procedures.
* Implement and lead the Lean Culture within the plant to maximize employee contributions and drive improvements in product quality and process efficiency with continuous yield improvements
* Generate operating rhythm and drive communication and recognition at all levels across all shifts to be consistent with the business strategy
* Work with individuals at all levels of the organization to motivate for results
* Support development of team oriented approaches to problem solving and implement processes to enable
* Consistently seeking to establish a high performing team aligned with Solidify values.
* Serves as a leader in the facility for the safety program in order to promote safe and healthy work conditions and ensure compliance with safety/GMP and GDP regulations.
* Assist Senior Leadership in strategic planning such as establishing budgets, capital expenditures, business plans and expansion capabilities.

**Qualifications, Education, Skills, and/or Experience required:**

* Bachelor?s degree in Engineering or Related field with 10+ years in plant/operations management with at least 5 years in a plastics manufacturing environment.
* Plastics experience must include either injection molding or blow molding.
* Lean manufacturing experience

* Demonstrated experience driving Operational Excellence, Lean tools, best practices and continuous improvement
* Experience supporting a team in a 24/7 shop leadership position
* Knowledge of Epicor or similar ERP/MRP software (Epicor)
* Experience in technical training programs and development of technical employees
* Strong computer skills, to include Excel and Word
* Can drive continuous improvement and problem solving culture.
* Six Sigma Greenbelt certification (preferred), with solid statistical analysis and problem solving expertise.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Able to lift up to 40 pounds
* Standing, walking, bending, kneeling, lifting, pushing-pulling, and reaching

records.title: Plant Manager(Electronics Manufacturing)
records.description:
Plant Manager – Electronics Manufacturing

* **Electronics manufacturing experience**, including PCBA assembly and electronic product testing.

Key Responsibilities:

* Manage daily plant operations, including production, quality, and facilities.
* Lead production supervisors, quality teams, and maintenance personnel.
* Ensure production schedules, quality standards, and operational goals are met.
* Monitor production performance, labor efficiency, scrap, and manufacturing costs.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing, 5S, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Oversee quality control, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Support new product introductions and manufacturing process improvements.
* Maintain equipment, preventive maintenance programs, and workplace safety.
* Collaborate with engineering, planning, purchasing, and warehouse teams.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA and company safety standards.

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related field.
* **10+ years of manufacturing experience**, including **5+ years in plant management, production management, or operations leadership**.
* Strong experience managing manufacturing teams and daily production operations.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement.
* Experience with quality management, production KPIs, and cost reduction.
* Familiarity with ERP/MES systems.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

* **Electronics manufacturing experience**, including PCBA assembly and electronic product testing.
* Knowledge of IPC workmanship standards and ESD control.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality standards.
* Lean Six Sigma certification.
* Experience with Epicor ERP.
* Experience managing facility maintenance and equipment projects.

Benefits

* Health Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Career Growth Opportunities

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
Job ID: 530934

Ash Grove is a CRH company with a legacy dating back to 1882. We combine technical expertise, safety and customer-focused solutions to deliver reliable performance for our customers. We manufacture and supply high-performance, advanced cementitious materials for the most demanding construction and infrastructure needs. With more than 2,000 people across 60 locations in the United States and Canada, we support a wide range of applications, from major infrastructure projects to the development and refurbishment of residential and non-residential buildings that support everyday life, from highways and bridges to schools and commercial buildings.

To learn more about us go to www.ashgrove.com

 

**Job Summary**

The Plant Manager plans, coordinates, and supervises the production operations, hazardous waste fuel program, maintenance activities, quality and safety programs, and other related functions involved in plant operations. This position incorporates directives provided by corporate management into policies and procedures to maintain standards and schedules. The position exercises direct or indirect supervision over a large number of employees.

**Job Location**

 

* This role will work out of our plant in Midlothian, TX.

**Job Responsibilities**

 

* Promote and follow all plant safety guidelines.
* Conducts meetings with plant staff personnel to communicate, coordinate and discuss plant operations.
* Monitors, inspects, and reviews all plant activities.
* Ensures production schedule corresponds with sales forecasts.
* Assists in investigating customer and quality problems and concerns.
* Meets with government agencies and community groups concerning plant activities to ensure compliance with environmental regulations, policies, and standards.
* Prepares regular reports regarding plant production operations.
* Attends Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) training for waste-derived fuel activities.
* Promotes effective job performance through motivation, goals, and providing feedback.
* Promotes the safety program, compliance with safety standards, and participates in safety meetings.
* Establishes plant standards, short-term goals, and long-term strategic plans for production, maintenance, and improvements.
* Discusses new products, equipment, and ideas with staff and vendors.
* Analyzes plant costs and explore methods to improve productivity cost-effectively.
* Uses technology to develop a continuous improvement plan for the plant.
* Troubleshoots various problems and performance barriers.

**Job Requirements**

 

* Ability to read, write, and understand warning labels, instructions, signs, etc.
* Minimum 4 Year - Bachelors Degree in engineering, chemistry, natural sciences, business administration, or closely related field.
* Professional Engineer (PE) preferred
* Ability to develop and deliver effective presentations
* Ability to make decisions and solve problems with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to make sound independent judgments regularly
* Ability to effectively coach and deliver constructive feedback
* Ability to inspire and develop staff
* Proficient in effective negotiation skills in business and construction contracts
* Proficient in Microsoft Office365
* Ability to effectively use computers for general word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, e-mail, internet, and customized company programs.
* Ability to communicate the company's vision into actionable goals and contributions for plant personnel.
* Ability to network with industry professionals, consultants, vendors, suppliers, regulators, and the community.
* Knowledge of safety and environmental health regulations.
* Knowledge of cement chemistry, physical testing, and concrete performance.
* Knowledge of various systems for cement manufacturing (crushing, grinding, pyro processing, chemistry).
* Ability to work from general policies and procedures.
* Ability to refer to supervisor when clarification or interpretation of the organizational policy

**What CRH Offers You**

 

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

**About CRH**

CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.

If you’re up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest!

Ash Grove Cement, a CRH Company, is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.

EOE/Vet/Disability

CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

AI tools may be used in certain stages of the employment lifecycle, such as candidate review; however, all final employment decisions will be made by a person.

records.description:
Description:

**Job Title:** Operations Manager VitalShred

**Summary:** The Operations Manager’s responsibilities include but are not limited to implementing quality concepts throughout the operational processes to make continuous improvements; supervising records center/vault operations and delivery service; maintaining proper staffing; and reaching specific operational benchmarks.

**Essential functions:**

**Personnel Management** – Candidate will be responsible for, in part, hiring job candidates, training new/existing employees, enforcing company policies, and ensuring proper staffing.

**Quality tracking and improvement** – Candidate will work with Area Vice President and Director of Operations to improve the Company’s quality program

**Forecast Requirements** – Responsible for budget control, budget reporting, and taking corrective actions to maintain fiscal responsibility.

**Facilities/Equipment Maintenance** – Responsible for maintaining clean and efficient facilities including vehicle/equipment maintenance. Properly maintain and control the use of currently available rack space and evaluate the need for additional racks.

**Inventory Control** – Responsible for daily shred operations. Includes the auditing of daily paperwork, overseeing and reconciling daily shred functions of critical accounts. Conduct and supervise audits.

**Customer Service** – Responsible for providing courteous and attentive treatment of all customers’ needs by presenting a professional and positive image when interacting with customers in person and over the phone.

Requirements:

**Competencies:**

* Problem solving skills
* Experience in implementing quality concepts and practice in a service industry work environment
* Detail-oriented work style
* Organizational skills
* Willing to take responsibilities for daily operations even if personal sacrifices are required (have cell phone, able to cover any shift, and run emergencies)
* Willing and able to do physical work when necessary
* Commitment to being a key leader in disaster recovery environment and embracing the unique requirements of servicing both internal and external customers in such an environment

**Work environment:** Must be able to tolerate heat in the summer and cold in the winter.

**Physical demands:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand and walk. The employee is occasionally required to sit, climb/balance, stoop, kneel, or crouch. Must be able to reach, handle, carry, and lift between 10 lbs. and up to 50 lbs. While performing job duties, the employee is regularly required to talk, hear, read, and identify numbers for accurate order filling and receiving of material.

Education and eligibility requirements:

* Supervisory experience (3-5 years preferred)
* Valid driver’s license with clean MVR and clean background check
* High school diploma
* Forklift certification
* Must pass drug screen

**Other duties:** Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the applicant for this job. Activities, duties, and responsibilities

Notice Regarding the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Application Review

**Notice of AI Use in Job Application Review**

As part of our commitment in creating a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process we may use artificial intelligence (AI) to help our recruiting teams organize, summarize, and analyze information provided by candidates, including resumes, application responses, and other materials submitted during the application process. AI may be used to identify patterns, highlight relevant skills, and experience, and assist in comparing a candidate's qualifications with the requirement of a specific role. These tools are to improve efficiency and consistency while supporting more informed hiring decisions, which will ultimately be made by the hiring team.

**Quality tracking and improvement** – Candidate will work with Area Vice President and Director of Operations to improve the Company’s quality program
**Forecast Requirements** – Responsible for budget control, budget reporting, and taking corrective actions to maintain fiscal responsibility.

records.title: PVC Plant Manager - Dallas, TX
records.description:
**PVC Plant Manager - Dallas**

**Who we are:** 
Atkore is forging a future where our employees, customers, suppliers, shareholders, and communities are building better together – a future focused on serving the customer and powering and protecting the world.

With a global network of manufacturing and distribution facilities, Atkore is a leading provider of electrical, safety and infrastructure solutions.

 

**Who we are looking for:** 
We are currently looking for a Plant Manager to be based out of Dallas, TX. Reporting to the Vice President Operations, this person will be responsible for directing and managing plant operations for extrusion processing, maintenance, quality, and shipping/receiving. This position will coordinate plant activities through the planning with departmental managers to ensure the total manufacturing objectives are accomplished in a safe, timely and cost-effective manner.

The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or a minimum of 5 years plant/general management experience in a manufacturing environment or prior success as a Plant Manager or equivalent position at Atkore. Experience in lean manufacturing or business system-based company is a requirement.

**What you’ll do:**

* Provide direction, development and leadership for the facility and share best practices with other Plant Managers in running a safe, productive, cost-effective plant
* Establish and monitor overall plant performance for production and quality standards.
* Implement cost effective systems of control over capital, operating expenditures, manpower, wages and salaries.
* Participate in regular P&L reviews to ensure that budgets are met; develops and implements programs for optimal equipment utilization, equipment maintenance, and labor and material costs
* Control and minimize labor overtime, premium freight and repair expenses.
* Provide leadership and training to accomplish the company goals and objectives.
* Maintain existing plant facilities and equipment; replace or make adjustments to plant facilities and equipment when necessary.
* Manage capital asset maintenance.
* Implement and maintain preventative maintenance programs.
* Provide Safety and Health direction and support to personnel; ensures compliance with OSHA and environmental regulations.
* Incorporate shop floor organization and plant cleanliness among plant personnel.
* Demonstrate and promote our key Atkore values of Accountability Teamwork, Integrity, Respect, and Excellence, through actions and decisions.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or a minimum of 5 years plant/general management experience in a manufacturing environment or prior success as a Plant Manager or equivalent position at Atkore.
* Working knowledge of budgets and financial statements.
* Background with manufacturing methods, process improvement programs and procedures required.
* Advanced knowledge and experience of PVC Water pipe extrusion process preferred.
* Ability to implement Lean Manufacturing practices and drive continuous improvement.
* Six Sigma / Project Management experience.
* Excellent written and communications skills
* Computer literate. Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Excel and PowerPoint.
* Proven experience as a mentor/developmental manager for employees
* Available to occasionally work off shift to provide training and facilitate continuous improvement initiatives to all production shifts.
* Ability to work both as a member of a team, a team leader or as an individual contributor.
* Experience managing in a matrixed, mid-to-large organization
* All associates must embrace and foster and environment that supports our core values of Integrity, Respect, Excellence, Teamwork and Accountability.

 

**Within 3 months, you’ll:**

* Complete your Atkore Immersion and training requirements.
* Understand how your job will help deliver Atkore’s strategy.
* Gain an understanding of your team.
* Have developed relationships with the key stakeholders for this role.
* Be well-versed in Atkore’s Business System and the importance of your role to daily operations.

 

**Within 6 months, you’ll:**

* Maintain and be accountable for KPI visual reporting while actively participating in Lean Daily Management activities, including GEMBA walks.
* Create and modify standardized work and ensure consistent application by all team members.
* Hire talent into your organization, coach and manage performance of your team members and compensation management responsibilities for direct reports.
* Identify ways to strengthen the team’s commitment to Atkore’s core values of Accountability, Teamwork, Integrity, Respect and Excellence.

 

**Within 12 months, you’ll:**

* Be managing an efficient plant and team that delivers Atkore’s strategy.
* Have meaningful performance conversations with your direct reports.
* Be able to resolve any issues quickly and safely.

Atkore is a six-time Great Place to Work© certified company and a four-time Top Workplaces USA award winner! We’re committed to creating an engaged, aligned workforce driven by a collaborative culture. Our team **strives** for breakthrough results and **stays**focused on being standout leaders. We consistently live the Atkore mission, strategic priorities, and behaviors consistent with our core values.

**Join our team and align yourself with an industry leader!**

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay for this position is $128,080 - $176,110. Placement in the range depends on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, relevant experience, skills, seniority, performance, shift, travel requirements, and business or organizational needs and may change over time. Other compensation may include, but not limited to, overtime, shift differentials, bonuses, commissions, stock, and other incentives.

Benefits available include:

* Medical, vision, and dental insurance
* Life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance
* 401k
* Paid Time Off
* Paid holidays
* Any leave required under federal, state, or local law

Benefits are subject to vesting and eligibility requirements.

Applications are being accepted on an ongoing basis.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**About the role:**
-------------------

As Plant Manager for Eaton’s Critical Power Solutions operations in Santa Ana, California, you’ll lead two facilities, 500+ employees, and approximately $280M in annual sales, delivering engineered-to-order critical power solutions for some of the world’s fastest-growing customers.

This is a **high-visibility business and operations leadership role** with the opportunity to make a significant impact. You’ll co-own the P&L, lead the full plant organization, and help scale the operation as demand continues to grow.

**We’re looking for a leader who can:**

* Build and develop high-performing, cross-functional teams.
* Deliver consistently against safety, quality, delivery, inventory, cost, and financial commitments.
* Create a culture of structured problem solving using A3, 8D, PDCA, and root cause analysis.
* Lead through growth, complexity, and change while maintaining strong operational discipline.
* Make sound financial decisions around cost, budgets, capital, capacity, and profitability.
* Move comfortably between the manufacturing floor, customer conversations, and senior leadership discussions.

**What you will do:**
---------------------

**Lead people and culture** 

* Build a safety-first culture where every employee owns EHS, and keep our safety management systems strong through active, visible leadership.
* Be a visible leader on every shift: communicate openly, spend real time on the floor, and build an inclusive team where people want to stay and grow.
* Model Eaton's values and Code of Ethics in how results get delivered, every day.

**Run a high-performing operation** 

* Co-own the site P&L and scorecard (safety, quality, delivery, inventory, cost, productivity and engagement), set stretch goals and close gaps quickly.
* Turn the division strategy and annual profit plan into clear short- and long-term site plans and run a disciplined daily management rhythm to deliver them.
* Lead demand, capacity and inventory planning (our Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning process) so we keep our commitments to customers and to the business.

**Put customers first** 

* Protect on-time delivery and shorten engineered-to-order and configure-to-order lead times so we win new business and grow with our customers.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Project Management and Supply Chain to deliver end-to-end quality and customer satisfaction.

**Improve continuously** 

* Use the Eaton Business System and our continuous improvement tools to make lasting gains in safety, quality and productivity.
* Develop lean experts and problem-solvers on every shift, coach leaders to teach problem solving, and recognize teams that improve their own work.

**Grow the site** 

* Lead capacity expansion and footprint plans, including capital projects, new lines and cell layouts, automation and new product launches with Engineering.
* Represent Eaton in the Santa Ana community and build strong relationships with local stakeholders.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Basic qualifications** 

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, industrial operations, or similar fields.
* Minimum 7 years of experience with progressive levels of accountability and responsibility in Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, operational excellence (OPEX) and/or related support functions in a manufacturing environment.

 
**Preferred qualifications** 

* Master's in business administration (MBA) or other master's degree from an accredited institution.
* Lean and/or Six Sigma certification (Green Belt, Black Belt or Lean Tool Expert), with a track record of deploying a continuous improvement system.

• Strong understanding of Engineered to Order (ETO) and Configure to Order (CTO) business • Strong MRP / ERP platform knowledge, such as SAP or Oracle. 

* Bilingual (English and Spanish).

**Additional Information:**
---------------------------

* This role will be based at our manufacturing plant in Santa Ana, California.
* Relocation will be offered for this position.
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment, immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.
* Travel required up to 25% (domestic).

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

At Eaton, we strive to provide compensation and benefits that attract, engage, and retain the best talent. This includes competitive pay and a variety of benefit programs for eligible employees. The expected annual salary range for this role is $190000 - $278000 a year. This role is also eligible for a variable incentive program. *Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.*

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.

You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.

To request a disability-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1-800-836-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number.

We know that good benefit programs are important to employees and their families. Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. Click here for more detail: Eaton Benefits Overview. Please note that specific programs and options available to an employee may depend on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

**PLANT MANAGER**

Hussey Copper | A Pantheon Electric Company

Location: Leetsdale, PA 
Department: Operations 
Reports To: Vice President, Operations 
Employment Type: Full-Time 
Work Arrangement: On-Site 
FLSA Status: Exempt

**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**

Lead Operations. Drive Performance. Build the Future of Manufacturing.

At Hussey Copper, operational excellence begins with strong leadership, a commitment to safety, and a culture of continuous improvement.

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Plant Manager to lead operations at our Leetsdale, Pennsylvania manufacturing facility. This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for an experienced manufacturing professional who thrives in a fast-paced industrial environment and is passionate about driving performance, developing people, and delivering sustainable business results.

As Plant Manager, you will oversee the facility's manufacturing operations, including production, safety, quality, cost management, workforce development, and operational efficiency. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional partners to execute operational strategies, strengthen manufacturing capabilities, and drive continuous improvement across the organization.

We are looking for more than someone who can manage production. We are looking for a leader who can inspire teams, elevate performance, and build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and operational excellence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Operational Leadership and Manufacturing Excellence

* Provide strategic and operational leadership for all manufacturing activities, ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective production operations.
* Direct daily operations across manufacturing processes, including casting, rolling, slitting, and annealing.
* Develop and execute operational plans aligned with production schedules, customer requirements, financial objectives, and business priorities.
* Establish clear performance expectations and maintain accountability for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including throughput, scrap, downtime, production efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Analyze operational performance and implement corrective actions to improve manufacturing effectiveness.
* Partner with Planning, Maintenance, Logistics, and other departments to optimize production schedules, equipment availability, and workflow.
* Identify and address operational challenges while maintaining a strong focus on continuous improvement and operational consistency.

Safety, Quality, and Environmental Compliance

* Champion a proactive safety culture that prioritizes employee well-being, hazard prevention, and operational accountability.
* Establish and reinforce safety standards, ensuring consistent compliance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Partner with safety and environmental teams to identify risks, implement corrective actions, and strengthen workplace safety practices.
* Promote high standards of product quality, process reliability, and operational consistency.
* Support environmental management initiatives, including regulatory compliance, audits, annual reviews, and continuous improvement efforts.
* Ensure manufacturing practices align with organizational safety, environmental, and sustainability objectives.

People Leadership and Employee Engagement

* Lead, coach, and develop managers, supervisors, and production teams to achieve operational and organizational objectives.
* Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, employee engagement, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Establish clear expectations, provide ongoing coaching, conduct performance evaluations, and recognize individual and team accomplishments.
* Strengthen leadership capabilities through mentoring, performance development, and succession planning.
* Foster an inclusive and respectful work environment where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to contribute.
* Partner with Human Resources to support workforce planning, employee relations, performance management, and organizational effectiveness.
* Maintain productive relationships with union leadership and ensure adherence to applicable collective bargaining agreements.
* Promote open communication and collaboration across all organizational levels.

Continuous Improvement and Operational Transformation

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen productivity, operational efficiency, and manufacturing performance.
* Apply Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured problem-solving methodologies to eliminate waste and improve processes.
* Evaluate production workflows and operating practices to identify opportunities for increased efficiency, reduced costs, and improved quality.
* Utilize performance data and operational metrics to identify trends, address root causes, and implement sustainable improvements.
* Encourage innovation and employee participation in developing solutions to manufacturing challenges.
* Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to improve equipment effectiveness, production flow, resource utilization, and overall operational performance.
* Drive initiatives that support operational consistency, accountability, and long-term business objectives.

Financial Management and Strategic Planning

* Manage plant operating budgets, ensuring effective cost control, financial accountability, and resource optimization.
* Analyze financial and operational performance to identify opportunities for increased productivity and improved cost efficiency.
* Partner with senior leadership to develop and execute operational strategies aligned with organizational goals.
* Participate in capital expenditure planning, equipment upgrades, facility improvements, and expansion initiatives.
* Evaluate manufacturing performance and investment opportunities to support informed business decisions.
* Collaborate with Finance, Human Resources, Planning, and Logistics to align staffing, resources, and operational priorities.
* Translate business strategies into actionable manufacturing objectives with measurable performance expectations.
* Support long-term business growth and market competitiveness through disciplined operational execution.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Management, Operations Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in metals manufacturing.
* At least 5 years of experience in plant management or operations management leadership.
* Demonstrated success leading complex manufacturing operations and achieving measurable results.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, production management, operational efficiency, and performance improvement.
* Proven ability to lead, develop, and motivate managers, supervisors, and production employees.
* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience managing operating budgets, interpreting financial data, and making data-driven decisions.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to establish priorities, manage competing demands, and deliver results in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and comparable business applications.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in copper manufacturing, metals processing, or related heavy industrial environments.
* Knowledge of casting, rolling, slitting, annealing, or similar manufacturing processes.
* Leadership experience within a unionized manufacturing environment.
* Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other structured continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience with capital projects, equipment modernization, or manufacturing process improvements.
* Strong understanding of industrial safety, environmental compliance, and quality management practices.
* Demonstrated success leading organizational change, improving employee engagement, and developing high-performing teams.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

Success in this position requires a leader who can balance operational performance with people development, safety, and long-term strategic objectives.

The successful Plant Manager will:

* Establish a strong culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Deliver measurable improvements in productivity, quality, cost management, and operational efficiency.
* Develop strong supervisors and management teams capable of driving consistent performance.
* Strengthen communication and collaboration across production teams, support functions, and union leadership.
* Build an engaged and accountable workforce focused on achieving shared objectives.
* Identify and implement process improvements that support sustainable operational results.
* Align daily manufacturing execution with broader organizational goals and business priorities.

THE LEADER WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and hands-on leader who understands that exceptional manufacturing performance requires both operational discipline and strong people leadership.

You are comfortable walking the production floor, coaching a supervisor, reviewing operational metrics, and collaborating with executive leadership.

You bring a solutions-oriented mindset, strong decision-making capabilities, and the ability to navigate complex operational challenges while maintaining accountability for results.

Most importantly, you understand that sustainable success comes from developing people, improving processes, and building a workplace where teams are empowered to perform at their best.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

This position is based on-site at our Leetsdale, Pennsylvania manufacturing facility.

The work environment includes exposure to moving mechanical equipment, varying temperatures, elevated noise levels, and active industrial operations.

The Plant Manager is expected to maintain a visible leadership presence throughout the facility while following established safety practices and operational requirements.

**ENVIRONMENTAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

At Hussey Copper, environmental stewardship is a shared responsibility and an essential part of our commitment to safe, responsible, and sustainable manufacturing.

Libertas Copper, LLC, doing business as Hussey Copper, is committed to protecting the environment and promoting the safety and well-being of individuals both inside and outside the workplace. We demonstrate this commitment through environmental sustainability, responsible operational practices, and compliance with applicable local, state, and federal environmental regulations.

As Plant Manager, you will play a critical leadership role in advancing these commitments by:

* Promoting environmental awareness and accountability across all levels of plant operations.
* Ensuring manufacturing activities comply with applicable environmental regulations, company policies, and established environmental management standards.
* Participating in the Environmental Management Systems Team, including environmental policy development, annual reviews, audits, and performance monitoring.
* Supporting initiatives that reduce waste, improve resource efficiency, and minimize the environmental impact of manufacturing operations.
* Monitoring environmental performance indicators and implementing corrective actions when necessary.
* Partnering with cross-functional teams to strengthen environmental compliance, sustainability initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts.
* Reinforcing employee awareness and understanding of environmental responsibilities through effective communication, leadership, and accountability.

All employees are expected to demonstrate a commitment to environmental responsibility and actively support the company's efforts to maintain a safe, compliant, and environmentally responsible workplace.

**JOIN OUR TEAM**

At Hussey Copper, we recognize that strong operations begin with strong leaders.

As Plant Manager, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on manufacturing performance, employee development, operational efficiency, and the continued success of our organization.

If you are an accomplished manufacturing leader who is passionate about developing people, driving operational excellence, and delivering measurable results, we encourage you to apply.

Take the next step in your leadership career with Hussey Copper, a Pantheon Electric company.

#ZR

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

records.description:
POSITION TITLE: Plant Manager 
CLASSIFICATION: Exempt 
REPORTS TO: Plant Manager I 
SUPERVISES: Yes

POSITION PURPOSE: 
Responsible for overseeing and supervising the manufacturing and distribution departments by establishing, monitoring and enforcing policies and procedures to ensure that departments run smoothly and are aligned to quality standards. Creates and executes on strategies and policies for company growth. 
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND BASIC DUTIES: 

* Oversee and supervise the Manufacturing and Distribution departments.
* Provide for the timely manufacture and distribution of product against customer orders.
* Anticipates and tracks operational and tactical risks and providing strategic solutions.
* Plays a significant role in long-term planning, project status reporting, and implementing change control processes.
* Maintain average workdays to manufacture and ship all published catalog items.
* Maintain average workdays to manufacture and ship all custom manufactured items (RCC label)
* Provide monthly responses to budget variance.
* Provide for utilization planning by weekly reporting of the average Work-in-Process.
* Perform physical inventories of raw materials, packaging components, and finished goods.
* Provide for an appropriate balance of inventory to meet performance and financial objectives.
* Implement plant safety programs and ensure compliance with GMP.
* Confirm that appropriate work instructions are developed and maintained and followed throughout the business.
* Ensure that all ISO quality systems are followed.
* Provide compliance to ISO quality systems (i.e. Corrective Action)
* Oversee facilities and grounds maintenance.
* Oversees and reports weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual metrics.
* Identifies trends and assess opportunities to improve processes and execution.
* Completes reasonability testing and information validation prior to circulating findings and recommendations to key stakeholders.
* Solicits and responds to feedback while gaining commitment and support.
* Stays up to date on industry regulations, trends, and technology.
* Manage and supervise employees, resolve problems, and make recommendations for staffing and interviewing candidates for employment.
* Responsible for annual personnel reviews.
* Champions Functional Training Document (FTD) program through employee learning and development initiatives; standards of excellence & leader/employee accountability.
* Other Duties as assigned.
* Commitment to the organizations values; High Standards, Bias for Action, Teamwork, Customer

Obsession, Trust, Accountability, Innovation and Growth & Learning. 
Items covered in this job description are not all-inclusive of the expectations to perform this job 
satisfactorily. There may be times where management may require that you perform task not listed in this 
job description.

REQUIRED SKILLS: 

* Addressing operational concerns and issues, monitoring overall customer satisfaction.
* Developing and implementing operational procedures and policies.
* Analyzing training needs/requirements.
* Excellent interpersonal communication and organizing skills to coordinate project activities.
* Ability to communicate with others effectively.
* Ability to conduct research for special projects, respond timely inquiries, and present written/ oral briefings.
* Ability to work with details and time-sensitive issues.
* Good decision-making skills and response to high-pressure situations.
* Managing processes, developing standard.
* Tracking budget expenses, financial skills.
* Performance management.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: 

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry or Engineering-related discipline or a business-related area or equivalent work experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum of eight (8) years manufacturing management experience supervising manufacturing employees.
* Minimum of two (2) years of recent overall project management experience.
* Knowledge of HazMat, ISO, Distribution and safety programs.
* Experience with Microsoft Office, including advanced Excel skills with the ability to manipulate spreadsheets, create pivot tables and summarize data from multiple sources
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to work independently and with the team with strong follow through
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Accuracy and attention to detail
* A Project Management Professional (PMP) certified by the Project Management Institute (PMI) can be used in lieu of the educational requirements

WORK ENVIRONMENT: 
The physical environment may require the employee to work both inside and outside in heat/cold, wet/humid, and dry/arid conditions. This position may be working in the warehouse under various indoor environmental conditions, including supplemental heating in the winter months and without air-conditioning in the summer months. May be requested to work overtime and weekends. The position may occasionally be exposed to ruptured, leaking packages, some of which may contain Hazardous Materials. Where appropriate, proper safety equipment should be utilized and/or appropriate personnel notified. Frequently required to use personal protective equipment to prevent exposure to hazardous materials and chemicals. This job may require lifting of up to 50 pounds occasionally. 
INTENT AND FUNCTION OF JOB DESCRIPTIONS 
All descriptions have been reviewed to ensure that only essential functions and basic duties have been included. Peripheral tasks, only incidentally related to each position, have been excluded. 
Items covered in this job description are not all-inclusive of the expectations to perform this job 
satisfactorily. There may be times where management may require that you perform task not listed in this 
job description. 
Requirements, skills, and abilities included have been determined to be the minimal standards required to successfully perform the positions. In no instance, however, should the duties, responsibilities, and requirements delineated be interpreted as all-inclusive. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate. 
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, it is possible that requirements may be modified to reasonably accommodate disabled individuals. However, no accommodations will be made which may pose serious health or safety risks to the employee or others or which impose undue hardships on the organization. 
Job descriptions are not intended as and do not create employment contracts. The organization maintains its status as an at-will employer. Employees can be terminated for any reason not prohibited by law.

records.description:
**PLANT OPERATIONS CAREERS**

Plant Manager

Lead a healthcare laundry plant.

**Where** [City, ST]

**Reports to** General Manager / Regional Vice President

As Plant Manager, you'll lead the full plant (production, maintenance, quality, and logistics) with accountability for safety, budget, and the healthcare customers who depend on clean, safe linen every day.

Why you'll like it here

**Own the plant**

Daily operations, people, budget, and results.

**Lean in action**

Drive improvement with Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma.

**Lead leaders**

Develop supervisors, maintenance staff, and production Associates.

**Healthcare standards**

Run an operation held to OSHA and HLAC requirements.

What you'll own

* Lead and manage the Safety & Health Program within the production environment.
* Lead, motivate, and develop a team of supervisors, maintenance staff, and production associates.
* Oversee daily plant operations, including production scheduling, labor forecasting, staffing, and workflow optimization.
* Drive process improvements using Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Manage plant budget, including labor, maintenance, and operational expenses.
* Oversee inventory management to ensure consistent material supply and stock levels.

What you need

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, or Business Administration required.
* 5–7 years of leadership experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Strong end-to-end understanding of plant operations, including safety, quality, maintenance, and compliance.
* Proven experience managing P&L, budgeting, payroll, and cost controls.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and strategic thinking skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and ERP systems.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.

**Physical requirements**

* Ability to stand, walk, and move throughout a manufacturing facility for extended periods.
* Ability to occasionally lift up-to fifty (50) pounds.
* Comfortable working in a plant/production environment.
* Ability to push and pull carts of linen regularly.
* Ability to use required personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, hearing protection, and work boots.

**Bonus points**

* Experience with Lean Manufacturing and/or Six Sigma methodologies preferred.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification.
* Willing to relocate- GOE flexibility.
* Prior military leadership experience (e.g., Sergeant or above) a plus.
* Familiarity with ISO 14001 / ISO 9001 and GMP standards.
* Experience with manufacturing systems and reporting tools

**We'll teach you:** Our plant network, operating standards, and the support of a national organization.

How we work

Every ImageFIRST Associate lives our four Core Values. These are our required competencies.

**Be Respectful**

Value all we come in contact with.

**Be Remarkable**

Create a positive moment with every interaction.

**Be Safe**

Keep ourselves and those around us safe.

**Be Honest**

Be guided by truthfulness in all we do.

Great work gets noticed

**Everyday recognition**

Coworkers nominate each other for going above and beyond, and those nominations go up in the office for everyone to see.

**All Stars & Council of Excellence**

Each year, Associates who live our values are nominated as All-Stars and earn a certificate and a cash award. Top winners join the Council of Excellence with an additional reward.

Benefits

Weekly pay

Medical, Dental, Vision

Pet, Legal, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance

401(k) with company match

Paid Time Off package

Paid Parental Leave

Tuition Reimbursement

Referral Program

Great company culture

Collaborative team environment

 

**MILITARY & VETERANS**

Served? Your skills fit here.

Officers and senior NCOs who led maintenance, logistics, or production operations: command a plant. Whether you're transitioning out, serving in the Guard or Reserve, or a veteran, we want to hear from you.

* Leading a unit leading supervisors, maintenance, and production
* Readiness and inspections safety, quality, and compliance
* Resource stewardship plant budget and cost control

Guard and Reserve members: we support your service commitments. Tell us your branch and specialty when you apply.

 

Who we are

ImageFIRST is the nation's largest medical-focused linen and laundry provider, serving health systems, hospitals, and outpatient facilities since 1967. We run more HLAC-accredited facilities than anyone else, and 97% of our customers stay with us.

Our mission: improving the lives of our associates, our customers, and the patients they serve.

**If you're ready to own a plant's results, apply today.**

 

**Equal Opportunity Employer / Drug-Free Workplace**

We maintain a drug-free workplace in compliance with state and federal law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are fueled by the talent, passion, and diversity of our associates.

records.description:
### **Summary**

The Production Manager oversees the operations of the entire production facility (excluding purchasing, personnel, and non-production functions), with a focus on the Converting department. This role ensures adherence to company policies and procedures while driving optimal operational performance. The manager directly supervises Converting employees and supervisors.

**Perks of Pratt:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision Plans
* Short Term/Long Term Disability
* Supplemental Life Insurance Plans
* Child Bearing/Parental Leave
* 401K Plan with Company Match
* Paid Holidays/Paid Vacation
* Uniforms/Safety Shoes/Prescription Safety Glasses
* Healthy Lifestyles Program/ Virgin Pulse Fitness Tracker
* $500.0/Year Gym Membership Reimbursement100% Tuition Reimbursement/Assistance Program
* Income Protection Plans
* Legal & Travel Assistance Plans
* EAP/Home Auto Insurance Plans
* Wireless/Auto/Computer Discount Plans

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Production & Operations**

* Provide full production support, with a strong emphasis on converting machine performance.
* Maximize productivity and minimize downtime through effective resource management.
* Coordinate with Maintenance on PMs, MVP, and machine uptime goals.
* Oversee converting production, including equipment installation and major repairs.
* Support cost-reduction strategies and drive productivity improvements.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies, safety protocols, and quality standards.

#### **Quality & Safety**

* Ensure plant focus on quality processes and tools for each converting machine.
* Maintain plant housekeeping standards and ensure machine cleaning programs are current.
* Drive safety initiatives and uphold OSHA, EPA, and company regulations.
* Oversee all audit protocols (third-party, customer, and internal).

#### **Leadership & Supervision**

* Directly supervise Converting employees and supervisors.
* Set and communicate quality, efficiency, and production standards.
* Provide training, coaching, conflict resolution, performance evaluations, and disciplinary action as needed.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, teamwork, and high morale.

#### **Administrative & Strategic Support**

* Evaluate new methods, machinery, and safety programs; contribute to planning, budgeting, and purchasing.
* Maintain optimal staffing levels daily.
* Communicate issues to the General Manager in a timely manner.
* Remain on-call and available after hours to address urgent production issues.
* Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

### **Qualifications**

#### **Required**

* High school diploma or GED
* 10 years of experience in corrugated manufacturing
* 5 years of proven management experience in a production environment

#### **Preferred**

* College degree
* Experience with Ward Servo Pro Die Cutters, Bobst 8.2, and Gopfert Die-Cutters
* 5+ years in converting manufacturing operations
* 2+ years in a supervisory role
* Proficiency in Lean/5S, OSHA, EPA regulations
* Mechanically inclined with strong troubleshooting skills
* Strong project management and coaching abilities

### **Skills & Competencies**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Sound mathematical and analytical capabilities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and lead effective meetings
* Emotional resilience and conflict resolution skills
* Positive leadership presence and professional demeanor

### **Performance Measurements**

* **Operating Standards:** Meets/exceeds performance goals for production and customer service
* **Personal Growth:** Achieves annual professional development goals
* **Employee Relations:** Demonstrates effective team development, coaching, and motivation
* **Creativity:** Contributes innovative ideas to improve business operations

### **Physical & Work Environment Requirements**

* Regular walking, talking, hearing; frequent standing and reaching; occasional sitting
* Visual requirements include close, distance, color, peripheral vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
* Exposure to wet/humid conditions, mechanical parts, fumes/particles, and high noise levels

Requirements:

Pratt Industries is America's 5th largest paper and packaging company with more than 10,000 highly skilled employees dedicated to the environment and sustainability. Pratt Industries is one of the largest corrugated packaging companies in America, with sophisticated manufacturing facilities in more than a dozen states. The company operates three of the most modern, cost effective paper mills in the country, as well as a series of sheet and box plants strategically placed throughout the United States offering a wide range of creative packaging solutions. Pratt Industries is committed to recycling and the environment by “harvesting the urban forest." 
Pratt Industries offers competitive compensation plans with incentive opportunities, full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, FSA, All State, Pre-Paid Legal, and 401(k) with company match, paid vacation, and paid holidays.
