records.description:
As a leader and innovator in the snack food industry for over 50 years, J&J Snack Foods provides branded snack foods to foodservice and retail supermarket outlets across the U.S. Its products include such icons as SUPERPRETZEL, ICEE, and Dippin' Dots along with other key brands like LUIGI'S Real Italian Ice, The Funnel Cake Factory Funnel Cakes, and Hola Churros. J&J also has a strong presence in bakery providing cakes, cookies, and pies to some of the largest grocery and convenience retailers in industry. Our company continues to deliver record sales led by a talented team and a commitment to "Fun Served Here".

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the Senior Director of Plant Operations, the Plant Manager serves as the senior leader responsible for the overall operational performance of a high-volume snack food manufacturing plant. This role oversees all day-to-day plant activities and is accountable for safety, quality, service, cost, people, and culture. The Plant Manager leads cross-functional teams across production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation to ensure the efficient production of high-quality products in alignment with company standards and financial targets. This position combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, translating company objectives into daily plant operations while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement. The Plant Manager plays a critical role in delivering the production plan, enhancing productivity and profitability, and fostering a safe, engaged, and high-performing workforce.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS****:**

* Leads and manages all aspects of plant operations, including production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation, to ensure the safe, efficient, and timely manufacturing of high-quality products.

* Establishes and sustains a strong safety culture by promoting a zero-injury mindset; ensure full compliance with all OSHA, FDA, GMP, HACCP, and environmental regulations through proactive programs, audits, and corrective actions.

* Delivers the production plan on time and in full by optimizing operational performance, including OEE, labor efficiency, yield, and waste reduction, while identifying and eliminating constraints and bottlenecks.

* Partners with Quality to uphold the highest food safety and product standards; ensure adherence to all quality systems, maintain audit readiness, and lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for quality deviations.

* Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing team by recruiting, training, and coaching supervisors and frontline employees; fosters a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement, while supporting succession planning and positive employee/labor relations.

* Owns and manages the plant's financial performance, including the operating budget, labor and overtime costs, waste, and conversion costs; monitor expenditures and drive cost-effective operations aligned with business objectives.

* Champions continuous improvement initiatives by implementing Lean manufacturing principles, 5S, and structured problem-solving methodologies; lead kaizen events and leverage data and KPIs to drive performance and decision-making.

* Ensures equipment reliability and optimal facility performance through strong partnership with maintenance; oversee preventive maintenance programs and manage capital improvement projects to support operational efficiency and long-term growth.

* Collaborates cross-functionally with Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and Distribution to align materials, staffing, and maintenance plans with production needs, including support for new product introductions and process changes.

* Tracks, analyzes, and reports key performance indicators related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people; communicate performance and improvement plans effectively to senior leadership.

* Performs other duties and special projects assigned to support plant operations and organizational objectives.

**COMPETENCIES:**

To perform this job successfully, the Plant Manager must be self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to solve problems while staying focused on priorities. The following knowledge, skills, and abilities are required:

* Excellent planning, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to balance production and maintenance priorities.

* Proven leadership and team-building abilities, including advanced coaching, employee development, and motivation skills.

* Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and active listening skills.

* Adaptable and flexible, able to navigate change and respond to evolving operational needs.

* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities.

* Collaborative, with the ability to lead team-based decision-making processes.

* Highly motivated, results-oriented, and driven to achieve operational excellence.

* Alignment with and passion for the company's mission, vision, values, and operating principles.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business Management, or a related field; Master's degree preferred. Equivalent experience will also be considered.

* Minimum of 7–10+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, preferably in CPG or food production, with prior experience leading a plant or large production operation.

* Proven track record in safety management, including implementing and enforcing safety systems and ensuring compliance with OSHA and other regulatory standards.

* Extensive experience managing food quality systems and adhering to GMP and other industry requirements.

records.title: Sand Plant Manager
records.description:
**Job Description:** 
Responsible for the management of all aspects of a sand mining and production facility. This position will utilize budgets, production goals, and effective communication. Safety must be a top priority. 
 
**Job Requirements:** 
**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 
 
Direct the following department personnel to ensure safety and productivity is achieved. 
1. Mine Team 
2. Wash Operators 
3. Dry Plant Operators 
4. Quality/Lab 
5. Maintenance

* Efficiently schedule and supervise hourly personnel for weekly operations, monitor timecards, vacations, and control overtime.
* Work with corporate HR department on staffing needs and employee issues.
* Handle discipline and grievances, as required, while maintaining acceptable labor and employee relations.
* Accurately collect, review, and forward operating data, such as mine, wash, and dry plant production reports.
* Assist HSE Coordinator in collecting the necessary data for MSHA and DNR reports.
* Communicate effectively and timely with owners, corporate directors, and/or other management of problems or potential problems that affect the proper operation of the plant. Problems may include personnel, equipment, transportation, quality, or raw materials.
* Direct activities safely to achieve optimum rates of productivity consistent with long/short range goals
* Direct and coordinate plant/mine related projects with Director of Mining
* Assisting in the preparation of capital projects and plan, and their completion • Direct and oversee activities performed by subcontractors.
* Monitor the mine operation to ensure compliance with all regulations concerning air emissions, water discharge, erosion and sedimentation control.
* Assist, implement, and comply with ISO 9001 quality program.
* Review quality reports daily and ensure quality standards are being followed.
* Evaluate with the EHS Coordinator the company’s training program and conditions in the plant, creating a culture of safety that exceeds MSHA guidelines and regulations.
* Ensure safety and good housekeeping by being active in all programs.
* Recommend and/or purchase materials and supplies as necessary, utilizing corporate purchasing department. Recommend equipment and process modifications to improve efficiencies.
* Ensure work standards, policies, plans, and procedures are enforced. Support management’s policies and programs.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIRMENTS**

* Team-oriented, an effective communicator (verbal and written), able to offer technical expertise and guidance, and have the ability and willingness to build rapport with department team members and external departments.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and set priorities appropriately.
* Understanding our company functions as a cohesive operation, and often employees serve in many roles and various functions or capacities.
* Develop working relationships with other corporate personnel and plants.
* Maintain open communications with subordinates, peers, and superiors.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s Degree, in Business Management or related field
* 3 to 5 years of related experience in a position of leadership, Surface Mining Experience preferred
* Valid driver’s license required.
* Advanced experience working with MSHA Safety and Environmental competency
* Supervisory skills
* Budgetary skills - Capital planning and projects
* Short and long-term planning and scheduling
* Leadership Skills

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Pass toxicity test.
* Medical clearance to wear respiratory protection.
* Team?oriented, effective communicator (verbal and written), able to offer technical expertise and guidance, and
* have the ability and willingness to build rapport with team members and external agencies.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and set priorities appropriately.
* Willingness to further training or education, if requested.

Wage Range: 130000 - 150000 per year 
General Description of Benefits: Competitive Wages | Paid Time Off | Full Benefits | $0 Premium Insurance Option

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Company Description**

Sirtex Medical is a global leader in healthcare, with offices in the U.S., Australia, Germany, and Singapore, dedicated to improving patient outcomes.

Our mission is to be at the forefront of minimally invasive cancer and embolization therapies. By partnering with physicians, we aim to provide innovative products that enhance patient outcomes and simplify treatments. Achieving this ambitious goal requires passionate and talented individuals who are committed to making a difference. Our flagship product, SIR-Spheres® Y-90 resin microspheres, is a targeted radiation therapy for liver cancer. To date, we have delivered over >150K doses across 50+ countries, significantly impacting patients' lives worldwide. Our success is fueled by our dedication to serving the medical community, maintaining professionalism, fostering a collaborative work culture, nurturing an entrepreneurial spirit, and continuously pursuing innovation and improvement.

At Sirtex, we are committed to creating a great workplace. We offer a range of benefits, programs, and services to support our employees, ensuring they have opportunities to contribute to our success and advance their careers. Join our inclusive community, where you can collaborate with talented colleagues, bring your ideas to life, and advance your career, all while delivering innovative healthcare solutions to patients.

 **Job Description**

**SCOPE:**

The Wilmington plant is the largest of 3 global Sirtex manufacturing site and serves as the principal production site of both SIR-Spheres microspheres and Lava product lines. The Plant Manager is responsible for leading the sites manufacturing operations, engineering, warehouse and product distribution.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

 

* Develop and lead execution of the site manufacturing strategy for both the SIR-Spheres and Lava value streams. Align site goals with Senior Leadership and Corporate objectives.
* Team Performance Management: lead, develop and mentor manufacturing team members.
* Manage production schedules, ensuring resource availability and capacity to meet demand, working closely with the Supply Chain team, using optimal schedules to minimize overall costs.
* Lead Continuous Improvement efforts, identifying process, equipment, product, and other opportunities, that reduce cost, improve quality and safety at the site.
* Full responsibility for developing and managing to site budget.
* Ensure resource and equipment capacity to ensure efficient and reliable manufacturing.
* Set site target KPI’s managing OEE, Labor Efficiency, Scrap, Equipment Utilization, etc.
* Ensure product is built to specification and in compliance with all Quality System requirements.
* Manage the site engineering team to ensure equipment and processes are robust and meet all manufacturing requirements. Manage PM strategy and ensure that execution is completed on time.
* Support the Quality Department, working with on site Quality team members to ensure that compliance with all areas of the Sirtex QMS are being followed. Identify opportunities for improvement and work to implement them directly in the QMS.
* Work in conjunction with HSE/Facilities Department to ensure a safe working environment for all employees and that the facilities is maintained, and compliant with regulatory requirements for both the handling of radioactive materials and medical device manufacturing.
* Manage all shipping, receiving and warehousing activities. Ensure timely material receipt, inventory accuracy is maintained, and products are shipped on time.

 
**Qualifications**

**EDUCATIONAL PREREQUISITES AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related discipline such as Chemistry or Biomedical field
* 5+ Years experience working in medical device or pharmaceutical industry preferred.
* Prior experience working with radioisotopes preferred.
* 3+ years of site management experience, with 10+ years of leadership experience.
* 6 Sigma Green belt preferred. Experience using 5S and Lean principles is preferred.

The anticipated annual base salary range and target bonus opportunity is $136,000 to $171,000 annually, plus a 15% target annual bonus.

The final position level and compensation will be determined based on non-discriminatory, job-related factors, including geographic location, skills, experience, education, and alignment with the position requirements. In addition to base salary and bonus eligibility, Sirtex offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid sick and vacation time, medical, dental, vision and life insurance, and a generous 401(k) matching program and other benefits, subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

 **Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines

Do you want to be part of something bigger? A team whose impact stretches across the globe making a real difference to the quality of people’s lives. Sirtex recognizes that well-being, financial health, and work-life balance are crucial for our employees to achieve personal success.

Sirtex offers qualified candidates:

* Diverse and flexible work arrangements to achieve the optimum balance between work and personal responsibilities.
* A culture of respect, diversity, collaboration, and innovation fostering inclusiveness and superior performance.
* Attractive compensation and benefit packages which are practical, robust and equitable.
* A commitment to support ongoing professional growth through career development, on the job experiences and training opportunities.
* Challenging work which supports the development of new and better ways to improve clinical outcomes for oncology treatment around the world.
* An unwavering commitment to company values, employee safety and excellence in everything we do.

Diversity drives innovation; inclusion fosters belonging, growth and success. Sirtex believes that it takes multiple perspectives and voices to create a culture and workplace which fosters engagement, teamwork, and employee satisfaction to perform our best and deliver on commitments. We are dedicated to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, included, and can share their ideas so that we can exceed even our own expectations.

Sirtex is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Sirtex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
**Director of Quality**

**Eldridge, IA – Direct Hire**

**Full time – On Site**

Productive Resources (www.productiveresources.com) is seeking a candidate to be part of our engineering team for our customer's facility in Eldridge, IA. As a member of our team, the selected candidate will be a Director of Quality who provides strategic and hands-on leadership for quality operations and is responsible for the planning, organization, direction, coordination, compliance, and control of the Company's Quality Management System. This role leads the Quality team and ensures the effectiveness of quality processes across the organization, including product and process quality, supplier quality, inspection activities, corrective actions, audit readiness, customer quality performance, and compliance with all applicable contractual, regulatory, and government requirements.

The Director of Quality is responsible for developing and leading employees, strengthening accountability, and partnering with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and Executive Leadership to prevent defects, drive continuous improvement, and support the safe, compliant, and on-time delivery of mission-critical products. This position oversees departmental personnel and processes, providing coaching, direction, and support to ensure the safe and efficient execution of work while maintaining quality standards, meeting customer requirements, and effectively managing operational costs. Through strong leadership and oversight, the Director of Quality ensures quality objectives are achieved and organizational performance continuously improves.

This is a full-time position that is indefinite in duration with the opportunity of professional growth, and additional opportunities within our organization.

**Duties:**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Quality managers, engineers, inspectors, supplier quality personnel, and other assigned team members.
* Establish and execute a quality strategy aligned with Company goals, customer expectations, contractual requirements, and operational priorities.
* Maintain and continually improve the Quality Management System and ensure processes remain effective, documented, implemented, and audit-ready.
* Lead internal, external, customer, registrar, and government audits; ensure findings are contained, corrected, and closed with effective corrective action.
* Own quality performance metrics and executive reporting, including product conformity, customer complaints, supplier quality, corrective action, scrap, rework, cost of poor quality, first-pass yield, and audit performance.
* Drive disciplined nonconformance control, material review, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness.
* Partner with Manufacturing and Engineering to improve process capability, inspection planning, product acceptance methods, error prevention, and manufacturability.
* Oversee inspection and test activities, measurement-system controls, calibration coordination, and the integrity and retention of quality records.
* Lead supplier quality strategy, qualification, surveillance, performance review, development, and supplier corrective action.
* Ensure customer-specific, contractual, regulatory, and government quality requirements are identified, flowed down, implemented, and maintained.
* Support first article inspections, source inspections, customer returns, complaint investigations, configuration and change-control activities, and product or process validation as required.
* Build a quality culture focused on prevention, accountability, objective evidence, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.
* Develop departmental staffing, training, succession, budget, and resource plans necessary to support current operations and future growth.
* Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, Sales, Finance, Human Resources, and executive leadership to resolve systemic issues and meet Company objectives.
* Any other duties assigned by Vice President of Operations.
 

 

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Industrial Technology, Operations, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible leadership experience managing quality functions and teams within a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading a multi-functional quality organization, including Quality Engineering, Inspection, Supplier Quality, Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), Internal Audits, and Regulatory/Customer Compliance activities.
* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), including the development, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of quality processes and standards.
* Experience with ISO 9001:2015 requirements, including coordinating and conducting internal audits and maintaining audit readiness.
* Proven ability to lead teams, develop talent, drive accountability, and collaborate cross-functionally to achieve quality and operational objectives.
* Strong working knowledge of NADCAP accreditation, its QMS, and quality requirements related to the special processes within Chemical Processing and Non-destructive Testing.
* Experience leading internal, customer, registrar, and government audits and responding effectively to findings.
* Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action methods such as 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, A3, and DMAIC.
* Working knowledge of statistical process control, process capability, measurement systems, control plans, and risk-based quality planning.
* Experience with supplier qualification, supplier performance management, supplier corrective action, and supplier development.
* Familiarity with government contracting and customer quality requirements, including FAR/DFARS and DCMA oversight, is preferred.
* Ability to translate quality data into clear priorities, executive-level metrics, and sustainable improvements.
* Excellent leadership, communication, coaching, conflict-resolution, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with direct engagement on the manufacturing floor and timely resolution of customer or production issues.
* Professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, Certified Quality Engineer, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt are preferred.
* Must have good written and verbal communication skills while being able to motivate and manage reporting personnel, collaboration with peers, and report up to executive leadership as needed.
* Must be able to professionally coach and direct activities of a diverse team while being fair and consistent.
 

 

**Preferred:**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* ISO Auditor Certification, Lean Six Sigma Certification, or other relevant quality management certifications.
* Experience in defense, government contracting, firearms, ammunition, aerospace, weapons systems, or another highly regulated precision manufacturing environment.
* Knowledge of first article inspection, including AS9102.
 

 

**Compensation & Benefits:**

We offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and excellent growth opportunities.

If you are the right person, if you have the expertise we need, submit your resume now!

records.title: Sr. Director, Operations - RMS
records.description:
The Senior Director, Operations – RMS is a critical leadership role with responsibility for the operational performance of the RMS site network across North America and EMEA. 
 
The role provides leadership across all RMS breeding, production and operational sites, ensuring that the global operating network is aligned with the company's broader commercial, financial and operational objectives. 
 
The Senior Director is responsible for translating global strategy into actionable operational plans and ensuring consistent execution across sites. The role balances strategic oversight with active operational engagement, working closely with Site Leaders to improve performance, strengthen operational discipline and ensure the organization is positioned to respond effectively to changing customer and commercial requirements. 
 
RMS operates across a complex network of sites with differing species, production models, infrastructure, regulatory environments and market requirements. The Senior Director is responsible for creating greater consistency in operational performance while recognizing and managing legitimate differences between sites. 
 
The role works closely with Commercial, SIOP, Production, Finance, Technical Services, Veterinary Services, Animal Welfare, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, HR and other functions to ensure that customer demand, production capability, workforce, resources and financial objectives are appropriately aligned. 
 
The Senior Director is accountable for operational performance, cost efficiency, productivity, service delivery, leadership capability and continuous improvement across the RMS operating network. 
 
The role partners closely with the Sr Strategic Production Leader, who provides specialist technical expertise in production capability, production mapping, capacity, biological production assumptions, production optimization and production-related risk. 
 
The Senior Director does not need to be the organization’s deepest technical production expert. The role requires sufficient understanding of RMS production to make informed operational decisions, challenge assumptions and translate technical considerations into business outcomes.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Strategic & Operational Leadership**

* Translate RMS strategy into actionable global operational plans, ensuring alignment with broader organizational and commercial goals.
* Provide operational leadership across all RMS sites in North America and EMEA.
* Establish clear operational priorities, performance expectations and accountability across the site network.
* Ensure Site Leaders and operational teams understand their responsibilities for delivering business, operational, customer and people outcomes.
* Develop greater consistency in operating standards, management processes and performance expectations across sites.
* Balance global standardization with appropriate local requirements and regulatory differences.
* Identify structural and operational barriers to performance and lead actions to address them.
* Ensure the RMS operating network works as an integrated business rather than a collection of individual sites.
* Provide regular operational insight, risks and recommendations to the Senior Vice President, RMS Operations.

**Operational Execution & Performance**

* Drive effective day-to-day operational execution through Site Leaders and operational leadership teams.
* Ensure sites operate efficiently and consistently against agreed operational standards.
* Identify and address operational inefficiencies, performance gaps and resource constraints.
* Establish a strong operating rhythm across the global RMS network.
* Ensure operational issues are identified early, appropriately escalated and resolved.
* Promote structured problem solving and accountability for sustainable solutions.
* Maintain visibility of operational performance across sites and ensure corrective actions are delivered.
* Balance immediate operational requirements with longer-term business priorities.

**Efficiency & Productivity Optimization**

* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, productivity and resource utilization.
* Drive initiatives that improve labor productivity and operational effectiveness.
* Challenge inefficient processes, structures and ways of working.
* Promote standardization and sharing of best practice across sites.
* Work with Site Leaders to identify opportunities to improve utilization of labor, facilities and other resources.
* Ensure productivity improvements are sustainable and do not compromise quality, animal welfare, biosecurity or regulatory requirements.
* Partner with the Head of Production to convert technical production opportunities into measurable operational improvements.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Commercial, SIOP and Production to align operational capability with customer demand.
* Partner with the Head of Production to understand production capability, constraints and technical risks.
* Work with SIOP to ensure operational plans reflect realistic production and capacity assumptions.
* Partner with Finance to align operational performance with financial objectives.
* Work with Technical Services, Veterinary, Animal Welfare, Quality and Regulatory functions to ensure operational requirements are appropriately managed.
* Partner with HR to align organizational structures, workforce requirements and leadership capability with business needs.
* Ensure cross-functional decisions are translated into clear operational actions and accountabilities.

**Customer Focus**

* Ensure operational activities are aligned with customer expectations and commercial requirements.
* Develop a customer-focused culture across RMS operations.
* Ensure customer commitments are supported by realistic operational and production plans.
* Identify operational risks that could affect customer delivery and ensure appropriate mitigation.
* Work with Commercial, SIOP and Production to balance customer requirements with capacity, cost, quality and operational constraints.
* Ensure customer focus does not compromise regulatory, welfare, quality or biosecurity standards.

**Process Improvement & Innovation**

* Lead continuous improvement across the RMS operational network.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, productivity, reliability and operational effectiveness.
* Sponsor cross-site improvement initiatives and ensure successful practices are transferred across the network.
* Encourage data-driven problem solving and evidence-based decision making.
* Lead change initiatives involving new systems, technologies, operating models and processes.
* Ensure improvement programs deliver measurable and sustainable benefits.
* Partner with the Head of Production on technically driven production improvement initiatives.

**Data-Driven Decision Making**

* Establish appropriate global RMS operational KPIs and performance measures.
* Utilize data and analytics to understand operational performance and identify trends.
* Develop and maintain performance dashboards and reporting mechanisms.
* Ensure KPIs are aligned with strategic, commercial and financial objectives.
* Use data to identify systemic issues rather than treating performance problems as isolated site issues.
* Ensure performance information is used to drive action and accountability.
* Provide regular performance reporting and insight to the Senior Vice President, RMS Operations.

**Financial Accountability & Margin Contribution**

* Manage the operational contribution to RMS financial performance.
* Partner with Finance to improve cost efficiency and gross profit margin.
* Translate financial targets into operational priorities and actions.
* Identify and address operational cost drivers.
* Challenge labor, resource and operational assumptions where appropriate.
* Support accurate operational forecasting and budget planning.
* Ensure operational investment decisions are supported by clear business cases.
* Drive cost-saving initiatives without compromising quality, welfare, biosecurity or operational sustainability.
* Ensure operational decisions consider both short-term financial performance and long-term capability.

**Capacity & Network Planning**

* Work with SIOP, Commercial and Production to understand current and future capacity requirements.
* Ensure operational resources are aligned with expected demand.
* Partner with the Head of Production to understand production capacity and biological constraints.
* Identify structural capacity constraints and develop appropriate operational responses.
* Support strategic decisions regarding site capability, infrastructure, footprint and investment.
* Assess the operational implications of changes in demand, customer requirements, species or production strategy.
* Ensure capacity decisions consider workforce, infrastructure, production, financial and customer requirements together.

**People Development & Culture**

* Lead and develop Site Leaders and senior operational leaders across North America and EMEA.
* Build a high-performance culture grounded in accountability, collaboration and operational discipline.
* Establish clear leadership expectations across RMS Operations.
* Identify high-potential individuals and create opportunities for development.
* Strengthen succession plans for critical operational leadership roles.
* Provide coaching and feedback to operational leaders.
* Hold leaders accountable for both performance and leadership behaviors.
* Build greater leadership capability across the global RMS network.
* Encourage leaders to solve problems at the appropriate level rather than relying on unnecessary escalation.

**Workforce & Organizational Effectiveness**

* Partner with HR and Finance to ensure workforce structures support business requirements.
* Ensure operational workforce levels are aligned with demand, production requirements and financial objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve workforce deployment and productivity.
* Challenge legacy structures and fixed workforce assumptions where business conditions require greater flexibility.
* Support organizational changes required to improve operational performance.
* Ensure critical operational capabilities are identified and developed.
* Align organizational design with the future requirements of the RMS business.

**Compliance, Quality, Animal Welfare & Risk**

* Maintain operational accountability for compliance across RMS sites.
* Ensure operational decisions incorporate regulatory, quality, animal welfare, veterinary and biosecurity requirements.
* Work closely with Quality, Veterinary, Animal Welfare and Regulatory functions.
* Ensure significant operational risks are identified, understood and actively managed.
* Establish appropriate escalation and response mechanisms for significant operational incidents.
* Ensure operational performance and financial pressures never compromise compliance, welfare, quality or biosecurity.
* Promote a culture in which compliance and welfare are embedded within operational decision making.

**Minimum Requirements**

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Operations, Business, Engineering, Animal Science, Agribusiness, Life Sciences or related discipline. Advanced degree preferred.

**Experience**

10+ years of progressive operational leadership experience, preferably including multi-site or geographically dispersed operations.

**Operational Leadership**

Demonstrated experience leading operational teams through Site Leaders, General Managers or other senior leaders.

**Financial Acumen**

Strong understanding of budgets, cost efficiency, labor productivity, resource utilization and margin improvement.

**Commercial Understanding**

Ability to understand customer requirements and translate commercial priorities into operational actions.

**Data-Driven Leadership**

Experience using operational data and KPIs to guide decisions and improve performance.

**Transformation**

Experience leading operational improvement, transformation, restructuring or change initiatives.

**Regulatory Environment**

Experience operating within a regulated, compliance-sensitive or technically complex environment.

**Global Experience**

Experience working across multiple countries, cultures or geographically dispersed operations.

**RMS / Industry Knowledge**

Experience in RMS, animal breeding, animal production, agriculture, life sciences, manufacturing or another technically complex operational environment is advantageous.

**TRAVEL**

~40% travel both domestica and international

The anticipated base salary for this position could range from between $141,800 to $195,000 and will depend, in part, on the successful candidate’s qualifications for the role, including education and experience. Benefits include health and dental coverage, short- and long-term disability, paid time off, 401K participation with company match, etc.

* *This position could be offered at different levels for candidates who qualify with a combination of advanced levels of education and/or years of experience. The salary range will adjust along with the level of the role to match the person’s relevant experience and/or education level.*

*At Inotiv, our work helps advance the development of new medicines and therapies that can improve people's lives. As a leading global contract research organization (CRO), we partner with researchers to tackle complex scientific challenges, drive innovation, and help build a healthier, safer world. Bringing together scientists, researchers, technical experts, and business professionals, we provide the expertise and collaboration needed to move research forward. Our people make this work possible, and we value the knowledge, ideas, and contributions each person brings to the team. Whether you are starting your career or bringing years of experience, Inotiv offers opportunities to learn, grow, and play a meaningful role in advancing treatments for patients around the world.*

*Salary will be commensurate with experience and responsibilities. Benefits include health and dental coverage, short- and long-term disability, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401K, and more!*

*Inotiv is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to provide a fair and equal employment opportunity to all persons, regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, discipline, termination and access to benefits and training.*

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
**Director of Operations**

At **MPE** we are dedicated to making a difference in the world through cutting-edge medical technology. Our mission is to be the global leader in design, engineering, and manufacturing solutions for the medical and technology industries. We are committed to creating impactful solutions that improve lives and fostering an environment where our team members can thrive, grow, and contribute to groundbreaking advancements in the medical field.

**A better career for you. Creating medical technology for all.**

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**We are seeking a dedicated Director of Operations to join our team.**

In this vital role, you will be responsible for all of the Company’s Manufacturing and Maintenance activities related to all MPE sites. The Director of Operations will plan, direct, coordinate, and oversee operations activities in the organization, ensuring development and implementation of efficient operations and cost-effective systems to meet current and future needs of the organization.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where precision and teamwork matter, we’d love to hear from you!

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a key member of the Leadership Team that develops, establishes, communicates and executes the strategic direction of operations while aligning with overall business goals and objectives and supporting customer requirements.
* Work closely with President/CEO to drive manufacturing plans, goals and future innovations including Lean, Six Sigma, Quick Response Manufacturing techniques and Continuous Improvement to evolve our World Class Organization.
* Ensure that, as the Company grows, our manufacturing capabilities meet or exceed industry and customer requirements for cost, quality, responsiveness, lean, efficiencies, safety and best practices.
* Develop, recommend and manage budgeting and budget execution within functional area with a focus on costs savings, productivity improvements and quality assurance. Manage within the budgetary constraints. Analyze and report on variances between actual and budgeted expenditures
* Oversee all manufacturing engineering, production control, production process development, and preventive maintenance.
* Develop and implement processes, procedures and controls to promote efficient operations of the organization and ensure all Operations teams remain compliant to the processes, procedures and controls.
* Work closely with the Quality Team to ensure manufacturing processes are meeting customers’ requirements and required scorecard levels.
* Monitor and understand our customers’ and other outside agencies regulatory and quality system requirements and incorporate into our manufacturing processes while maintaining compliance.
* Ensure the training of new and present employees in the processes and methods required to achieve the organization’s standards for quality, quantity, and safety, consistent with the companies compliance and operational needs. Identifies additional training needs and ensures proper training is developed and provided.
* Oversee the Company’s environmental, health and safety efforts in manufacturing to remain in compliance OSHA, EPA, State and local regulations and provide a safe working environment for our employees.
* Establish and maintain best practices for Manufacturing and Preventive Maintenance to develop and run a world-class manufacturer for medical devices. Ensure the maintenance of departmental housekeeping standards.
* Maintains knowledge of emerging technologies and trends in operations management.
* Presents periodic performance reports and metrics to the Chief Executive Officer and Leadership Team.
* Leader and Ambassador for MPE Cultural Values internally and externally.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Qualifications**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field or equivalent experience

**Experience and Training:**

* At least 10 years of manufacturing and continuous improvement experience in a leadership role
* Experience in capital equipment and ROI analysis
* Experience low-volume, high product mix manufacturing
* Experience in Lean, Six Sigma and/or Quick Response Manufacturing techniques

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Physical and Mental Demands:**

* Regularly required to analyze, interpret data and documents, read and write business correspondences, present information, and problem solve.
* Must be able to read, write, apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Why Join Us?**

* **Mission-Driven Work:** Help deliver medical products that change lives.
* **Growth Opportunities:** We support career development and internal promotions.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:**
 + Medical (HSA-qualified and traditional plans), dental, and vision—coverage starts the first of the month after hire.
 + 401(k) with company match.
 + Nine paid holidays and vacation time from day one.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**If you're detail-oriented, team-driven, and ready to contribute to life-changing medical technology, apply today and grow your career at MPE.**

**No relocation or sponsorship available for this role.**

records.title: Senior Director, Global Infrastructure Technology & Operations

postedPay.title: Senior Director, Global Infrastructure Technology & Operations

records.description:
**Career-defining. Life-changing.**

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

**About This Role:**

The Senior Director, Global Infrastructure Technology & Operations will lead iRhythm’s enterprise infrastructure strategy, architecture, operations, and modernization across cloud, networking, data center and hardware, end-user computing, and security infrastructure. This role will ensure that iRhythm’s technology foundation is resilient, secure, compliant, and scalable enough to support 24/7 clinical operations, manufacturing, global commercial growth, and the company’s expanding data and AI capabilities. This senior leadership role combines executive leadership, hands-on technical depth, organizational development, financial stewardship, and close partnership with the Chief Data Officer and head of IT, CISO, Quality/Regulatory, Engineering, and business leaders. The role works hand in hand with the CISO: Security defines the requirements and provides oversight, while Infrastructure delivers and operates the platforms, controls, and services that enable the business.

**What You Will Be Doing**
==========================

**Strategy & Leadership**
-------------------------

* Define and execute a multi-year enterprise infrastructure strategy and roadmap aligned to iRhythm’s business, clinical, data, and AI objectives.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing infrastructure organization across cloud, network, operations, end-user services, and managed service partners.
* Establish infrastructure architecture standards, reference patterns, governance, and operating models across business units and geographies.
* Serve as the senior infrastructure advisor to executive leadership, translating strategy, risk, investment, and performance into business terms.

**Cloud Infrastructure**
------------------------

* Own the enterprise multi-cloud strategy across AWS, GCP, Azure, and Microsoft 365, including landing zones, account and project structure, identity integration, and guardrails.
* Lead cloud platform engineering using Infrastructure as Code, automation, infrastructure CI/CD, and policy-as-code.
* Drive FinOps practices, including cost visibility, optimization, reserved-capacity strategy, and chargeback/showback.
* Enable modern data and AI platforms—including Snowflake, enterprise AI and search platforms, and ML/GPU workloads—with secure, scalable, well-governed infrastructure and private connectivity patterns.
* Lead workload migration and modernization from on-premises environments to cloud where appropriate.

**Networking & Connectivity**
-----------------------------

* Own enterprise network architecture across corporate offices, clinical and IDTF sites, manufacturing facilities, data centers, and cloud environments, including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, SASE, DNS, and load balancing.
* Design secure hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity using Direct Connect, Interconnect, private endpoints, VPN, and transit architectures.
* Implement network segmentation and isolation for manufacturing/OT and clinical environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles.
* Ensure high availability, performance monitoring, and capacity planning for mission-critical clinical and patient-facing services.

**Data Center, Hardware & End-User Computing**
----------------------------------------------

* Oversee on-premises and colocation data centers, compute, storage, backup, and virtualization platforms, including lifecycle management and rationalization.
* Own the hardware asset lifecycle, including procurement, standards, refresh cycles, and secure disposal.
* Lead end-user computing across endpoints, MDM, collaboration tools, service desk, and conference room technology to deliver a secure and productive employee experience.
* Support infrastructure for manufacturing sites and clinical operations, including device and equipment connectivity where applicable.
* **Security Infrastructure**
 ---------------------------
* Implement, operate, and maintain infrastructure security controls in alignment with the security strategy, policies, and standards set by the CISO.
* Own the day-to-day engineering and operation of network and platform security technologies such as firewalls, WAF, proxies/SASE, NAC, and VPN, with the CISO’s team defining requirements, configuration standards, and monitoring.
* Embed security by design across infrastructure through hardening baselines, secure configurations, and Infrastructure-as-Code guardrails.
* Own timely vulnerability remediation and patching across infrastructure assets, meeting SLAs defined by the Security team.
* Operate identity and directory infrastructure, including SSO, MFA, and directory services, in support of the CISO-led Zero Trust and identity roadmap.
* Partner with the CISO’s organization during security incidents by providing infrastructure expertise, containment, remediation, logs, telemetry, and integrations needed for detection and response.

**Compliance, Quality & Regulated Environments**
------------------------------------------------

* Ensure infrastructure meets applicable regulatory and compliance obligations, including FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA/HITECH, SOC 2, ISO 13485, ISO 27001, GDPR/UK GDPR, and other international requirements.
* Partner with the CISO, Quality, and Regulatory teams to maintain infrastructure controls and evidence for audits, with Security owning the control framework and this role owning control execution for infrastructure.
* Support computer system validation (CSV/CSA) for GxP-relevant infrastructure, along with change control and audit readiness.
* Lead infrastructure responses during internal, customer, and regulatory audits.
* Protect patient health information through appropriate data residency, encryption, access controls, and logging.

**Resilience, Operations & Service Management**
-----------------------------------------------

* Own business continuity and disaster recovery for infrastructure, with defined RTO/RPO targets for clinical and business-critical systems and regular DR testing.
* Build observability, monitoring, and alerting practices using SRE principles, SLOs, and error budgets for critical services.
* Mature ITSM processes for incident, problem, change, and configuration management using ITIL-aligned practices and tools such as ServiceNow.
* Drive automation to reduce toil and improve reliability, speed, and consistency.

**Vendor & Financial Management**
---------------------------------

* Own the infrastructure budget across OpEx and CapEx, including forecasting, business cases, and cost optimization.
* Manage strategic vendor, cloud provider, telecom, and managed service relationships, including contract negotiation and performance management.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and make build, buy, or partner recommendations.

**Technology Environment**
==========================

Our environment spans enterprise infrastructure, cloud, networking, security, end-user computing, data, AI, and regulated clinical and manufacturing systems. Experience with every named technology is not required.

* Cloud and platform: AWS, GCP, Azure, Microsoft 365, landing zones, Terraform or similar Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, policy-as-code, containers, virtualization, and GPU infrastructure.
* Netorking and connectivity: LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, SASE, DNS, load balancing, Direct Connect, Interconnect, private endpoints, VPN, transit architectures, NAC, firewalls, and WAF.
* Data, AI, and analytics infrastructure: Snowflake, Databricks, enterprise AI and search platforms, ML/GPU workloads, private connectivity, and governed data products.
* Security and identity: SSO, MFA, directory services, Zero Trust, endpoint management, vulnerability management, security telemetry, logging, and incident response integrations.
* Operations and service management: observability, monitoring, SRE practices, SLOs, error budgets, backup and recovery, ServiceNow, ITIL, and disaster recovery testing.
* Enterprise integrations and ecosystems: Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Salesforce, QAD, Workday, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, and other business and clinical platforms.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise infrastructure, including 7+ years leading multi-disciplinary infrastructure teams at the director level or above.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven strength in ability to balance strategic vision with execution excellence, developing organizational capability while creating the capacity, accountability, and focus needed to consistently deliver on business and technology priorities.
* Deep hands-on and architectural expertise in at least one major cloud platform, preferably AWS and/or GCP, with experience running multi-cloud and hybrid environments.
* Strong background in enterprise networking and hands-on experience engineering and operating security infrastructure in partnership with a security organization.
* Proven experience operating infrastructure in a regulated industry such as medical devices, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or financial services.
* Working knowledge of FDA regulations, including 21 CFR Part 11 and 21 CFR Part 820, as well as frameworks such as HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF.
* Track record of leading large-scale transformation programs, including cloud migration, data center consolidation, network modernization, or comparable enterprise initiatives.
* Experience owning budgets of meaningful scale and managing strategic technology, cloud, telecom, and managed service vendors.
* Excellent executive communication and influencing skills and the ability to translate technical risk, resilience, and investment into business outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience in a medical device, digital health, or connected-device company supporting 24/7 clinical services.
* Experience supporting manufacturing or OT networks and familiarity with IEC 62443 or similar OT security practices.
* Familiarity with infrastructure for data and AI platforms, including Snowflake, Databricks, ML/GPU workloads, and enterprise AI tools.
* Global infrastructure experience across the United States, United Kingdom/Europe, and Asia-Pacific, including data residency requirements.
* Certifications such as AWS or GCP Professional Architect, CCIE/CCNP,
* MBA or advanced degree.

**#LI-JR1**
===========

**Location:**

Remote - US

Actual compensation may vary depending on job-related factors including knowledge, skills, experience, and work location.

**Estimated Pay Range**

$222,000.00 - $288,000.00

As a part of our core values, we ensure an inclusive workforce. records.title: Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
records.description:
Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering

White Bear Lake, MN

**About Heraeus**

Making displays foldable? Help hearts beat with micro-particles? Work on solutions involving precious metals? As a family-owned global technology group we help our customers to always being one step ahead.

 

**About Heraeus Medevio**

Heraeus Medevio combines medical technology expertise with collaborative partnerships. Together with medical device manufacturers, we develop and implement solutions for defined applications. As part of the Heraeus Group, we support the professional development of our employees and offer opportunities for career development, depending on the role, location and operational conditions.

To reach our vision of improving 100 million lives every year, we foster a culture of curiosity that thrives on challenge, continuous learning, growth, and the opportunity to try new things. With sites in the United States, European Union, and Asia, and over 2,200 employees worldwide, together, we will meet tomorrow's challenges today.

 
**Position Summary**
 
The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of advanced manufacturing technology across the Americas manufacturing network, including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing. This role owns the design, development, validation, implementation, and maintenance of automated manufacturing equipment, assembly systems, robotics, vision inspection technologies, digital manufacturing solutions, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment that support the production of medical devices. The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering role builds and leads a team of engineering professionals across these disciplines, sets technical direction and standards, and partners closely with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and Supply Chain to advance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across multiple sites.
 
**This is an onsite position at the White Bear Lake, MN location with travel to other global manufacturing sites.**
 
**What You’ll Do Every Day:**
 

* Develop and execute the advanced manufacturing engineering roadmap (including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing) aligned with business objectives.
* Establish long-term technology strategies to support manufacturing capacity expansion, cost reduction, and product quality improvement across the manufacturing network.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities for implementation, including robotics, AI-enabled inspection systems, Industry 4.0/digital manufacturing applications, advanced controls, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment.
* Lead capital equipment planning and investment strategy across automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing initiatives.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, and external technology partners to enhance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
* Direct a team responsible for automation engineering, controls engineering, robotics, machine vision, electrical engineering, digital manufacturing/manufacturing systems integration, and additive manufacturing.
* Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams through coaching, performance management, and talent development, while establishing engineering standards, best practices, and design methodologies across advanced manufacturing disciplines.
* Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including selection, training and development, assigning work, and performance management of employees.
* Manage complex, multidisciplinary engineering projects from concept through implementation, delivering on time and within budget while meeting technical and quality requirements, and communicate progress and issues clearly to leadership to support project and site objectives.
* Manage external automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing integrators, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
* Develop and control departmental operating and capital budgets; establish project schedules, resource plans, and cost controls.
* Other duties may be assigned as required.

 
**What We’re Looking For:**
 

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field required; Master’s degree in Engineering, MBA, or related discipline preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in automated manufacturing environments; experience in digital manufacturing and/or additive manufacturing strongly preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams.
* Experience within medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Proven success leading large-scale automation, digital manufacturing, and/or additive manufacturing projects and capital equipment installations.
* Experience with equipment validation and regulatory compliance in FDA-regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams across multiple sites and drive continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel across the Americas manufacturing network (White Bear Lake, MN; Costa Rica; Puerto Rico), approximately 25-50% of the time.

 
*Medevio is committed to providing competitive total compensation and benefits packages. The expected hiring range for this position is between $160,000 and $190,000 based upon a full-time schedule. This is a good faith estimate on the applicable range. Base salaries are determined by taking a variety of factors in account, including, but not limited to, candidate qualifications, geographic locations, market conditions and internal equity. This position is bonus eligible, with a target bonus of 20%. Our total compensation package includes eligibility for comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, education reimbursement, paid parental leave and paid time off.*
 

**Curious? Apply now!**

Heraeus is proud to be an employer that provides equal access to opportunities for all its employees. We provide fair and equal consideration to all qualified applicants, regardless of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other legally protected characteristic. A diverse and inclusive culture is at the heart of our Vision, Mission, and Values. We are dedicated to cultivating a workforce that reflects a broad spectrum of cultures, backgrounds, and perspectives.

We participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility after hire. Learn more at www.e-verify.gov

**Any further questions?**

If you need any assistance or have questions, please contact hrdirect-americas@heraeus.com or visit our website at jobs.heraeus.com.

records.title: Manufacturing Engineering Director
records.description:
The Figeac Aero Group has multiple locations across the world. Figeac Aero North America, located in Wichita, Kansas in the heart of the country, is a leading aerospace partner for detailed parts and sub-assemblies with specialization in saturation shot peening, shot peen forming, chemical processing, painting, assembly, non-destructive testing, and machining.

At Figeac Aero North America, we place a high value on our employees. Employees are given the opportunity to be a part of something special while achieving their career goals. We offer competitive compensation as a smaller company in addition to an attractive benefits package for qualified employees.

***Manufacturing Engineering Director***

***Salary****: $90,000 - $120,000*

**Experience:** 8+ years in Manufacturing Engineering discipline in Aerospace environment.

**Job Duties:**

* Responsible for coordinating and executing activities around the following: Leading technical teams in the improvement of current processes, transitioning new statements of work, being the focal point of communication between quality, operations, NC Programming and Planning.
* Monitor and enforce adherence to internal processes and standards to ensure a consistent product to the manufacturing floor.
* Collaborate with NC Programming, operations and Manufacturing Engineering on tool and fixture design.
* Review first part runs with Quality, Operations and NC Programming to verify a conforming part and acceptable manufacturing process.
* Mentoring and training of new Manufacturing Engineers/Planners.
* Interface with customer base to resolve engineering issues.
* Investigate and resolve manufacturing issues related to low profitability or excessive scrap.
* Engagement at the estimating stage on strategic packages to review engineering design and productivity concerns.
* Shop support and guidance on first article builds to ensure engineering compliance and manufacturing process design effectiveness.
* Provides planning, direction, and coordination for all technical activities while monitors performance to estimates, budgets and organization goals.
* Participates in developing organization and department goals and objectives.

records.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality
records.description:
At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together.

 

The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: *we come together*, *we always look for a better way*, and *we create possibilities*.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must be able to maintain such authorization without current or future employer or school sponsorship. GE Appliances will not sponsor employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

Interested in joining us on our journey?

 
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality leads a team supporting the execution of short-term and long term projects focused on product and process quality improvement. The role supports front-line leadership and development of both salary and hourly team members in support of the factory Manufacturing Control Plans. The role is responsible for working cross-functionally to execute the overall goal for reducing the cost of poor quality associated with plant operations and product performance post-sale.

**Position**
------------

Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality

**Location**
------------

USA, Louisville, KY

**How You'll Create Possibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Live, promote and support the Appliance Production System (APS) philosophy and drive continuous improvement in the quality and adjacent areas. Coach all team members to ensure cross-functional, focused collaboration is the way we work.
* Partner with the Quality Improvement Engineering, Business Operations and Manufacturing Engineering Leaders to promote a culture that establishes, sustains and improves product quality through engineering problem solving and discipline around supporting systems. Promote a method-based quick response to new issues.
* Responsible for developing and tracking team performance metrics tied to the overall factory (FPY, EOLA, Scrap) and effect to the product line financial plan (Damage, Scrap). Leads the team to complete projects and tasks supporting this effort. Owns and assigns tasks and establishes accountability at the appropriate level.
* Closely collaborates with the product line Engineering, Field Quality and Service organizations to understand and respond to part or system product level performance issues impacting owner use and satisfaction. Responds to this data in addition to internal data streams (leading indicators) for product quality and reliability (Engineering, EOLA and audit labs).
* Identify and execute projects to improve the cost of operations. Serve as a broad owner for Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA), Corrective Action Request (CAR) approach to problem solving.
* Owner of the execution of attributes of the Manufacturing Control Plan for broad areas. Responsible for the training, execution, auditing and improvement of the Manufacturing Quality Control Plan. Support efforts intended to improve workstation documentation process; create, update and maintain Manufacturing Control Instructions (MCI’s), visual aid and alerts (single point lessons) as needed.
* Strong technical aptitude and ability to coach others in complex engineering topics like dimensional control, material properties, failure analysis as well as emerging technologies such as AI
* Support analysis of data as part of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and implementation of responses as required by MCI/MCP. Escalate and measure response to data trends. Validate root cause response for effectiveness.
* Lead and support 1x1 problem solving for quality systems and related issues collaborate cross functionally to improve product quality through the identification and elimination of root cause of issues. Focus on overall repair efficiency.

**What You'll Bring to Our Team**
---------------------------------

* 8+ Years of successful experience in Manufacturing / Quality, focused on providing operational support to support operations and vertical manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated expertise in a combination of Metrology, CMM or 3D scanning of complicated assemblies
* Ability to work within large cross-functional teams and at multiple levels in the organization.
* Demonstrated excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrated experience as a hands-on problem solver including complex systems (supply, build, testing and diagnosis)
* Demonstrated leadership during technically challenging and complicated cross functional projects/tasks

**Desired Characteristics**

* Engineering degree with strong content tied to understanding and impact to business financial performance
* Quality Leadership experience
* Prior experience in a union environment
* Strong organizational skills- focused on project and resource management

### **Working Conditions**

### 

* Working conditions are normal for a high-volume manufacturing environment.
* Working in this environment will occasionally require the use of safety equipment to include but not limited to: eye safety glasses, hearing protectors, work boots, and hardhats.
* These roles require frequent walking in a manufacturing plant environment.
* Travel (up to 10%) to suppliers and other manufacturing locations as needed.
* This position will be located in Louisville, KY.
* Hours & Weekends: Working off-shift and weekends may be required.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Our work is centered on our People and Culture as reflected in our Zero Distance philosophy and we recognize the importance of reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and diversity (I&D). This underscores our commitment to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, connected, and empowered to contribute, while positioning our organization to adapt seamlessly to the evolving needs of our workforce and communities. 
 
This reflects our dedication to creating solutions that: Empower colleagues by fostering an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and encouraged to contribute. Strengthen communities where we live and work. Reinforce a culture of belonging, purpose, and engagement. Reflect the diversity of the communities we serve through our workforce, products, and practices. 
 
By further embedding Zero Distance into our People and Culture framework, we will continue to build a deeply connected organization. We are cultivating a culture of engagement, belonging, and connection, because while attracting new talent remains a priority, retention is a cornerstone of our strategy.

GE Appliances is a trust-based organization. It is important we offer our employees the flexibility they need to do their best work while balancing the needs of the business and individuals. When you join GE Appliances, you will have the opportunity to work with your leader to create a flexible work arrangement that balances the needs of the individual, team, and organization.

GE Appliances is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Appliances participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S

*If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance or an accommodation to use our website or to apply, please send an e-mail* *to ask.recruiting@geappliances.com*
