records.title: Director of Operations, Service Delivery
records.description:
**About LawnStarter**

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, spanning three brands: LawnStarter, Lawn Love, and Home Gnome. We've cleared $750M in bookings and turned a profit three years running. Founded in Austin in 2013, we're a team of about 180 that scales past 500 employees during peak season. The marketplace itself is easy to describe and hard to run well: a customer requests a service, we price the job and match it to an eligible Pro, the Pro claims and completes the work, and we process payment and take a commission.

We're entering the most ambitious stretch in the company's history as we build new verticals, new software products, and the groundwork to become a multi-billion-dollar company.

One of our company values is AI or Extinction: every task, AI-first. No exceptions, no excuses. Top 1% or we're already a fossil. This role is hired against that bar.

**The Role**

This is a biz ops generalist role, built for someone who wants to work across many parts of the business instead of owning one narrow lane. You'll start as an individual contributor with no direct reports, in a new seat reporting directly to the COO. Your first owned area will be building Service Delivery into a working operational function. This will entail adding structure, visibility and process to the way we ensure as many customer jobs as possible are completed successfully and on time by LawnStarter Pros, in lawn care and other services we offer now and over time.

New projects will show up unscoped over time. That's by design. As LawnStarter enters new verticals and grows toward a multi-billion-dollar future, big problems will keep surfacing with no obvious owner, and you'll be one of the people the COO trusts to run them down.

**What makes this role different:**

* You work on some of the biggest company-wide projects, cutting across teams and functional areas.
* You'll be a top builder in Brain, LawnStarter's internal AI toolkit built on Claude Code that already powers everything we do across the company: metric queries, document drafting, bug triage, and more. We expect you to approach your work in an AI-first fashion, leveraging Brain to build new systems and processes that will push the limits of how fast AI can accelerate business results. Every project you run is built AI-first: the analysis, the tooling, the process automation, the monitoring. You build it yourself instead of waiting on an analyst or engineer.
* You own outcomes end to end, from recommendation through execution. Strategy without follow-through doesn't count here.

**What You'll Own**

* **Service Delivery, from the ground up.** Despite LawnStarter's considerable scale and reach, Service Delivery doesn't exist yet as a dedicated function. You'll help define the standards we should meet for job completion rates and speed, measure whether we hit them, and design processes, incentives and real-time interventions that get tested with Pros and customers in the field to lift performance. Scope covers every vertical and every delivery model, from today's 1099 Pros to potential W-2 crews under future evaluation.
* **Raising customer & Pro retention rates.** When we deliver service with excellence, Pros and customers alike stay with us longer. Working tightly with peers across Product, Data and Support, you'll identify new opportunities for us to boost retention and LTV and play a key role in driving resulting initiatives cross-functionally.
* **Whatever comes next.** New projects will land on your plate as the company grows into new verticals and builds new software products. You'll take them from "we should look into this" to building and then running systems with structure, KPIs and owners.

**Problems to Solve**

**Build a Service Delivery function that doesn't exist yet.** Right now, no one formally owns whether LawnStarter delivers the service it promises. You'll define the standard for what a Pro should deliver, then build the agents and pipelines that measure adherence to it and run the tests that change behaviors and outcomes in the field.

**Move metrics.** Leverage systems thinking and AI expertise to drive business results that sit across various functional teams. That means untangling handoffs where several teams touch a problem or goal and no one team owns the outcome.

**Take unscoped problems from ideas to fully-running and automated systems.** Some of the most important work here hasn't been named yet. At some point, someone will raise a fuzzy, unframed problem and say it needs attention. Your job is to take that starting point and build whatever tooling or process it needs, at record speed, and hand back something that runs, with a clear owner and quantitative targets attached.

**What Success Looks Like (Year 1)**

* Service Delivery is a working function with a defined (and elevated) service standard, a way to measure adherence to it, clear SOPs, and an intervention and incentive playbook that's been tested and proven to lift results.
* At least one project nobody had scoped a year earlier has gone from "we should look into this" to a heavily-automated, running system with a named owner and tracked KPIs.
* Tools you built with AI are in daily use by people other than you, and the way you work has raised the bar for how the company uses AI.
* The COO can hand you a gray-area problem with no playbook and trust that what comes back is data, a recommendation, and a plan to execute it.

 
**Requirements**

**Who You Are**

**An elite AI builder.** You think in terms of agentic systems. Building agents, evals, context engineering, and thinking in guardrails are core to who you are. You keep up with the frontier and put new capabilities to work within days, not quarters. You'd be in the top few percent of AI users at any company you've worked at. Someone who treats AI as an occasional assistant, or needs an engineer to build tooling for them, isn't the right fit here.

**A zero-to-one operator.** You've taken ambiguous, cross-team operating problems from zero to running systems as an individual contributor, with no team to hand the work to. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your experience stops at executing a scope someone else already defined.

**Marketplace-tested.** You've operated inside a marketplace or another multi-sided business and felt firsthand what it takes to balance the needs of different stakeholders on the supply and demand sides. A background built entirely on single-sided businesses, with one stakeholder type to satisfy, won't translate here.

**A finisher.** Executing what you recommend matters as much to you as the recommendation itself. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you treat strategy as your job and execution as someone else's.

**A partner who can help drive strategy collaboratively.** You work well with people who don't report to you and are a savvy cross-departmental collaborator on priorities and sequencing. If you need formal authority to effect change, this role isn't for you.

**Data-driven by reflex.** You'd rather build the query or the dashboard than argue from a hunch. This is unlikely to be a good fit if, when ambiguity hits, your first move is to guess and move on instead of digging for the number.

**At home in unresolved ambiguity.** Scope shifts as priorities do, and problems arrive unframed more often than not. That's the norm here, not an exception.

**Degree** in analytics, business or related field, with **7+ years of experience** in marketplace operations or equivalent roles.

**This Role Is NOT**

* **A people-management role.** There's no team to build or manage, at least not to start.
* **A strategy-only seat.** You'll execute what you recommend, not hand it off to someone else to run.
* **A fit for anyone who isn't already an elite AI builder.** The AI bar on this team isn't aspirational; it's the baseline we hire against.

 
**Benefits**

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Base salary**: $175,000 to $200,000.
* **Equity component**: We want the person who takes this role invested in LawnStarter delivering excellent service, and in how far AI-first operating carries this company.
* **Healthcare**: Medical, dental, and vision.
* **Fully remote (US)**: All of LawnStarter is remote. This role demands deep independent work and close partnership across a distributed, multi-country team.
* **Flexible time off**: We focus on results. Take what you need.

*LawnStarter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We comply with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.*

records.title: Global Director, Supplier Quality
records.description:
**Job Title:** Global Director, Supplier Quality

**Job Location:** Southfield, MI

**What we offer:**

VeoneerSafety Systemsis the world leader in Automotive Electronic Safety Systems. Veoneer’s scalable, best-in-class restraint control systems are mitigating the effects of a car crash. To date, we have delivered more than 1 billion devices to car manufacturers globally.
 
 
Veoneer Safety Systems has an international and collaborative team of 2,700 employees in 11 countries. We empower our people and are dedicated to their professional development and growth*.* 
 
Veoneer Safety Systems – Protect Everyone in Every Crash.

**What you'll do:**

The Global Director of Supplier Quality leads the global SQ organization, setting strategy, standards, and accountability for supplier readiness, performance, and continuous improvement.

The role combines global Supplier Quality leadership (80%) with North America Engineering Quality and Operational Quality leadership (20%).

**Key Responsibilities for Supplier Quality** (80% of role)

**Strategic Leadership & Global Deployment**

* Set global SQ strategy aligned with corporate, customer, sourcing, and manufacturing objectives.
* Define and execution of Supplier Quality Policies, Standards, Processes, Methods and Systems.
* Owner of Veoneer Supplier Manual (VSM), Supplier Quality Project (SQP) – APQP & PPAP, Supplier Non-Conformance Material (NCM) Management.
* Align cross-functional priorities, resources, and accountability; establish SQE oversight of workload, open issues, owners, overdue actions, and escalations.
* Monitor supplier quality targets, initiatives and indicators to ensure compliance to Veoneer Supplier Quality related policies, standards and reporting.

**Supplier Development & Standards Compliance**

* Oversee new supplier assessment, qualification, and development with Purchasing and Engineering; improve assessment models and ensure teams close risks and capability gaps before sourcing and production approval.
* Set common supplier requirements, risk-based audit and development expectations, and change controls; ensure existing suppliers improve capability and sustain company and customer compliance.
* Representing quality in Supplier Sourcing Board.

**Supplier Performance & Major Quality Issues**

* Lead major supplier escalations with supplier executives and cross-functional teams, ensuring containment, exposure assessment, production and customer protection, and verified permanent corrective actions.
* Drive common KPIs and improvement targets for supplier PPM, repeat defects, corrective-action aging, disruptions.
* Require leadership reviews and improvement plans for systemic issues, sharing lessons learned across suppliers.
* Supplier Scorecard (VS051 rating) and drive continuous improvement for supplier quality performance.

**Supplier APQP / PPAP & Safe Launch**

* Ensure on time and effective supplier APQP, PPAP, and Safe Launch for new programs, suppliers, and changes, including risk reviews, capability verification, and readiness-gap closure before production release.

**Quality Tools, Talent Development & Training**

* Set expectations for consistent SQE application of core quality tools, process audits, and structured problem solving to strengthen prevention and corrective-action effectiveness.
* Assess global SQ team capabilities and set development priorities with regional managers to strengthen technical expertise, expand skills, and build future leaders through training, mentoring, and succession planning.
* Supplier Quality talent review and succession plan.

**Regional Leadership: Engineering Quality & Operational Quality** (20% of role)

* Represent Quality Leadership team in regional activities across RDE, Manufacturing and Supplier Quality teams.
* Align regional priorities, governance, performance reviews, and escalations with global Engineering Quality and Operational Quality leaders and standards.
* Guide development and launch readiness, quality system execution, major issue resolution, and lessons learned while retaining local execution accountability.

**What you'll bring:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in engineering.

**Experience:** Minimum 15 years in supplier quality, including supplier qualification, development, major issue resolution, and talent development. Electronics experience required; automotive SQ experience strongly preferred. Experience leading a multinational organization is preferred.

**Skills:**

* Global SQ leadership and effective matrix-team management.
* Cross-functional influence, supplier executive engagement, and timely decision-making.
* Strong supplier APQP, PPAP, change management, and Safe Launch knowledge.
* Advanced PFMEA, control plan, MSA, SPC, capability, audit, and 8D expertise; proven data-driven problem resolution and daily management.
* Strong commodity expertise for IC, PCB and/or mechanical parts is preferred.
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones.
* Experience in other Quality domains is preferred

**Location:** Physical location Markham, Ontario, Canada or Southfield, Michigan; global scope across North America, Europe, India, and Asia.

**Travel:** International travel will be required 8-10 times per year.

**Reporting / Collaboration:**

* Reports to SVP Manufacturing & Quality.
* Solid-line responsibility for tech-center SQEs; dotted-line functional leadership of plant SQEs, with plant leadership retaining local operational accountability.
* Partners with Purchasing, Operations, Engineering, Industrialization, Program Management, and supplier leadership.

records.description:
**Date Posted:**

2026-11-13

**Country:**

United States of America

**Location:**

US-CT-EAST HARTFORD-OBG ~ 400 Main St ~ BLDG OBG

**Position Role Type:**

Hybrid

**U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:**

U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are authorized to access information under this program/contract.

**Security Clearance Type:**

None/Not Required

**Security Clearance Status:**

Not Required

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

 

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

**What You Will Do**:

We are in search of a **17/24K Industrial Manager, Production Chief** who will be managing, reviewing, and approving Engineering Change Industrialization. The 17/24K Industrial Manager, Production Chief will be key team member within our 17/24K EC Industrial Team of the 17/24K Production Chief Office.

 

Reporting to the Deputy Production Chief, 17/24K EC Industrialization Associate Director, the role will be focusing on program management, industrialization of engineering changes, business process development, and detailed analysis to support program needs.

The 17/24K Industrial Manager, Production Chief will be instrumental in the achievement of Program milestones through alignment of Engineering, Operations, and Supply Chain organizational plans and initiatives to Program and Customer priorities and commitments.

 

* Deliver executive presentations and program reporting on deliveries, risks, and industrial initiatives.
* Support communications, cross-functional alignment, industrial risk identification, and risk mitigation efforts for 17/24K programs.
* Participate in GTF PIPTs on behalf of the 17/24K programs.
* Collaborate with Mod Center, GSC, and cross-functional leaders on planning and execution of critical industrial actions to rate readiness for our programs.
* Leading continuous improvement activities to improve key processes; coordinate, organize, and lead critical industrial initiatives for engineering changes to minimize disruption to OEM and MRO operations
* Support MIPT and IPMT meetings for key engineering changes; present and align industrial content for critical customers
* Track and realign block changes for 24k program
* Champion MRL progression and productivity tasks
* Serve as the primary liaison for the Production Chiefs, ensuring effective communication and smooth execution across the PCIR process
* Partner closely with CAT 1 supplier to maintain alignment and drive successful incorporation planning
* Role involves travel up to 10%

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Bachelor's degree and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience in an engineering, manufacturing operations, continuous improvement or related environment OR a Master's degree and minimum 5 years experience in an engineering, manufacturing operations, continuous improvement or related environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
* Experience working in a fluctuating environment with constantly shifting priorities
* Demonstrated ability to critically assess industrial production schedules, qualification requirements and develop risk mitigations to drive successful program execution.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience using SAP
* Knowledge of the PCIR process
Working knowledge of continuous improvement principles (e.g. lean manufacturing, CORE, QCPC) 

 

**Learn More & Apply Now:**

Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. This position is classified as:

**Onsite:** Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

***As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.***

The salary range for this role is 107,500 USD - 204,500 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

*RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.*

**Privacy Policy and Terms:**

records.title: Executive Director / Vice President of Quality
records.description:
**Executive Director / VP of Quality**

I’m partnering exclusively with a growing Pharmaceutical Company looking to bring on a Vice President of Quality to lead its entire site Quality organisation, reporting directly to the CEO.

This is a senior, high-impact leadership opportunity for an established Quality executive to shape the site's Quality strategy, strengthen regulatory compliance and build a scalable Quality organisation as the business enters its next phase of growth and investment.

The successful individual will have oversight of both Quality Assurance and Quality Control, with significant influence across manufacturing operations, regulatory affairs, product development and wider business strategy. This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of the Quality function, work closely with executive leadership and help drive the business forward while maintaining the highest standards of product quality and patient safety.

**Key areas of responsibility:**

* Set the overall Quality vision, objectives and priorities for the site, leading both QA and QC and ensuring the function supports business growth, operational performance and regulatory compliance.
* Act as the senior Quality representative to the FDA, leading inspections, maintaining inspection readiness, managing regulatory responses and overseeing sustainable remediation where required.
* Own the effectiveness and continuous improvement of the site QMS, ensuring systems remain robust, risk-based and aligned with evolving regulatory expectations.
* Provide executive oversight of batch release, deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change control, complaints, supplier quality, document control and data integrity, maintaining appropriate independent Quality decision-making.
* Oversee analytical and microbiological testing, OOS investigations, stability programmes, laboratory systems, environmental monitoring and associated compliance requirements.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Operations, Regulatory Affairs, R&D and Engineering to provide Quality oversight across product development, technology transfer, validation, commercial manufacturing and post-market activities.
* Establish meaningful Quality metrics, lead management reviews and use trend analysis, root-cause investigations and risk-based decision-making to address systemic issues and improve site performance.
* Build, lead and develop a high-performing Quality organisation, establishing the appropriate structure, technical capabilities, succession planning and resources to support the site's future needs.
* Work directly with the CEO and wider leadership team, translating complex regulatory requirements and Quality risks into practical business decisions while protecting compliance and patient safety.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 12+ years of progressive experience within pharmaceutical manufacturing, with substantial Quality leadership experience in sterile pharmaceutical products.
* Proven executive-level leadership across multidisciplinary Quality organisations, ideally with responsibility for both QA and QC.
* A strong track record of leading FDA inspections, managing regulatory interactions and driving successful inspection readiness and remediation programmes.
* In-depth knowledge of US pharmaceutical cGMP requirements, particularly 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211, with familiarity with relevant medical device regulations.
* Broad expertise across QMS, CAPA, validation and qualification, laboratory operations, supplier quality, complaints, risk management and data integrity.
* Experience supporting products throughout the lifecycle, from development and regulatory submissions through commercial manufacturing, release and post-market activities.
* Demonstrated success building Quality teams, developing future leaders and embedding a culture of accountability, compliance and continuous improvement.
* The ability to operate as a strategic business partner to executive leadership while maintaining the independence and authority required of the Quality function.
* A degree in a relevant scientific or technical discipline is required.

Apply today to learn more or reach out directly with your CV to rbanton@barringtonjames.com

records.title: VP Quality - Healthcare Technology
records.description:
**Role Summary**

Lead the enterprise quality strategy for a regulated health care organization. Build, lead, and mature quality systems that drive the performance of products and services and the teams that develop them, while ensuring regulatory compliance and driving continuous improvement. Use data and analytics to make quality measurable and predictive.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the enterprise quality management system (QMS)
* Own quality control (QC) and quality assurance (QA) across operations, and ensure readiness for audits and inspections
* Build and lead a high-performing quality organization, including hiring, coaching, and succession planning
* Partner with the executive team and board on quality, risk, and compliance performance
* Drive process improvement using Lean, Six Sigma, and the 7 quality tools
* Apply FMEA and risk-based approaches to proactively identify and reduce failure modes
* Establish quality metrics, dashboards, and advanced analytics to identify trends and predict issues
* Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous learning

**Required Qualifications**

* 10-15 years of progressive experience building, leading, and maturing quality systems in complex regulatory and health environments
* Proven experience in both quality control and quality assurance practices
* Practical experience with the 7 quality tools, the Toyota Production System, or Lean Six Sigma toolsets
* Experience using data and advanced analytics to drive decisions
* Strong knowledge of applicable health care regulations and accreditation standards
* Demonstrated executive presence, with the ability to influence across clinical, operational, and regulatory stakeholders
* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, engineering, or health-related field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with FMEA or Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP)
* Process or chemical engineering background
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt, or ASQ certification (CQE, CMQ/OE)
* Master’s degree or MBA
* Experience with predictive modeling, statistical process control, or quality data platforms

**Core Competencies**

Strategic thinking, regulatory judgment, data-driven decision-making, change leadership, and clear communication.

records.title: VP of Manufacturing & Operations
records.description:
For more than three decades, Design West Technologies Inc. has been a trusted Department of War (DoW) partner, delivering mission-critical engineering and rugged manufacturing solutions supporting our nation's warfighters. Building on this defense heritage, DWT is embracing a growth-oriented, start-up culture aligned with evolving DoW opportunities. Based in Tustin, CA, DWT seeks an experienced Vice President of Manufacturing & Operations to lead manufacturing, production, supply chain, facilities, and operational functions. The ideal candidate brings proven aerospace, defense, or complex manufacturing leadership experience, combining strategic vision with hands-on execution to drive growth, organizational transformation, operational excellence, and accountability.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
As VP of Manufacturing & Operations, you will provide strategic leadership while maintaining hands-on engagement across daily manufacturing execution, production performance, and operational priorities. You will develop and scale DWT's manufacturing capabilities, integrating people, processes, technology, and resources to drive operational excellence and sustainable growth. You will have executive accountability for manufacturing performance, P&L, capacity, supply chain, quality, safety, and customer delivery while ensuring operational capabilities support current and future business objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Manufacturing & Operations Excellence**

* Lead manufacturing functions, including production, planning, engineering, facilities, maintenance, and warehouse operations.
* Scale manufacturing capabilities, capacity, and infrastructure to support new program launches, increased customer demand, and long-term business growth.
* Drive operational excellence through Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and 5S, improving throughput, productivity, automation, equipment utilization, and capacity while establishing KPIs, corrective actions, and scalable processes.

**Supply Chain Management**

* Lead Supply Chain, Procurement, and Production Planning to ensure alignment with business objectives and customer commitments.
* Optimize procurement, supplier performance, material availability, lead times, and inventory while controlling excess and obsolete materials.
* Align production schedules with customer demand, program requirements, and manufacturing capacity while strengthening supply chain resilience through proactive risk mitigation

**Quality, Safety & Compliance**

* Partner with Quality and Engineering leadership to ensure manufacturing processes meet customer, regulatory, and quality requirements while promoting safety and accountability.
* Ensure compliance with AS9100, ISO 9001, ITAR, OSHA, and government-contracting requirements while driving audit readiness, corrective actions, defect reduction, and continuous improvement.

**Financial & Business Strategy**

* Own manufacturing P&L performance, including operating budgets, financial forecasts, labor costs, cost controls, capital expenditures, margins, and profitability, ensuring financial accountability and alignment with business objectives.
* Partner with the President and Finance leadership on operating plans, financial forecasts, capital investments, and performance metrics.
* Drive margin improvement through operational efficiency, automation, resource optimization, and process redesign while supporting strategic growth and business expansion.

**Cross-Functional & Organizational Leadership**

* Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to align operational priorities, resources, and manufacturing objectives with business strategy.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Program Management to support production readiness, program execution, customer commitments, and new business opportunities.
* Build high-performing teams through clear accountability, coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and leadership development while fostering collaboration, trust, and continuous improvement.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or related field.
* 12–15+ years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience, including at least five years in senior leadership overseeing multiple functions.
* Proven experience managing complex manufacturing operations, P&L, budgets, capital investments, production planning, capacity, quality, delivery, and supply chain.
* Demonstrated success in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, operational strategy, business growth, organizational transformation, and cross-functional leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in aerospace, defense, electronics, precision, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments, preferably involving PCBA, microelectronics, ruggedized electronics, cable and harness assemblies, or complex electromechanical products.
* Experience scaling operations, integrating acquisitions, or leading organizational transformation. MBA, Master's degree, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification preferred.

**Are you ready to join our team?**
At DWT, we value teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement as we build for the future.
  
  
We are an
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**
including disability/Vets

**Group Presentation**

thyssenkrupp is an international industrial and technology group with more than 93,000 employees. In the fiscal year 2024/2025, the company generated sales of around €33 billion in 48 countries. Its business activities are bundled in five segments: Automotive Technology, Decarbon Technologies, Materials Services, Steel Europe and Marine Systems. With extensive technological know-how, outstanding engineering competence and a high level of innovative strength, the group develops solutions for the challenges of the future, especially in the fields of climate protection and energy transition, digital transformation in industry and mobility of the future.

To learn more about thyssenkrupp, please visit the following link: thyssenkrupp As An Employer - North America

**Company Presentation**

thyssenkrupp Dynamic Components is one of the world's automotive industry leading partners for development and manufacturing of highly complex, state-of-the-art drivetrain technologies for both combustion engines and electric motors. Worldwide, 10 locations with 3,800 employees produce over 25 million drivetrain components per year. The product portfolio includes camshafts and cylinder head cover modules for the valve train as well as rotor shafts for battery electric vehicles.

Our electrical A/C compressor, designed for the natural refrigerant CO
*2*
, sets new standards in efficient and sustainable thermal management.

With precision and passion, we are enabling our customers in the automotive industry to achieve their emission and sustainability targets for more than 30 years.

thyssenkrupp Presta Dynamic Components is proud to be Certified™ by
**Great Place To Work®**
. The prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at thyssenkrupp Presta Dynamic Components. This year, 82% of employees said it's a great place To Work - 25 points higher than the average U.S. company. Great Place To Work® is the global authority on workplace culture, employee experience, and the leadership behaviors proven to deliver market-leading revenue, employee retention and increased innovation.

**Your Responsibilities**

**Lead Quality Excellence in a Fast-Paced Manufacturing Environment**

We are seeking an experienced
**Head of Quality**
to lead our Quality organization and drive world-class performance across safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost objectives. This leadership role is responsible for overseeing the Quality Management System, developing quality strategies, leading customer and supplier quality initiatives, and driving continuous improvement throughout the organization.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and maintain the Quality Management System in compliance with IATF 16949 requirements.
* Develop and execute quality objectives, metrics, and improvement initiatives aligned with business goals.
* Manage customer and supplier quality activities, including audits, APQP, PPAP, launch readiness, corrective actions, and change management.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action efforts for internal and external quality issues.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product quality, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor and report key quality metrics, including scrap, rework, and overall quality performance.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to support production, new product launches, and supplier development.
* Build, develop, and lead high-performing quality teams.

**Success Competencies**

*The Head of Quality embodies the following competencies:*

* **Manages Complexity:**
  Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* **Decision Quality:**
  Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
* **Action Oriented:**
  Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy and enthusiasm.
* **Ensures Accountability:**
  Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
* **Drive Results:**
  Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
* **Develops Talent:**
  Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization's goals.
* **Builds Effective Teams:**
  Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspective to achieve common goals.
* **Communicates Effectively:**
  Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
* **Instills Trust:**
  Gaining the confidence and trust of others though honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
* **Manages Ambiguity:**
  Operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
* **Being Resilient:**
  Rebounding from setbacks and adversity when facing difficult situations.

**Supervisory Responsibility:**

Directly manages the Quality Department including the Quality Engineering, Quality Systems, Quality Planning, Quality Lab/ Gauging, Change and Series Management functions.

**Your Profile**

**Qualifications:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

* **Education:**
  A Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a related technical field is required, experience in Quality functions within the automotive industry or related areas.
* **Language:**
  Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers, OEMs, or employees of organization.
* **Technology:**
  Microsoft Office Suite knowledge; SAP/ERP knowledge preferred. Knowledge of IATF 16949, APQP-PPAP, FMEA, MSA, 8D, Statistics, GD&T and mechanical manufacturing processes.
* **Travel:**
  Occasional travel, up to 10% including international

records.title: Vice President, Operations
records.description:
**Description**

**Company & Job Overview**

Diality is a medical device company focused on developing solutions to improve lives impacted by kidney disease. Diality offers the Moda-flx Hemodialysis System, a user-friendly, mobile, and connected hemodialysis system designed to maximize clinical flexibility and ease-of-use for both clinical and non-clinical users. The Moda-flx Hemodialysis system combines flow rate capabilities of conventional in-center dialysis devices with a fully integrated reverse osmosis (RO) water filtration system to provide a broad range of prescriptions and meet the needs of any professional dialysis care setting.

The Vice President of Operations is a strategic executive responsible for leading the end-to-end operational strategy, including manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, and logistics. The ideal candidate will scale our production capabilities, optimize global supply chain resilience, and ensure uncompromising compliance with FDA, ISO 13485, and GMP regulations. This leader will bridge the gap between R&D, product development, and commercialization to deliver high-quality, cost-effective medical devices to the market

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in Operations leadership, particularly in a medical device, medical technology or biotechnology organization. They will possess deep expertise in talent management, organizational development, and workforce planning.

This position is an office-based position at the company’s Irvine, CA headquarters.

**Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Execution**

* Translate corporate vision into actionable operational strategies, setting short- and long-term objectives for scaling manufacturing and supply chain.
* Oversee Profit & Loss (P&L) for the operations division, managing budgets, and identifying areas for continuous cost optimization.
* Serve as a core member of the executive leadership team, collaborating cross-functionally with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial teams.

**Program Management**

* Lead end-to-end program execution across the organization, ensuring alignment with strategic goals and timelines
* Develop and implement standardized project management methodologies, tools, and reporting systems
* Monitor program performance metrics and proactively address risks, delays, and resource constraints

**Manufacturing & Supply Chain Management**

* Direct all manufacturing operations (internal facilities and/or outsourced/CMO partnerships), ensuring production schedules are met with the highest standards of safety and quality.
* Oversee global supply chain, procurement, and logistics, mitigating risks related to material shortages and distribution delays.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies to eliminate waste, reduce lead times, and improve manufacturing efficiency.

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. The VP, Global GMP Quality position will be responsible for leading the GMP quality functional teams at Mirum and its subsidiaries (US and International). This position will play a pivotal role in steering the organization toward an ongoing commitment to quality improvement, driving efforts to identify areas for optimization, innovation, and excellence. This person will be responsible for managing, mentoring and supporting a GMP Operations team of clinical and commercial Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) professionals. This person will provide leadership and hands-on support to ensure the seamless execution of GMP QA and QC functions, including product quality complaint investigation, root-cause investigations, and the reporting of critical GMP issues to executive management.  This person will also be responsible for leading, providing direction, resources, and guidance to ensure that all GMP quality processes are executed with the highest standards of compliance with FDA, EMA, and other international regulatory requirements, corporate objectives, and industry best practices. This role also involves ensuring that the GMP and GDP quality functions are closely aligned with the organization’s broader strategic goals, guaranteeing that quality initiatives support the company’s mission, vision, and operational objectives.

records.description:
At CompoSecure, we are redefining the future of payment card technology. As a global leader in premium metal payment cards and fintech solutions, we combine innovation with craftsmanship to deliver exceptional products for the world's leading financial institutions.
  
  
We're looking for talented individuals who share our passion for excellence and innovation.
  
  
**Position Overview**
This role provides senior leadership and ownership of the functions that safeguard product integrity and the operating environment: Quality, Compliance (Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Safety and regulatory conformance), Security, and Facilities. The position is accountable for ensuring that products consistently meet quality specifications, that operations remain fully compliant with regulatory and safety standards, that the site and its products are secure, and that facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment. The role establishes clear metrics and ownership across these areas and reports performance to senior leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Quality: Establish and maintain quality control protocols for raw materials, components, and finished products. Design inspection and testing processes and provide guidance on maintaining consistent quality from the beginning of production through final release. Lead Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, monitor quality metrics, and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to eliminate root causes of defects. Ensure conformance to customer, product, and industry specifications.
* Compliance: Ensure full compliance of operations with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and applicable safety standards in accordance with New Jersey law. Own audits, certifications, and documentation, and serve as the primary liaison with regulatory bodies, auditors, and customers on compliance matters. Identify potential risks and pitfalls (e.g., equipment failures or other disruptions) and develop strategies to mitigate these issues through process improvement, alternative suppliers of materials, or altered equipment.
* Security: Oversee physical and product security programs consistent with the company's trust and authentication mission. Establish and enforce protocols to protect raw materials, work-in-process, finished goods, and sensitive assets throughout the facility and supply chain. Ensure operations meet payment-industry and customer security requirements, and manage security personnel and access controls across all shifts.
* Accountability: Own the key performance indicators and reporting for quality, compliance, security, and facilities. Establish clear ownership, metrics, and dashboards, report performance to senior management, and foster a culture of accountability across the organization. Manage a team of approximately 35 people across 7 shifts supporting QA, Safety & Security.
* Facilities: Oversee facility operations, maintenance, and environmental health and safety of the buildings, grounds, and utilities. Ensure facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment, manage facility vendors and contractors, and lead facility-related capital projects, space planning, and safe-workplace initiatives.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations Management, or a related field.
* A minimum of 10–15 years (or more) of relevant experience in quality, compliance, and/or operations leadership in a high-volume manufacturing environment (Pharmaceutical, Semiconductor, Automotive, or secure/payment products) , with at least 5-10 years experience in managing teams across multiple shift in a 24/7 environment :
* Deep knowledge of quality management systems (ISO 9001, IATF 16949 for automotive, AS9100 for aerospace, etc.)
* Six Sigma / Lean methodologies (typically Black Belt or Master Black Belt level)
* Root cause analysis and CAPA (corrective and preventive action) processes
* Statistical process control (SPC) and data-driven decision making
* Supplier quality management and audit experience
* Very strong analytical skill set, including familiarity with quality and reliability tools (e.g., FMEA, SPC, Kaizen).
* Regulatory fluency:
* OSHA, EPA, ISO 14001 (environmental), ISO 45001 (occupational health & safety)
* Industrial hygiene and risk assessment methodologies
* Environmental compliance (emissions, waste management, hazmat handling)
* Process safety management
* Incident investigation and workers' compensation/claims oversight
* Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams required.
* Demonstrated experience in third party audits ( ISO , PCI, ....)
* Occasional travel to suppliers and partners.

**Preferred Skills And Qualifications**

* Quality certifications such as Black belt Six Sigma
* GHG Management
* Familiarity with ERP tools
* Experience in a secure payment, or otherwise highly regulated manufacturing environment.

**About CompoSecure**
CompoSecure, a GPGI business (NYSE: GPGI), is the leading manufacturer of Premium Metal Payment Cards and also offers best-in-class Authentication and Digital Asset solutions. The Company's offerings combine elegance, simplicity, and security to deliver exceptional experiences and peace of mind, enabling trust for millions of people around the globe. For more information, please visit
**www.CompoSecure.com**
and

.

records.title: Global Head of Quality
records.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

  

The Global Head of Quality provides strategic leadership and oversight of ProSciento's global Quality department, establishing the strategy, direction, governance, and priorities for the function. This role will oversee the Quality Management System (QMS) and ensures the organization maintains the highest standards of quality, regulatory compliance, and inspection readiness.

  

This role is accountable for establishing and advancing the company's quality strategy, Quality by Design and governance framework, and quality culture while ensuring compliance with applicable GxP regulations, FDA requirements, ISO standards, and other country specific, regional, and international regulatory requirements. The Global Head of Quality partners closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement, operational excellence, risk management, and organizational effectiveness while supporting ProSciento's strategic growth. Performs duties in accordance with ProSciento's values, policies, and procedures. Approximately 20% domestic and international travel is expected, with additional travel required based on business needs.

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

  
* Provides strategic leadership for ProSciento’s Quality department, establishing the vision, priorities, and organizational structure to support the company’s operations and business objectives.
  
* Accountable for the design, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations including GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP), FDA, ISO, data privacy requirements, and other local, national, and international requirements.
  
* Responsible to oversee the quality of Global CRO studies and local site CRU trials as well as hands on experience implementing and maintaining a strategic Quality by Design framework for both business units.
  
* Responsible for the definition, development, implementation, monitoring and continuous improvement of quality systems, processes, and Key Quality indicators (KQIs) to drive operational excellence and regulatory compliance.
  

  

  
* Oversees the Quality Event Management program, including deviations, CAPAs, change control, investigations, risk assessments, and process improvement initiatives. Chairs or delegates the CAPA Board and ensures timely resolution of quality issues.
  
* Directs internal, external, sponsor, vendor, and regulatory inspection readiness activities, including audit planning, execution, response management, and corrective action oversight.
  
* Partners with Vendor Management to oversee supplier qualification, vendor audits, performance monitoring, and quality risk mitigation.
  
* Leads Executive Quality Management Reviews, ensuring quality trends, compliance risks, audit outcomes, CAPAs, and quality metrics are routinely communicated to Executive Leadership with appropriate recommendations and mitigation strategies.
  
* Oversee the development, maintenance, and governance of Quality Management System documentation, including quality policies, SOPs, work instructions, controlled documents, training programs, equipment records, and electronic document management systems.
  
* Partners with Information Technology and business leaders to ensure computerized systems, electronic records, and applicable equipment are appropriately qualified, verified, or validated in accordance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  
* Establishes and promotes a culture of quality throughout the organization by providing strategic guidance, regulatory interpretation, and quality leadership across all functional departments.
  
* Maintains current knowledge of evolving global regulatory requirements, industry standards, and best practices, ensuring organizational policies and procedures remain compliant and effective.
  
* Builds, develops, and leads a high-performing Quality organization by fostering employee development, succession planning, collaboration, accountability, and a culture aligned with ProSciento's core values.
  
* Serves as the senior quality representative for regulatory agencies, sponsors, auditors, and executive leadership on matters relating to quality systems, compliance, and inspection readiness.
  

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

  

  
* Provides leadership and oversight for the Quality organization, including workforce planning, organizational design, recruitment, employee development, performance management, succession planning, coaching, and employee engagement.
  
* Establishes departmental objectives, allocates resources, and ensures the Quality organization effectively supports ProSciento's strategic and operational priorities.
  

  

**QUALIFICATIONS & EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:**

  

**Qualifications:**

  

To perform this job successfully an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Systems, or Regulatory Compliance within the CRO or clinical research industry, including at least 5 years in senior quality leadership roles with responsibility for organizational quality strategy and personnel management with a minimum of 3 years of Global experience.
  
* Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant experience will be considered.
  

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND COMPETENCIES REQUIREMENTS:**

  

**Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:**

  

  
* Extensive knowledge of Quality Management Systems and quality governance, with demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and continuously improving quality systems within clinical research and regulated environments.
  
* Comprehensive knowledge of applicable global regulatory requirements and industry standards, including FDA regulations, ICH Guidelines, GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP), ISO 9001, data integrity, and applicable privacy requirements. Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and continuously improving Quality Management Systems (QMS) supporting GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP) environments and clinical research operations.
  
* Demonstrated experience leading regulatory inspections, sponsor and internal audits, supplier qualification programs, CAPA governance, inspection readiness, and enterprise quality risk management.
  
* Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing quality organizations, while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  
* Proven strategic leadership, organizational planning, and change management skills, with the ability to partner with executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to establish quality strategies and organizational priorities.
  
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and risk assessment capabilities.
  
* Strong communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across all organizational levels.
  
* Experience leading regulatory inspections, sponsor interactions, and quality governance forums.
  
* Ability to balance strategic leadership with operational execution in a dynamic, fast-paced organization.
  
* Proficiency with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), document management systems, quality metrics, and computerized system validation principles.
  

  

**Language Skills:**

  

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to interpret complex regulations, prepare executive reports, develop policies and procedures, and effectively communicate with regulatory agencies, sponsors, auditors, executive leadership, and employees.

  

**Reasoning Skills:**

  

Ability to analyze complex regulatory and operational issues, exercise sound judgment, assess organizational risk, and develop practical, compliant solutions in a dynamic business environment.

  

**Computer Skills:**

  

Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and experience with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), document management systems, learning management systems, audit management tools, and computerized system validation principles. Ability to quickly learn new software applications.

  

**CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT**

  

Verification of educational requirements, employment history, professional references, and certifications/training and U.S. work authorization.

  

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL EFFORT**

  

  
* Work is primarily performed in a professional office environment and may be conducted onsite, remotely, or in a hybrid work arrangement based on business needs and management approval.
  
* Occasional domestic and international travel may be required to support audits, regulatory inspections, client meetings, and business operations.
  

  

The above job description does not imply these outlined duties are the only duties performed by this employee. The incumbent is expected to perform other related duties necessary for the effective operation of the department and company.

  

ProSciento reserves the right to change or alter any of the above duties and responsibilities according to the operational needs of the department and company.

  

ProSciento is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

records.title: VP, Inventory Control & Quality Assurance
records.description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.
  
  
By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.
  
  
With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.
  
  
Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.
  
  
**About The Role**
Stord is looking for a Vice President of Quality to build and lead the quality function across our fulfillment network.
  
  
This leader will own the systems, standards, and operating mechanisms that ensure inventory is accurate, processes are followed, and every order moves through our network the way it was designed to. The mandate spans the full lifecycle of inventory inside our buildings from inbound receipt and putaway through picking, packing, sorting, and outbound shipment.
  
  
This is an independent quality function. While our Operations teams are responsible for delivering volume efficiently, the VP of Quality is responsible for ensuring we never achieve speed, growth, or cost improvements by compromising inventory integrity or execution quality.
  
  
This leader should be an inventory and fulfillment quality expert at heart — someone who understands how inventory moves through a complex fulfillment operation, knows where process breakdowns create downstream failures, and is relentless about identifying and eliminating root causes.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Inventory Health & Accuracy**

* Own inventory health and accuracy across Stord's fulfillment network.
* Establish the standards, controls, and operating mechanisms required to maintain book-to-floor and floor-to-book inventory integrity.
* Own cycle counting, inventory reconciliation, adjustment governance, and inventory variance reduction.
* Build mechanisms to identify inventory defects early and systematically eliminate their root causes.
* Establish network-level metrics and reporting that make inventory health visible and actionable.

**Fulfillment Process Quality**

* Own process adherence across inbound, receiving, putaway, picking, packing, sorting, and outbound operations.
* Define the critical quality controls for each process path and ensure sites consistently execute against them.
* Build audit mechanisms that identify process drift before it becomes a customer or inventory issue.
* Partner with Operations, Product, Engineering, and Data to eliminate systemic sources of defects.
* Develop a clear view of transaction volume, exception rates, and defect rates by process path to identify where quality is breaking down.

**Lot Control & Regulatory Compliance**

* Own lot, expiration-date, and inventory-attribute accuracy across applicable customers and facilities.
* Establish controls for FIFO, FEFO, lot traceability, recalls, quarantine, and other regulated inventory requirements.
* Ensure Stord's operating processes meet applicable customer, regulatory, and contractual quality requirements.
* Build a quality organization capable of supporting increasingly complex and regulated categories as Stord grows.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Build a rigorous root-cause and corrective-action discipline across the fulfillment network.
* Turn recurring defects into permanent process, system, or training improvements rather than repeatedly solving individual incidents.
* Identify network-wide trends and deploy standardized improvements across sites.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure recurring operational defects inform the technology roadmap.
* Create a culture where defects are surfaced quickly, investigated objectively, and permanently resolved.

**Quality Organization**

* Build and lead Stord's network Quality and Inventory Control organization.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability between Quality and Operations.
* Develop site and regional quality leaders capable of independently auditing operational performance.
* Serve as the executive escalation point when inventory integrity, regulatory compliance, or fulfillment quality is at risk.
* Maintain an independent point of view and be willing to stop, challenge, or redesign processes when quality standards are not being met.

**What We're Looking For**
We are looking for someone who has spent their career inside
**large, complex fulfillment or distribution operations**
and understands inventory at a level most operators do not.
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate**

* Has 12+ years of experience across fulfillment quality, inventory control, operational excellence, distribution, or supply chain operations, including significant leadership experience.
* Has led quality or inventory control across a multi-site fulfillment or distribution network.
* Comes from a scaled 3PL, retailer, e-commerce fulfillment network, food distribution company, or similarly complex physical operation.
* Is deeply fluent in inventory control, WMS-driven processes, cycle counting, reconciliation, lot control, and inventory accuracy.
* Understands the mechanics of inbound, putaway, pick, pack, sort, and outbound processes — and how defects in one process create downstream failures elsewhere.
* Has built quality systems based on data, audits, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and measurable defect reduction.
* Is comfortable challenging Operations leadership when execution does not meet the required standard.
* Has operated in environments where quality and compliance cannot be traded for throughput or cost.
* Ideally brings experience from food, grocery, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another environment with rigorous lot, expiration, traceability, or regulatory requirements.
* Can operate strategically at the executive level while still being willing to go onto the warehouse floor, trace an inventory discrepancy through a WMS, and understand exactly where a process failed.

!

The position also oversees the qualification and ongoing evaluation of suppliers to align with the company’s operational and commercial objectives.

* Supplier Audits & Qualification: Formulate and implement a comprehensive operational strategy to drive continuous quality improvement initiatives within the supplier quality function. Lead a team that conducts comprehensive audits and supplier qualification processes, ensuring compliance with quality standards and the prevention of defective component shipments from the supplier to S&C. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess supplier capabilities and align with company requirements.
* COPQ: Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) Reduction: Take ownership of reducing the cost of poor quality (COPQ) by analyzing trends in supplier-reported issues, identifying root causes, and implementing preventative measures to ensure continuous improvement in product quality.
* Production Part Approval Process (PPAP): Oversee the PPAP process to validate supplier-provided components meet specified requirements. Ensure that documentation, testing, and approvals are conducted thoroughly and accurately.

records.description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.
  
  
Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.
  
  
As the
**Senior Manager of Quality System and Quality (Regulatory) Compliance**
, you are a pivotal leader responsible for the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of our Quality Management System (QMS), oversight, and associated tools. You will lead our efforts to ensure robust compliance with national and international medical device regulations, including FDA, ISO 13485, EU MDR, and MDSAP. This role is a unique blend of strategic foresight and tactical leadership, requiring a deep expertise in QMS setup and management, particularly for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), with ability to make thoughtful changes and enhance the overall QMS.
  
  
You will lead a high-performing team of quality professionals , championing a "Quality-first" culture and driving data-driven decisions. Your proven track record of navigating complex regulatory landscapes, including
**FDA, PMDA, IEC, EU MDR, and ISO regulations and standards**
, is essential to our success.
  
  
Job Responsibilities:
  
  
Quality Management System (QMS) Oversight
  
  

* Manage holistic aspects of the QMS to ensure compliance with global regulations, including FDA, ISO 13485, EU MDR, and MDSAP countries’ requirements.
* Oversee the following key QMS subsystems: CAPA subsystem, Document Control, Training, Management Review, Internal Audits, and External Audit management, QMS Tool Validation, and Supplier Management.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the QMS.

Quality Compliance & Audits
  
  

* Serve as the front room or backroom lead and the primary subject matter expert (SME) for the QMS during audits, including inspections by the FDA, Notified Bodies, and other regulatory authorities.

Strategic Leadership & Team Development
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and scale a team of QMS professionals, fostering career growth and technical excellence.
* Champion a "Quality-first" mindset throughout the organization, through collaboration and using impactful KPIs to drive accountability and data-driven decisions.
* Collaborate with leaders and partners in R&D, Production, Regulatory, Clinical, and Product Management to integrate quality processes seamlessly, balancing compliance with business objectives.
* Manage departmental resources, including headcount and long-term strategic planning.

Skills Needed:
  
  

* Effective, clear, and concise communication skills bringing clarity to complex topics across the leadership spectrum.
* Ability to coach, mentor, and drive a collaborative quality culture through influence.
* Deep understanding of Quality System and Quality Compliance.
* Experience interacting with auditors, including Notified Body auditors and FDA Investigators.

Educational Requirements & Work Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or scientific discipline, or equivalent.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Quality within the medical device industry, with at least 5+ years in a leadership/management role.
* Expert-level knowledge of relevant regulations and standards, including FDA 21 CFR 820, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and ISO 14971.
* Proven track record of successfully leading or playing a key SME role in regulatory inspections (FDA, Notified Body).
* Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence and build consensus among cross-functional senior leaders.

Preferred:
  
  

* Direct experience with AI/ML-driven SaMD and cloud-based medical device platforms.
