**The Asahi Kasei Group operates with a commitment of creating for tomorrow. Our business sectors,** ***Materials, Homes, and Health Care*** **, contribute to the development of society by anticipating the changing needs of those around the world. We look for candidates that offer a fresh perspective and a variety of skills to help us achieve our commitment.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  
  
Asahi Kasei Therapeutics is the global specialty pharmaceutical business of Asahi Kasei. We are a commercial-stage company committed to positively impacting health by expanding therapeutic options that improve the lives of patients around the world. Drawing upon our strong heritage of scientific innovation, we aim to help reshape care in transplantation, nephrology, immunology, infectious diseases and other underserved conditions.  
  

**Job Description:**

  

The Senior Director of Quality Operations is a strategic and hands‑on leader responsible for ensuring the quality and compliance of all GMP/GDP activities executed internally and by external partners for the company’s products, supporting both clinical trials and commercial distribution, working with the VP of QA, QC and AD

  

This role provides oversight across CDMOs and testing labs, ensuring timely product disposition, investigation management, and quality support throughout the product lifecycle.

  

The base compensation range for this role is $230-260K. Base Compensation is influenced by many factors including, but not limited to: time in the role, previous experience, skills, knowledge, performance, work requirements, internal equity, and business / economic conditions.

  

The Senior Director QA Operations is accountable and responsible to:

* Ensure that the company's global Quality Management System (QMS), processes, and procedures required in the development, manufacture, supply and distribution and related activities are established, maintained and continuously improved in compliance with applicable laws and regulations, including but not necessarily limited to GMP and GDP.
* Provide global and independent Quality Management support, and in particular GMP and GDP oversight, leadership, expertise, reviews and as required quality approvals.
* Assure a satisfactory state of control and compliance with the AKTX QMS, and applicable GMP and GDP standards, authorizations, internal policies, procedures and protocols related to product for clinical trials and commercial manufacturing,
* Actively identify and communicate compliance issues or risks, develop and oversee plans to rectify issues or mitigate risks.

The Senior QA Director works in close collaboration with AKTX functional heads and process owners leading the development, supply and distribution of AKTX medicinal products.

  

**Tasks and responsibilities/accountabilities**

* Take an active role in development and delivery of AKTX strategy, objectives and targets.
* Support development of the QA unit and its way of working, budget, and deliverables in accordance with agreed corporate and individual objectives.
* Lead QA Operations and provide strategic leadership to QA operations staff by driving development, performance, coaching initiatives and ensuring optimal resource allocation to achieve organizational goals and deliver on targets, and objectives
* Collaborate within QA and with process owners, management and departments to establish, maintain and continually improve a fit-for-purpose, robust and effective global QMS.
* Act as owner of assigned business and quality management processes within the QMS and drive and ensure their suitability and effectiveness, and continual improvements.
* Provide oversight across CDMOs and service providers for clinical and commercial programs, ensuring timely product disposition, investigation management, and quality support throughout the product lifecycle.
* Serve as the quality lead in cross-functional CMC teams, partnering with MTO, QC/AD, Regulatory, Clinical, PAM and Supply Chain to ensure end-to-end GMP compliance
* Represent QA in governance and escalation forums for manufacturing investigations, supplier issues, or product quality events
* Own and continuously improve core quality systems including batch release, deviation/CAPA and change control and ensure scalability.
* Provide Quality Oversight, and support of:
  + Suppliers and other third parties involved in outsourced activities or procured material and services to AKTX, including development and follow up of quality and service agreements.
  + Assigned projects related to product and process development, supply and distribution of medicinal products.
  + Assigned computerized systems and other infrastructure within AKTX group.
* Support, and as agreed lead,
  + the management/coordination of regulatory inspections and audits by partners, related to AKTX QMS, and GMP and GDP activities.
  + inspection readiness and QA support during audits and health authority inspections at CDMOs
  + internal audits and audits of engaged suppliers and vendors for outsourced activities and of procured services, including planning, and delivery of the audit program.
  + investigations related to product complaints, issues, deviations, and other findings to identify root causes, corrections, risk mitigations, corrective or preventive actions in collaboration with related experts within the field.
* Support, as applicable, writing, review and approval of governing documentation such as protocols, applications and regulatory files related to Quality Management, and in particular GMP and GDP.
* Lead by example through ensuring own compliance with AKTX policies, values and procedures as well as promoting own team and wider AKTX to do so.
Maintain a contemporary knowledge of current industry trends, standards and methodologies within the area  

  

**Delegations**

* Authority to execute management approvals (or rejection) of governing, controlling and compliance documents and records, such as but not limited to procedures, protocols, reports, statements and methods, for processes owned by the QA unit and managed within AKTX QMS.
* Authority to execute quality and compliance (QA) approvals, consent or rejections of batches of medicinal products for use in clinical studies or intended for commercial distribution.
* Authority to execute quality and compliance (QA) approvals, consent or rejections of proposed changes, investigations of product complaints, deviations, or issues, and resulting corrections or corrective and preventive actions, related to supply, product or process development of medicinal products.
On behalf of AKTX, authority to approve Quality Agreements, including associated schedules, amendments and equivalent, with engaged suppliers, service providers, license partners and other third parties.  

  

**Competence requirements for the position (education and experience)**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in relevant applied sciences, e.g. pharmacy, medicine, chemistry, biology and/or engineering (pharmaceutical, chemical or biotechnology).
At least 10 years working experience in quality management, assurance or control, supply chain, regulatory affairs and/or product or process development of medicinal products or other life-science related industry (e.g. medical devices).

records.description:
If you’re reading this on your way from 5am spin class to festival fast-pass, you’re CELSIUS®— an everyday hustler with the essential energy to aim high, and go the extra mile wherever your goals take you.

Joyful by design, sunny by nature, and unapologetically bold. If your bestie has you saved in their phone as “Icon,” you’re ALANI NU® — confident, colorful, and bringing main-character energy to every moment.

SoCal in your soul, attitude in your stride. If gravity doesn’t stop you and “impossible” sounds more like “dare you,” you’re ROCKSTAR®— a born rebel, raising the bar with mind-body energy and zero compromise.

-

Together, we’re Celsius Holdings, Inc.— a global CPG company united by three powerhouse brands and one incredibly talented team.

At Celsius, we pride ourselves on empowering our people. Every employee has a stake in our success. We create a collaborative culture built on inclusivity, innovation, and a belief that great ideas can come from anywhere.

And we’re on our way to building something bigger: a category where energy isn’t just consumed, it’s lived—where performance meets personality, brand becomes community, and every can crack sparks a statement.

**This is the future of modern energy. This is Celsius.**

Ready to take your career to the next level? Join our team and redefine what it means to be energized.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

As the Director of Manufacturing, you will serve as the senior plant leader for a high-volume beverage canning operation responsible for batching, filling, seaming, and packaging canned CELSIUS® beverages. You will provide strategic and operational leadership across production, quality, food safety, maintenance, engineering, safety, warehousing, workforce development, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader who has operated in a high-speed, automated food, beverage, packaging, or consumer products environment. This role requires strong business judgment, operational discipline, technical understanding, and the ability to build an accountable, collaborative culture focused on safety, food safety, quality, service, cost, and continuous improvement.

**On-Site:** Based full-time in Charlotte, NC at Big Beverages manufacturing facility

**Travel Requirements:** Up to 25% domestic travel

**People Management Responsibilities:** Yes

**Reports To:** VP of Manufacturing

**Role Type:** Full-Time

 **Requirements**  

* **Experience:** 7-10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, preferably in high-speed beverage filling/canning, food, or consumer packaged goods operations, including at least 3–5 years leading a plant or multi-department operation with full responsibility for production performance and hourly teams.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Food Science, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Experience leading high-volume, automated manufacturing operations and managing production, maintenance, engineering, quality, safety, and continuous improvement functions.
* Working knowledge of FSSC 22000, ISO 22000 principles, HACCP, GMP, FSMA, food defense, food fraud prevention, traceability, prerequisite programs, CAPA systems, and audit readiness.
* Demonstrated success improving OEE, schedule attainment, throughput, labor efficiency, yield, waste, downtime, quality, cost performance, and equipment reliability through disciplined operating systems.
* Experience managing budgets, labor planning, capital projects, business cases, and plant-level financial performance.
* Experience hiring, developing, coaching, and leading large hourly and salaried teams, including supervisors and frontline leaders.
* Experience using ERP/MRP, MES, maintenance-management, and manufacturing-performance systems to make data-driven decisions.
* Strong analytical, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work onsite at the manufacturing facility and support a flexible schedule based on operational needs.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, Food Science, or a related field.
* PCQI, HACCP, FSSC 22000, Lean Six Sigma, or similar certification or training.
* Hands-on experience with high-speed carbonated beverage filling and canning lines, including syrup batching/blending, water treatment, carbonation, fillers, can seamers and double-seam integrity, can warmers/pasteurizers, CIP sanitation, and end-of-line packaging and palletizing.
* Experience with plant start-ups, expansions, new line installations, automation, commissioning, scale-up, or major capital investments.
* Experience supporting a rapidly growing consumer brand or publicly traded company.
* Experience working with labor relations or represented manufacturing environments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead all manufacturing operations to ensure the safe, efficient, and consistent production of high-quality canned beverages from production scheduling through finished-goods handoff.
* Develop and execute the plant operating strategy in alignment with CELSIUS business objectives, demand forecasts, customer requirements, and long-term growth plans.
* Own production planning, capacity, staffing, schedule attainment, changeovers, line utilization, labor efficiency, and daily operating execution.
* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability across production, quality, food safety, maintenance, engineering, warehouse, and support functions.
* Drive key operating metrics, including safety, OEE, throughput, yield, scrap, waste, downtime, labor productivity, cost per unit, on-time production, and schedule attainment.
* Establish and sustain leader standard work, tiered accountability, visual management, root-cause problem solving, standard work, and continuous-improvement routines.
* Partner with Maintenance and Engineering on preventive and predictive maintenance, equipment reliability, automation, capital priorities, commissioning, line expansions, and new technology implementation.
* Coordinate with Warehousing, Logistics, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Customer Service to maintain material availability, protect product integrity, and ensure accurate and timely finished-goods handoff.
* Maintain compliance with applicable safety, environmental, food-contact, quality, food-safety, and regulatory requirements, including FSSC 22000, HACCP, GMP, FSMA, and customer standards.
* Ensure effective prerequisite programs, food defense, food fraud prevention, sanitation, traceability, lot control, allergen control where applicable, and environmental monitoring activities.
* Oversee inspections, testing, product release, holds, deviations, nonconforming product, complaints, CAPAs, and corrective-action effectiveness in partnership with Quality.
* Ensure beverage-specific quality controls are effective, including ingredient and batch accuracy, Brix and carbonation targets, fill levels and net contents, double-seam inspection, date/lot coding, and finished-product testing.
* Lead audit readiness and support certification, surveillance, recertification, customer, regulatory, internal, and third-party audits.
* Maintain a strong safety culture through employee engagement, training, audits, risk assessments, safety observations, incident investigations, emergency preparedness, and corrective-action plans.
* Collaborate with Human Resources to recruit, develop, retain, and engage a high-performing plant workforce.
* Build leadership capability through coaching, performance management, individual development plans, skills matrices, cross-training, succession planning, and consistent leader standard work.
* Lead labor planning and workforce optimization in response to production volumes, seasonality, new product requirements, and business growth.
* Manage the plant operating budget, labor costs, maintenance spending, capital expenditures, and other controllable expenses.
* Analyze operational and financial data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actions needed to improve plant performance.
* Communicate plant performance, operating priorities, business risks, resource needs, and improvement plans clearly to plant and executive leadership.
* Contribute to network and growth planning, including capacity, new product introductions, and line additions, in partnership with corporate Operations and Supply Chain.
* Build strong working relationships with corporate brand, R&D/innovation, Quality, and Supply Chain partners, as well as co-pack customers and key suppliers where applicable.
* Promote a culture consistent with CELSIUS values, including ownership, agility, grit, commercial thinking, collaboration, positive influence, and a bias for action.
* Provide site-wide leadership that translates company goals into plant priorities, targets, and daily execution.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.
* Leadership Expectations
* Lead with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Make thoughtful, timely decisions in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
* Balance immediate production needs with long-term operational excellence.
* Build trust across plant, corporate, commercial, and cross-functional teams.

records.title: Director, MSAT/External Manufacturing Management
records.description:
OPPORTUNITY

Mammoth Biosciences is seeking a Director, Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) to lead the scale-up of our lipid nanoparticle (LNP) drug product process from Phase 1 into Phase 2 and toward late stage readiness. This leader will own the technical path from the current clinical process to a well-characterized, scalable process that is ready for process performance qualification (PPQ).

All manufacturing and analytical work is performed at external contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) and contract testing labs. The Director will be Mammoth's technical owner of the process at those partners, ensuring that development, technology transfer, process characterization and PPQ are executed in line with current regulatory guidance and industry best practice.

This is a build role. Initially the Director will deliver through external resources (CDMOs, consultants and contract staff), then grow an internal MSAT team in stages as program milestones are met. The role reports to the Head of CMC and works closely with Process Development, Analytical Development, Quality, Regulatory CMC, Supply Chain and Program Management.

### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Process scale-up and technology transfer

* Lead scale-up of the Phase 1 LNP process (nucleic acid payload formulation, mixing, buffer exchange/TFF, sterile filtration and fill) to Phase 2 and late-stage clinical scale
* Define the scale-up strategy, including equipment selection, mixing platform scalability, scale-down model development and comparability between process versions
* Plan and execute technology transfers of processes and methods between Mammoth, development partners and GMP CDMOs, including transfer protocols, gap assessments and engineering runs
* Own the technical risk assessments (e.g., FMEA) that drive scale-up and characterization priorities

Process characterization and PPQ readiness

* Build the control strategy using a QbD approach: define CQAs and CPPs, link material attributes to product quality, and set proven acceptable ranges
* Design and oversee process characterization studies (DoE, qualified scale-down models, hold times, mixing and filtration studies) that support the control strategy and regulatory filings
* Lead PPQ planning and execution: validation master plan inputs, PPQ protocols and reports, acceptance criteria, sampling plans and the transition to continued process verification
* Partner with Analytical Development to make sure methods are phase-appropriate, validated on time and fit to support characterization and PPQ

External manufacturing and CDMO management

* Serve as Mammoth's technical lead and person-in-plant at CDMOs and contract labs for development, engineering and GMP campaigns
* Lead selection, qualification and oversight of CDMO partners for drug product manufacturing, fill-finish operations and drug product testing, including technical due diligence, capacity and capability assessment, and scale-up fit
* Provide technical oversight for engineering and GMP runs at external partners
* Develop scalable, phase-appropriate aseptic drug product processes at CDMOs, including fill-finish operations, cryogenic handling (as applicable) and cold-chain compatibility
* Assess and implement suitable container-closure systems (vials, syringes) that meet regulatory and operational requirements
* Accountable for review and approval of batch records in accordance with regulatory guidelines; review campaign plans, deviations, investigations, CAPAs and change controls in partnership with Quality
* Manage partner timelines, budgets, deliverables and quality in collaboration with internal stakeholders; drive technical decisions and escalate issues early
* Project manage external stakeholders and high-profile partner meetings (up to 10% of time)
* Contribute to technical sections of quality agreements, statements of work and budgets

Regulatory and cross-functional support

* Author and review CMC sections for IND/IMPD/CTA amendments, end-of-Phase 2 and later filings (Module 3 process description, process development history, process validation)
* Support regulatory interactions and inspections with process knowledge and data
* Provide manufacturing input to program plans, timelines and supply forecasts

Team and resource leadership

* In the early phase, deliver through external resources: CDMO technical teams, consultants and contract MSAT staff
* Build the internal MSAT function in stages tied to milestones, including hiring plans, roles and the balance of internal and outsourced work
* Set up MSAT systems and practices: tech transfer templates, process knowledge management, data trending and lifecycle documentation

### **REEQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* PhD in chemical engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry or a related field with 10+ years of industry experience, or MS with 14+ or BS with 16+ years of experience
* 6+ years in MSAT, process development or technical operations for parenteral drug products, including at least 3 years in a leadership role
* Hands-on experience scaling up LNP or comparable complex parenteral processes (liposomes, nanoparticles, nucleic acid formulations) from early clinical to late-stage scale
* Led at least one process characterization and PPQ campaign through completion, with working command of ICH Q8–Q12 and FDA/EMA process validation expectations
* Extensive experience managing CDMOs and contract labs as the sponsor's technical lead, including tech transfer, person-in-plant oversight, deviations and change control
* Experience with fill-finish operations, aseptic processing and external manufacturing oversight
* Strong working knowledge of cryogenic storage and cold-chain management for LNP drug products
* Track record of authoring CMC regulatory sections and supporting agency interactions
* Ability to influence and direct external partners without line authority, and to make sound technical calls under timeline pressure
* Ability for frequent domestic and international travel to CDMO and contract lab sites, estimated at up to [30–40]% and peaking during engineering, characterization and PPQ campaigns
* Must be able to travel internationally on short notice and hold, or be able to obtain, a valid passport and any visas needed for partner sites
* Ability to commit to extended on-site presence at CDMOs (person-in-plant) during critical campaigns, sometimes across time zones.
* Based in the San Francisco Bay Area preferred, with ability to work onsite at our Brisbane, CA location; hybrid or remote arrangements are available
* Ability to work Pacific Time Zone hours if not located on the West Coast
* Ability to travel to Mammoth’s Brisbane, CA HQ regularly if not local

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Direct experience with mRNA/LNP or gene editing drug products
* Experience with impingement jet or microfluidic mixing scale-up, TFF and sterile filtration of LNPs
* Experience with commercial process validation and BLA/MAA preparation
* Experience building a function or team from the ground up in a small or mid-size biotech
* Working knowledge of statistical tools for DoE and process data analysis (e.g., JMP, Minitab)

### **BENEFITS**

* Company-paid health/vision/dental benefits
* Unlimited vacation and generous sick time
* Company-sponsored meals and snacks

**Position:** Director – Operations  
**Location:** North Carolina/ South Carolina  
**Type:** Full-Time  
**Reports To:** CEO, ZetSol Energy

**Who We Are**

ZetSol Energy is the solar manufacturing and supply chain platform built to give North American solar developers, EPCs, utilities, and independent power producers a reliable, tariff-compliant alternative to fragmented overseas sourcing. The company is establishing a vertically integrated greenfield facility in Tuticorin, Tamil Nadu, producing silicon ingots, monocrystalline wafers, cells, and modules, including high-efficiency TOPCon and HJT technology, and pairs that manufacturing base with a full strategic sourcing, bill-of-materials management, quality audit, compliance, and logistics practice purpose-built for the US market.

ZetSol Energy is backed by Zetwerk, a global manufacturing platform valued at over $2.7 billion that already supplies solar piles, mechanical and structural components, and modules to leading US EPCs and asset owners, and whose 2022 acquisition of Unimacts strengthened its US industrial and solar manufacturing footprint. ZetSol Energy is the next chapter of that build-out: a dedicated US-facing commercial platform launching at a moment when American solar developers are actively searching for supply chain partners who can deliver both scale and certainty.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced operations leader to lead and scale ZetSol Energy's US operations, with overall responsibility for manufacturing, factory production, supply chain, logistics and sales operations.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing large-scale operations, with a strong background in Supply Chain Management (SCM), logistics and manufacturing, preferably within the renewable energy, solar or industrial sectors.

This individual will be responsible for overseeing factory production, managing end-to-end supply chain and logistics operations, and driving sales operations, including demand planning, order management and customer fulfilment in the US market.

The role will also involve building strong relationships with US government authorities, regulatory bodies, logistics partners and other key industry stakeholders, while ensuring operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and cost optimisation.

This is a key leadership position that will play an instrumental role in building and scaling ZetSol Energy's US operations, establishing robust operational processes and driving business growth in North America.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead and oversee end-to-end US operations for ZetSol Energy, covering manufacturing, supply chain, logistics and sales operations.

* Manage factory production operations, including production planning, capacity utilisation, quality, productivity and timely delivery.

* Drive end-to-end supply chain and logistics operations, including global sourcing, procurement, inventory management, import/export, customs clearance and distribution.

* Oversee sales operations, including demand planning, order management, customer fulfilment and coordination with commercial teams.

* Build and manage relationships with US government authorities, regulatory bodies, customs officials, port authorities, logistics partners and other key stakeholders.

* Ensure compliance with US trade regulations, import policies, tariffs and applicable industry standards while driving operational efficiency and cost optimisation.

* Build and scale the US operations team, processes and infrastructure while working closely with the leadership and manufacturing teams in India.

**Qualifications**

* 15–20 years of experience in operations, manufacturing, supply chain management and logistics, preferably within renewable energy, solar, infrastructure or industrial sectors.

* Extensive experience managing large-scale manufacturing operations, including factory production, production planning, quality and operational efficiency.

* Strong experience in end-to-end supply chain, logistics and sales operations, including global sourcing, procurement, import/export, order management and customer fulfilment.

* Strong understanding of US trade regulations, import compliance, tariffs, customs procedures and logistics frameworks.

* Established relationships with government authorities, regulatory bodies, customs officials, port authorities and key industry stakeholders.

* Proven track record of building and managing large operational teams, vendor ecosystems and strategic partnerships, with strong commercial and cost management capabilities.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in the solar, renewable energy or energy manufacturing ecosystem.

* Previous experience leading operations for a global manufacturing or industrial organisation.

* Experience managing manufacturing facilities and cross-border operations between the US and international markets, preferably India.

* Ability to build and scale operational infrastructure in a fast-growing business environment.

**Why ZetSol Energy**

* Opportunity to play a key leadership role in building ZetSol Energy's US operations.

* Work closely with the CEO and leadership team in shaping the company's operational strategy.

* Opportunity to build and scale a large operational and supply chain ecosystem.

* Be part of a growing solar manufacturing and supply chain platform backed by Zetwerk's global manufacturing capabilities.

records.description:
**DEFINITION:**

Under general direction from the General Manager, plans, directs, organizes, integrates and provides oversight of ReGen Monterey’s Materials Recovery Facility (MRF), equipment maintenance, site and facilities maintenance, landfill operations; scales operations, landfill gas operations, and Household Hazardous Waste (HHW) operations; directs and manages the development of short and long-term goals and objectives consistent with the Strategic Plan and annual business plan and ensures their effective execution; ensures all assigned operations and functions serve the needs of ReGen Monterey, while complying with applicable laws and regulations; responsible for maximizing the environmental management of resources; provides highly responsible and complex operations support to the General Manager.

**DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS:**

This position is responsible for coordination, integration and short and long-range planning of a wide variety of functions related to solid waste processing, recycling and diversion programs for ReGen Monterey. Incumbents work at an advanced professional level on complex and specialized solid waste-related operations, recycling activities, facilities, programs, and services, which include formulation and implementation of programs and financial budgets. Within assigned areas of accountability, the incumbent operates with substantial latitude and discretion to achieve effective and efficient utilization of resources in serving ReGen Monterey’s mission. Positions at this class level serve as a member of ReGen’s leadership team and provide advice and counsel to the General Manager regarding strategic policy and problem-solving issues relating to the assigned Departments and ReGen’s overall. A person appointed to the Director of Operations classification is an “at-will” employee.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

*The following duties are typical of this classification and are intended only to describe the various types of work that may be performed, the level of technical complexity of the assignment(s) and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties. The omission of a specific duty statement does not exclude it from the position if the work is consistent with the concept of the classification or is similar or closely related to another duty statement to address business needs and changing business practices.*

* Oversee and is responsible for planning and execution of all aspects of solid waste and recycling operations including processing, recycling/diversion, scheduling, expansion and renovation of processing facility, and customer service.
* Oversee logistics, material preparation and export compliance of collected materials and manage all aspects of commodity sales and related contracted services.
* Oversees and is responsible for the planning and execution of all aspects of the operation and maintenance of ReGen Monterey’s landfill; oversees proper compliance with specifications on the use and development of disposal site, ensures proper operations compliance with health and safety regulations.
* Participates in the development and implementation of goals, objectives, policies, and priorities of ReGen Monterey’s operations.
* Plans, organizes, controls, integrates and evaluates the work of assigned departments to ensure services comply with the policies and strategic direction set by the General Manager, Board of Directors and all applicable laws and regulations.
* Recommend and enforce State waste reduction/recycling regulations and other policy issues, including safety policy and procedures.
* Manages the development, revision, and implementation of policies and procedures for ReGen Monterey’s solid waste and recycling/diversion operations.
* Drafts budget for assigned departments.
* Reviews and assesses all program production data; measures program effectiveness; prepares quarterly and annual data reports.
* Assists in the preparation of Requests for Proposal (RFPs) for equipment and services; represents the division in negotiations with vendors and service contractors and participates in contract administration in disputed contractual matters.
* Prepares staff reports and letters, including reports for presentation to Board of Directors.
* All ReGen Monterey positions require the employee to provide good customer service to both internal and external customers, maintain positive and effective working relationships with other ReGen Monterey employees, and have regular and reliable attendance and timeliness. Must show cooperation and respect to fellow employees and supervisors at all times.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBLITIES:**

The incumbent in this position provides direct supervision of the operations department managers and has oversight of multiple departments and indirect supervision of approximately 100 assigned department employees.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Through subordinates, supervises the safe and efficient handling and disposal of solid waste, including household, industrial, infectious, medical, and household hazardous materials; provides oversight ancillary solid waste operations, including equipment maintenance and repair, recycling, and enforcement of refuse disposal laws.
* Coordinates solid waste processing operations with engineering staff to ensure the success of new programs and facilities; analyzes field operations and formulates improvements to ensure compliance with federal and state regulations; performs long-range planning for staffing needs, equipment replacement, and other operational requirements.
* Provides oversight to HHW program and organics recycling program, including food waste collection, yard waste processing, mulch/compost marketing and other waste reduction processing such as scrap metal, electronic waste, mattresses, and scrap tires.

* Prepares tonnage reports and makes recommendations regarding change in fees.
* Organize and optimize the structure of the assigned departments, adjusting in accordance with workloads and new/changing functions.
* Maintain contact with various governmental and regulatory agencies, industry related agencies, and represent ReGen Monterey at public and professional organizations functions.
* Selects and trains operations staff; assists management staff in resolving the most difficult operational problems; establishes productive standards and measures staff performance; accordingly, prepares annual performance plans, evaluates performance, and reviews performance evaluations prepared by subordinate managers. Collaborates with human resources with disciplinary actions.
* Directly or through subordinates, responds to complaints from ReGen Monterey customers by explaining and enforcing applicable laws and regulations; participates in public workshops to explain and generate support for proposed projects and facilities; may address the Board of Directors to answer questions about issues or proposals related to ReGen Monterey’s operations.
* Oversees and participates in the annual review and revision of ReGen Monterey’s fee structure; develops strategies and approaches for evaluating fee change alternatives; directs the development and recommends proposed fees; attends and participates in public meetings; oversees the implementation of new fees following board approval.
* Directs and coordinates the preparation of analyses and recommendations regarding policy issues and long-range plans to address ReGen Monterey’s financial needs; advises the General Manager regarding policy issues, programs and projects to meet ReGen Monterey and customer needs; advises and assists the General Manager in identifying, articulating and implementing policies, programs and projects.
* Participates in the analysis of proposed legislation and regulation; participates in industry and intergovernmental activities to influence legislative and regulatory change consistent with ReGen Monterey’s interests and needs; represents ReGen Monterey as requested or assigned in dealings with stakeholders in ReGen Monterey’s service area, and with other industry and governmental agencies and professional organizations.
* Participates in major negotiations with contractors, consultants, vendors, collective bargaining and other public agencies.
* Participates in regional, state, national and other professional meetings and conferences to stay abreast of trends and technology related to ReGen Monterey’s operations, particularly in areas of assigned accountability.

**Knowledge of and Ability to:**

The following generally describes the knowledge and ability required to successfully perform the assigned duties.

**Knowledge of:**

Principles and practices of recycling and diversion program operations, solid waste management and landfill maintenance practices and procedures; local, state and federal regulations pertaining to environmental management of landfills and public works systems or landfill operations; California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA); principles and practices of budgeting, effective management, supervision, evaluation and training; health and safety regulations. Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word, Outlook and PowerPoint) is required.

**Ability to:**

Analyze problems, identify alternative solutions, project consequences of proposed actions, and implement recommendations in support of goals; understand highly regulatory issues (current and proposed) and appropriate permitting for solid waste facilities, recycling operations and programs; negotiate with the best interest of ReGen Monterey; work independently with minimal supervision; manage and evaluate the work of others; prepare clear and concise plans, specifications, and technical reports; interpret and apply applicable federal, state, and local policies, laws, and regulations; present proposals and recommendations clearly, logically and persuasively in public meetings; develop and implement appropriate procedures and controls; exercise sound, independent judgment within policy guidelines; develop and administer departmental goals, objectives, and procedures; analyze and assess programs, policies, and operational needs and make appropriate adjustments; research, analyze, and evaluate new service delivery methods and techniques; facilitate group participation and consensus building; communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing; establish and maintain effective working relationships with those contacted in the course of work.

**TRAINING, EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in environmental planning and management; environmental studies; solid waste planning or a related field is required.

**Experience:**

* Ten to 15 years of broad and progressively responsible work experience in recycling program operations, transfer station management, or combined and related experiences.
* A minimum of five years of recent experience in solid waste management and/or in the operation of mixed waste processing facility or a single-stream material recovery facility or operation of a landfill is required. **OR** work experience in a management position with a private or public agency responsible for solid waste management, recycling/diversion or landfill operations to demonstrate knowledge, skills, and abilities to meet the above minimum requirements.

**License or Certificate:**

* Possession of or ability to obtain a certificate of Manager of Landfill Operations (MOLO) issued by the Solid Waste Association of North America (SWANA) is desired.
* Possession of a valid California driver’s license is required.

**PhYSICAL AND SENSORY REQUIREMENTS:**

The physical and mental demands described here are representative of those that must be met by employees to successfully perform the essential functions of this class. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Physical Demands**

While performing the duties of this class, employees are regularly required to sit; talk or hear, in person, in meetings and by telephone; use hands to finger, handle, feel or operate standard office equipment; and reach with hands and arms; occasionally bend, stoop, lift and/or carry objects weighing up to 25 pounds individually. Employees are occasionally required to walk and stand on even and uneven surfaces, grounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

**Mental Demands**

While performing the duties of this class, employees are regularly required to use written and oral communication skills; read and interpret complex data, information and documents; analyze and solve complex policy and operational problems; observe and interpret people and situations; use math and mathematical reasoning; learn and apply new information or skills; perform highly detailed work on multiple, concurrent tasks with constant interruptions; work under intensive deadlines and interact with Board members, all levels of ReGen Monterey management, other elected and appointed governmental officials, consultants, contractors, developers, vendors, employees, media representatives and the public.

**Special Demands**

Must be able to actively participate in public meetings, including giving presentations in person and on camera before the Board of Directors and members of the public.

**Work Environment**

Employees work under typical office conditions, and the noise level is usually quiet, occasional exposure to dirt, grease, foul odors and other outdoor elements.

**The Opportunity**

* Lead the effort to identify, select, and manage Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) for the development and cGMP manufacture of raw materials, RSMs, and DS in support of ongoing clinical programs and commercial products (with finance and commercial teams)
* Manage global supply chains and logistics in support of demand for clinical studies and commercial products

* Coordinate the preparation and/or review of CMC sections of INDs, CTAs, NDAs, MAAs, and other regulatory submissions to ensure timely distribution of clinical trial materials
* Coordinate the process validation programs to support commercialization
* Initiate and manage high-value intercontinental, cross-border, and domestic shipments
* Coordinate the preparation, review, editing, and approval of cGMP batch records and CMC regulatory and Quality documents
* Coordinate the preparation of technical reports, publications, and oral presentations

  

**What You'll Bring**

* BS with 15+ years' experience; degree in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Science, or a related scientific discipline
* At least 10 years of relevant experience in a pharmaceutical or biotechnology CMC/cGMP environment
* Excellent project management skills and the ability to work cross-functionally to develop and execute project plans
* Experience managing US and international CRO/CMOs for the manufacture of raw materials, RSMs, and cGMP DS and DP for programs in development
* Experience with clinical supply chain, including forecasting supply needs

* Experience in supply chain management, and experience establishing pharmaceutical supply chain systems and networks
* Able to identify and resolve critical issues
* Sufficient technical background and experience to work closely with other technical functional areas

**Salary Range:** $270,300 - $295,700

**Location:** Onsite – Brisbane, CA

* Strong team orientation; highly collaborative

**About Nurix Therapeutics**

*Nurix Therapeutics is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of targeted protein degradation medicines, the next frontier in innovative drug design aimed at improving treatment options for patients with cancer and inflammatory diseases. Powered by a fully AI-integrated discovery engine capable of tackling any protein class, and coupled with unparalleled ligase expertise, Nurix's dedicated team has built a formidable advantage in translating the science of targeted protein degradation into clinical advancements. records.title: Program Director, Advanced Manufacturing Technology
records.description:
DeVry University strives to close our society’s opportunity gap and address emerging talent needs by preparing learners to thrive in careers shaped by continuous technological change. Through innovative programs, relevant partnerships, and exceptional care, we empower students to meaningfully improve their lives, communities, and workplaces.
  
  
Our colleague experience is an area of obsessive focus. At DeVry University, we care about you. Because, only through you can we deliver our unique Care Formula to our learners and partners.
  
  
Opportunity
  
The Program Director, Advanced Manufacturing Technology, will lead the development and launch of employer-informed technical education programs in advanced manufacturing. Working across Product and Academics, this role translates industry requirements into differentiated academic programs, identifies delivery and investment needs, and coordinates academic and product readiness for launch.
  
The position provides discipline-level leadership and accountability for the Advanced Manufacturing Technology program from initial development through sustainable academic operations. During program build and launch, the role will operate within Product in close partnership with Academics. Once the program is established, the position may transition to Academics and assume ongoing leadership of a faculty team, instructional quality, academic operations, and program performance, consistent with institutional academic governance and approval requirements.
  
Responsibilities
  
Employer Engagement and Program Strategy
  

* Establish and maintain a structured process for engaging employers and industry stakeholders to identify required competencies, knowledge, skills, abilities, and employment outcomes.
* Develop relationships with employers and industry partners that could support program co-design, applied learning opportunities, industry-recognized credentials, or pathways to employment.
* Use employer feedback, labor-market demand, competitive intelligence, and recognized industry competency frameworks to inform program direction and differentiation.
* Collaborate with Product, Academics, and other stakeholders to develop and maintain a discipline-specific program roadmap and recommendations.

Program and Curriculum Development
  

* Partner with academic and curriculum teams to translate employer requirements into program outcomes, curriculum architecture, course sequencing, and applied learning experiences.
* Identify opportunities to differentiate DeVry’s programs through emerging technologies, simulation, industry partnerships, innovative hands-on learning models, and integration of digital technologies.
* Ensure proposed programs reflect relevant industry standards, appropriate academic requirements, and measurable student learning and employment outcomes.
* Coordinate input from faculty, academic leaders, and industry partners to maintain program relevance and quality.

Investment and Delivery Planning
  

* Develop recommendations and funding requirements for labs, equipment, tools, technology, facilities, instructional resources, and external delivery partnerships.
* Evaluate delivery options that expand learner access, support hands-on skill development, improve the student experience, and create efficient, scalable operations.
* Partner with Finance and operational teams to evaluate program costs, investments, and implementation requirements.

**SUMMARY:** Directs production, distribution, maintenance, receiving, and supervision operations for the Plant, by performing the following duties personally or through subordinate supervisors.

* Leads all departments in the plant with department supervisors (or production manager) to maintain safety, quality, and efficient production.
* Coordinates production, distribution, and warehousing in accordance with policies, principles, and established procedures.
* Develops and implements plans for efficient use of materials, machines, and employees.

* Directs preparation of production, human resources, and labor/costs records.
* Recommends budgets to management. Assists management in negotiation of employee contracts.
* Maintains positive working relationship with sales management and customer service management.
* Systematically reviews financial performance of the plant to recommend to management opportunities for sales growth and cost savings.
* Coordinates plant safety, environmental and training activities in cooperation with the Human Resources Department.
* Comply with company policies and procedures.
* Additional duties as assigned by management.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manages subordinate supervisors and/or production manager who supervise all plant employees. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of these units.

* Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**:

* High school diploma or GED plus college and/or appropriate technical courses.
* Five years experience as a proven manager
* Ten years corrugated manufacturing experience
* Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:
* College degree

**LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
* Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:**

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
* Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**REASONING ABILITY:**

* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS:**

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

* Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation. This also supports the supervisor's role of teacher and trainer for his/her personnel.
* Cost issues in order to make daily decisions that will reduce overall costs and will help the supervisor find areas that require improvement.
* Budget development, adherence and analysis.
* Quality standards.
* Regulatory requirements including but not limited to wage and hour requirements, environmental and waste minimization, company policies, and personnel requirements including OSHA, DEQ and EEO.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**:

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, and sit.
* The employee is occasionally required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts.
* The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions.
* The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration.
* The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

**LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES**:

The individual must posses the following:

* Superior time management skills including the ability to manage multiple issues concurrently and the ability to lead an effective and efficient meeting.
* Teaching skills in order to function effectively as a teacher for his personnel both in the technical and administrative parts of the position.
* Excellent crisis manager who demonstrates that he/she has a high emotional control under adverse conditions and can lead his/her personnel to a successful resolution.

* Professional appearance to support his/her role as a managerial representative of the company.

The performance of the supervisor will be measured as follows:

* **Operating standards** - the Plant Manager will need to see that all reporting staff meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the supervisor.
* **Personal growth** - while the company will provide the tools to assist the supervisor to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the supervisor and his/her superior.

**Employee relations** - through observations the Plant Manager will be evaluated regarding his/her and his/her reporting staff's skills and advancements in the areas of motivational techniques and results, positive and corrective/constructive feedback, subordinate development and creating a positive work environment.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
CAMS is looking for a Plant Manager at the Kings Mountain Energy Center in Kings Mountain, NC. The incumbent will have 19 direct and indirect employees. The Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable, compliant, and financially responsible operation and maintenance of the Kings Mountain Energy Center.

Kings Mountain Energy Center is a 475MW natural gas-fired combined-cycle power plant. The facility features an advanced 276MW Mitsubishi M501GAC gas turbine, a Vogt Power heat recovery steam generator (HRSG), a 225MW Toshiba steam turbine generator, and a Thermal Engineering International surface condenser.

The position provides overall leadership for plant operations, maintenance, engineering support, environmental and regulatory compliance, administration, workforce development, budgeting, outage execution, and continuous improvement. The Plant Manager serves as the primary site representative to CAMS leadership, facility ownership and asset management, and is accountable for developing a high-performing organization that maximizes plant availability, reliability, efficiency, and long-term asset value. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, sound technical and business judgment, and the ability to manage a complex combined-cycle generating facility in a competitive power-market environment.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for the safe, reliable, environmentally compliant, and cost-effective operation and maintenance of the facility.
* Establish and maintain a strong safety culture in which employees and contractors actively identify hazards, stop unsafe work, and demonstrate personal ownership of safety performance.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local environmental permits, laws, regulations, NERC requirements, OSHA requirements, company policies, and facility procedures.
* Lead and develop the plant management team and workforce, including recruiting, coaching, performance management, succession planning, qualification programs, and workforce development.
* Maintain effective working relationships with facility ownership, Asset Management, CAMS leadership, regulatory agencies, the system operator, utilities, OEMs, contractors, and other key stakeholders.
* Develop and execute annual operating plans, O&M budgets, capital plans, forecasts, and long-term maintenance strategies consistent with owner objectives and contractual requirements.
* Monitor plant financial performance and control expenditures while ensuring that short-term budget objectives do not create unacceptable safety, environmental, reliability, or long-term asset risk.
* Direct plant operations to achieve availability, reliability, heat-rate, start-reliability, capacity, and other performance objectives while meeting dispatch and commercial obligations.
* Provide leadership for maintenance strategies, preventive and predictive maintenance, corrective-maintenance backlog management, equipment reliability, root-cause analysis, and elimination of recurring failures.
* Direct planning and execution of combustion turbine, steam turbine, HRSG, generator, electrical, and balance-of-plant outages and major maintenance activities, including scope, budget, schedule, contractor performance, quality, and risk management.
* Develop and maintain multi-year outage, major-maintenance, and capital improvement plans based on equipment condition, OEM recommendations, operating profile, commercial requirements, and risk.
* Identify significant plant risks and provide CAMS leadership and ownership with timely information, alternatives, consequences, and clear recommendations for decision-making.
* Ensure appropriate critical-spares strategy, inventory controls, long-lead component planning, and equipment-obsolescence management.
* Oversee plant engineering and technical support activities, including equipment modifications, controls and logic changes, performance monitoring, capital projects, and technical problem solving.
* Ensure plant procedures, drawings, technical documentation, training materials, emergency plans, and operating records are accurate and maintained.
* Oversee administration of applicable plant contracts and agreements and ensure operational compliance with owner requirements, O&M obligations, OEM/LTSA requirements, fuel and utility agreements, and other commercial commitments.
* Maintain effective communication with Asset Management and ownership, including prompt escalation of significant safety, environmental, operational, equipment, financial, contractual, or regulatory events.
* Lead emergency response and business-continuity activities and ensure the facility is prepared for severe weather, grid emergencies, fuel interruptions, cyber events, and major equipment failures.
* Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement, and open communication across Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Compliance, and Administration.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve plant performance, reduce operating risk, optimize costs, and increase long-term asset value.
* Support CAMS fleet initiatives, peer reviews, lessons learned, workforce-development efforts, and cross-facility technical support as requested.

Other duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications and Skills**

* 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in power generation operations and maintenance, including significant leadership experience in a power plant environment.
* Prior Plant Manager, Operations Manager, Maintenance Manager, or comparable senior power-generation leadership experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge of combined-cycle power plant operations, maintenance, reliability, and major equipment systems. Experience with combustion turbines, steam turbines, HRSGs, generators, electrical systems, and balance-of-plant equipment is preferred.
* Experience with Mitsubishi M501GAC combustion turbines is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing major outages, managing contractors and OEMs, controlling outage scope and cost, and resolving emergent technical issues.
* Working knowledge of environmental, health and safety, and electric-generation regulatory requirements applicable to power plant operations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and managing O&M budgets, forecasts, capital projects, and long-term maintenance plans.
* Proven ability to lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable a multidisciplinary workforce.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, planning, and organizational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with employees, executives, owners, regulators, contractors, and technical personnel.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred. Significant relevant power-generation leadership experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and familiarity with computerized maintenance management systems, plant historians, performance-monitoring systems, and other power-plant business systems.
* Ability to respond to plant emergencies and significant operating events outside normal business hours as required.

Other Desirable Skills

* Demonstrates visible leadership and a strong personal commitment to safety and environmental compliance.
* Balances technical, operational, financial, and commercial considerations when making decisions.
* Communicates significant risks and problems early and avoids surprises for ownership and senior leadership.
* Demonstrates strong customer service skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with facility ownership and Asset Management.
* Effectively prioritizes competing demands in a fast-changing operating environment.
* Develop people and create clear succession paths for key positions.
* Demonstrates a high degree of integrity, accountability, sound judgment, and ownership mentality.
* Ability to represent the facility and CAMS professionally with owners, regulators, industry organizations, and external stakeholders

Applicants must possess a **valid driver's license** and maintain a clean driving record, as this position requires occasional travel for company business. Candidates should be comfortable operating a vehicle as part of their job responsibilities and must meet any applicable company and insurance requirements.

CAMS offers a variety of excellent benefits. Full-time employees are offered the following: medical, dental, vision, LTD, STD, and Life insurance plans. You can even select additional “al la carte” benefits to meet all your needs. You can also enroll in our 401k, flex spending accounts for medical and childcare needs, and participate in our employee referral and tuition reimbursement programs.

Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.

We believe in transparency and providing candidates with important information to make informed decisions. The salary range for this position will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, and location. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, and relevant qualifications.

This range represents the base salary and does not include other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, benefits, or equity, which may be offered in addition to the base pay. The company reserves the right to modify.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

The Plant Manager will work closely with other departments and managers to ensure
  
all in-process production metrics as deliverables are being met. This team member will be focused
  
on overall safety, production deliverables and continuous improvement as we continue our growth.  
Job Duties & Responsibilities:  

* Establishing and maintaining production and shipping schedules and ensuring that quality

product is consistently delivered to customers on time and within budget for labor hours,
  
machine hours and material costs  

* Managing production operations such that equipment and employee resources are

utilized efficiently, productivity is high and product quality requirements are met and
  
exceeded  

* Ensuring that process and equipment capabilities meet or exceed company and industry

standards and requirements; implementing operations-related initiatives that result in
  
increased efficiency, improved productivity and reduced job-related costs  

* Full participation in weekly production meetings and daily work-related meetings is

expected  

* Maintaining company policies and procedures with respect to production, materials, and

equipment-related activities, ensuring that employees report labor hours, machine hours,
  
material usage and activities in accordance with company policies and procedures and
  
within the current operations management and control systems  

* Implementing operations and function-related budgeting goals and objectives;

establishing benchmarks for monthly, quarterly, and annual case production and
  
shipments, material receipts, production work-in-process completed and inventory levels
  
within the Plant Level of Operations  

* Preparing and presenting to Director of Operations, the weekly executive summary that

includes production, purchasing, shipping, receiving and inventory numbers as part of the
  
system of infernal checks and balances  

* Recruiting, selecting, training, motivating and evaluating all operations employees in

accordance with company human relations policies and procedures  

* Helping to build and manage within a team-based production environment and developing

and maintaining good working relationships between production, materials, and
  
equipment maintenance  

* Interfacing between the employees in the department and the Director of Operations, the

Executive Vice-President and President of the Company and supporting company policies,
  
goals, objectives, and initiatives  

* Ensuring that all product produced meets quality requirements in accordance with

company policy, procedures and requirements and in accordance with industry standards  

* Keeping the Management abreast of successes, progress and potential problems and

offering appropriate solutions for those problems  

* Simultaneously handling, prioritizing and resolving problems effectively
* Ensuring that shipment deadlines and budget and profitability objectives (i.e. gross margin

and operating profit) are met and exceeded on a quarterly and annual basis as established
  
by Director of Operations  

* Ensuring achievement of production metrics and shipment objectives, including labor

hours per case, machine time per case, quality and cost per case; ensure that labor and
  
machine efficiency is within company guidelines; ensuring that periodic maintenance,
  
repair, rework hours and waste are within company guidelines  

* Ascertaining that purchasing, production support, shipping and receiving performance

metrics and objectives and inventory units and balance objectives are achieved or
  
exceeded on a quarterly and annual basis while ensuring on-time delivery of quality
  
product to customers at budgeted cost per case  

* Ensuring quality products are produced and quality relationships are established and

maintained between production, materials and equipment maintenance personnel, with
  
engineering and sales, customers, subcontractors and others in the area and in the
  
industry  

* Ensuring customer complaints are fewer and of less seriousness than company targets and

objectives  

* Ensuring that reporting and supporting documentation is completed on time and in

accordance with company procedures  

* Achieving Company goals to produce quality product on time and within budget hours are

supported in theory and followed in practice

Job Qualifications:
  

* 5+ year’s relevant industrial and manufacturing experience
* Associates degree in industrial, mechanical, or electrical engineering or equivalent

experience. Manufacturing engineering and operations management an added plus  

* Relevant and current technical knowledge concerning products, materials and equipment
* Knowledge, skills and ability to understand and manage food processing activities and

production lines to provide expertise and technical support to all plant employees, to
  
make equipment, production and materials related decisions  

* Ability to maintain production planning and scheduling, shop loading, expediting and

dispatching, purchasing, shipping and receiving and inventory control functions using
  
manufacturing systems in place  

* Ability to lead and motivate teams to produce quality product, on schedule and within

budget and participate in and facilitate operations-related team meetings  

* Outstanding communication skills with proven ability to successfully lead and develop a

team  

* Excellent team leadership skills and an ability to set goals, accomplish objectives, coach

and counsel while adding to the organizational climate and culture  

* Personal characteristics reflective of a fast paced industry: high energy, self-motivated,

positive attitude, service oriented, flexible, ethical, loyal and with high degree of integrity  

* Business maturity, team orientation and proven ability to positively influence change and

ensure business discipline through periods of growth while simultaneously protecting the
  
company’s operating principles and underlying entrepreneurial culture  

* Demonstrated good judgment in prioritizing, expediting, investigating and resolving

problems and issues and fosters harmonious relations with other company employees
  
while meeting and exceeding customer requirements  

* Respect for the confidentiality of company, customer, and employee information

Competencies:  

* Managing People - Includes staff in planning, decision-making, facilitating and process

improvement; Takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes self-available to staff;
  
Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages
  
growth; Solicits and applies customer feedback (internal and external); Fosters quality focus
  
in others; Improves processes, products, and services.; Continually works to improve
  
supervisory skills.

correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values; Benefits organization
  
through outside activities; Supports affirmative action and respects diversity.  

* Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and

analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem
  
solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

accuracy and thoroughness.

action beyond guidelines; Reports potentially unsafe conditions; Uses equipment and
  
materials properly.

external threats and opportunities; Adapts strategy to changing conditions.

development opportunities; Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; Shares
  
expertise with others.

vision and speech capabilities. Can wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) (Hearing protection,

this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or physical
  
requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign

United Plastic Fabricating (UPF) and Tideman Marine build custom polyethylene and polypropylene water tanks for the fire industry, along with products for the industrial, transportation, marine, and defense markets. The Plant Manager leads our Ocala, Florida plant and owns its results: safety, schedule attainment, labor efficiency, and quality. Production Managers make the week happen; you make the month happen. records.description:

This role combines technical leadership in process development, scale-up, and manufacturing excellence with responsibility for building the people, systems, and operating capabilities needed to support Inpria’s long-term growth.

The Director leads the Process Engineering Manager and the HVM Operations organization, integrating engineering priorities, manufacturing performance, and organizational capability. The role manages engineering and operations expenditure and execution in support of company objectives, and reports to the VP of Engineering.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

**Technical and Strategic Leadership**

* Set direction for process engineering and manufacturing operations, aligning objectives and priorities with company objectives cascaded by VP of Engineering, in partnership with senior management and JSR stakeholders.
* Partner with the Director of NPI Engineering to coordinate process development and scale-up, and lead manufacturing readiness and HVM’s participation in product transfers, including to external sites.
* Align engineering and manufacturing to support long-term growth, capacity expansion, and product roadmap needs.
* Lead capital planning and manufacturing capacity expansion in partnership with Facilities, Equipment Engineering, and Maintenance, defining manufacturing requirements and coordinating execution of approved investments.
* Manage operating expenditure (OPEX) and capital expenditure (CAPEX) for engineering and operations, including forecasts, resource allocation, cost control, and performance reporting within approved budgets and delegated authority. Develop plans and investment proposals to support VP in securing departmental budgets.
* Serve as a key interface with customers, supporting qualifications, audits, and long-term partnerships.
* Set priorities for the Process Engineering Manager, who leads the engineering team and owns process design, technical problem-solving, qualification, controlled process documentation, and technical readiness for transfer.
* Work with customer teams to balance production priorities against plant capacity, maintenance activities, equipment installs, and workforce readiness.
* Resolve significant technical, operational, customer-related, and cross-functional priority or resource conflicts within delegated authority; escalate decisions requiring additional approval to VP of Engineering.
* Lead organizational planning and develop the Process Engineering Manager, shift supervisors, and operations personnel to build leadership capability, technical depth, and operational continuity.
* Align technical programs across R&D, manufacturing, quality, and operations to support business goals.
* Ensure process control, equipment strategy, and continuous improvement efforts are properly resourced and executed.
* Support ERP and MES implementation by facilitating manufacturing requirements and ensuring organizational adoption.
* Partner with senior leadership on capacity planning, capability growth, and long-range roadmap execution.

**Manufacturing Operations**

* Provide hands-on leadership of the extended-shift HVM operation producing high-purity EUV metal oxide photoresist materials, building a detailed understanding of Inpria’s manufacturing constraints while balancing production requirements with safe, reliable, and effective use of personnel and equipment.
* Lead Operations through shift supervisors and the Manufacturing Engineering Specialist.

* Establish and enforce operational discipline through KPIs, standard work, performance management, and continuous-improvement systems.
* Manage the implementation of effective training, operator qualification, accountability, and workforce development systems.
* Build and develop the Operations management team, including defining the scope and hiring plan for an Operations Manager; developing supervisors to lead their shift teams; and developing the Manufacturing Engineering Specialist to coordinate manufacturing readiness, documentation, and floor support. * Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering or related field; advanced degree preferred.

* Demonstrated experience managing engineering or manufacturing operating budgets and capital investment plans, including forecasting, resource allocation, cost management, and performance reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to connect technical priorities with safe, reliable manufacturing performance and make sound technical and operational trade-offs in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Strong expertise in contamination control, ultra-high-purity systems, and specialty chemical processing.
* Experience scaling processes from development through full production.
* Proven leadership developing managers, supervisors, or technical teams, with experience supporting a continuous or extended-shift manufacturing environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Experience with photoresist precursors, EUV photoresists, advanced lithography materials, electronics materials, or semiconductor process integration.
